chapters.title: Chapter 3030 Expansion II
paragraphs: Even in the midst of the weavings of such news, an Entity like this thought on how to best use it as if it could only be the Pillagers and Sanctus Populi that were affected by these weavings...
With a rainbow colored glow surging around him, he stared above and began to seamlessly pull up on the influence of multiple Omniversal Authorities...
Far, far away from the Source of the Imperium.
Within the gaps of the Omniverse.
Between the complex weavings of Omniversal Authorities themselves.
A massive pocket of existence was carved within such a location as it was ten times as vast as common Existential Domains.

Yet everything within it was immeasurably dark and veiled as at the center of it all...was a massive form of an Entity that seemed to be entirely made up of trillions of tentacles filled with a deeply obsidian light.

These tentacles were so numerous and massive that they seemed to stretch out across this carved pocket of space, with two crimson eyes the size of Planes of Existence simmering with power visible at the very center.
Arcs of destruction and devouring might crackle around this massive Entity as very few could ever handle their pressure alone, but in the next moment...
WAP!
A humanoid figure surrounded by a blazing rainbow colored light appeared in the center of the void in the line of sight of the two crimson eyes and the trillions of tentacles all around it.
The figure bowed towards the eyes while speaking out.
|Master, I have seen-|

|Yes, yes- Weavings of destruction. Haha, you are bothering with such things? We live and thrive on pillaging and destruction. I welcome whatever force will try to do this...you haven't gotten a clue yet, have you, Butler Skylar?|
Before the humanoid entity surrounded by a rainbow colored light could even reply, the tendrils of the monstrous entity he called Master interrupted him and asked a question at the same time.
A question that the humanoid Entity distinguished as Butler Skylar shook his head with sternness while replying.
|Not much. A flash of Colorless wings of light. Of interminable wrath raging out...|

|Mmm yes, wrath. Meaning this may happen from the weavings of the future that will be reacted upon...I want to help them achieve this wrath that brings about so much destruction. I want to make sure they truly get enraged and involve all those prevalent. The only question is...who they are and what we need to do to achieve that level of rage. Haha!|
Unfathomable Existential waves of destruction bloomed out as towards this issue...it seemed different entities reacted in their own ways.
|Find them. Enrage them. Let us seek out this possible weaving of the future and bask in its destruction...|
Hearing the words of the terrifying Entity before him, the humanoid visage only bowed down with absolute loyalty.
|I will do my best to collect the information, Master.|
With a glimmer of brilliance, this humanoid entity disappeared.
It left behind the terrifying tendrils of weavings of an Omniversal Pillager whose eyes began to shine with expectation and excitement!
It thrived on destruction.
If such a level of destruction could truly be brought forth, its Existence felt like it could advance even further.
The Others just like it were getting even further ahead.
Their strength was reaching unfathomable levels as it couldn't be left behind!
So it began to peer into the weavings of Existence itself.
On the identity of the one it needed to find. What it needed to do in order to enrage them.
Normally, enraging someone could be done by taking what was theirs, or that which they truly loved.
It would first find the party promising destruction...and it would utterly and existentially destroy that which they loved to earn their rage!
|Haha...where are you, O Bearer of Destruction?!|
An unknown party was being sought after by many, many Entities.
Uniquely...this unknown party was also looking for themselves!
In another area of the vast stretches of the Omniverse.
An Omniversal Authority twisted as it spat out a few hundred figures radiating terrifying might.
And at the very center...
|Old Fool, this is fucking exhausting...|
An entity surrounded by a liquid gold light uttered out as he was an Imperium Martial King, and the one he was grumbling to was of the same stature!
It was the Archon Basileus Alderon and the Imperium Martial King of Cappadocia!
The visage of Archon Basileus Alderon was the one complaining as he was currently tightly entangled with an Omniversal Authority, constantly using its influence as he didn't let it go.
The Imperium Martial King Reperiel nodded as if he understood entirely, his intent gazing around.

|You are the best tracker among us. With the Omniversal Authority you've entangled yourself with, every time we warp...gives us the slim possibility of getting closer towards the one we're thinking of across the Omniverse. You never know, during one of these Omniversal Warpings, Noah Osmont could be right before us...|
Terrifying words emanated from this being!

|Bah, the problem is the whole entourage you're carrying around with you. What use do they have if we're here?| Archon Basileus Alderon seemed annoyed and exhausted as he pointed to the Legions of Teleios Stage Imperium Knights behind them.
Amongst them were Akalusia and Knight Palmino, in one Legion- along with the visage of Al-Abalem!
Multiple other Legions surrounded their figures as when they were pointed out, Martial King Reperiel only smiled.
|I want there to be not even a slim chance of him slipping through. My Imperium Legions have means to ensure this even with us being present...|
A heavy and prepared force.

A force led by two Teracosm Stage Entities who were warping across the Omniverse while utilizing a unique Omniversal Authority that had a probability of allowing them to warp closer and closer to a certain target!
A target that even at this very moment...was actually heading towards the direction of the Imperium!

chapters.title: Chapter 3031 Expansion III
paragraphs: In a distant corner of the Omniverse.

Two figures were making their way across as if they were strolling on a fun little journey, an Existential Vessel in the form of verdant gold ship leading the way as ever so often, it seemed to breeze over the back of an Omniversal Authority.

Aboard this ship, two being sat down on verdant gold cushions as between them, an illusory construct of a massive Existential Domain could be seen- this actually being a loose recreation of the Source of the Imperium!
Sona had gone through great difficulty in grasping the weavings of existence and records to recreate this as they now studied it on how to best infiltrate to get what they wanted.
Noah looked at Sona's green and gold locks of hair, finding a few locks of blue within that seemed to be caused by her icy Source of Psychros.
She held the face of determination right now that caused her whole visage to emanate immeasurable charm, her fair nose wrinkling here and there as she seemed to be in a great battle of thoughts.
She was currently adorned in an icy white blue robe that hid the many blessings underneath, tendrils of Omniversal Authorities occasionally dancing on her figure over the past minutes.
As Noah gazed and studied her stunning figure...an Extremity relating to the seven Deadly sins arose of its own volition.
{The Extremity of Lust nods in appreciation at the Entity before it.}
{The Existential Extremity Authority of Dignity glares at the Extremity of Lust with warning.}
{The Extremity of Plot states not to worry and let things flow as they should.}

Noah's extremes continued to have their own intents and express them, Noah himself only listening to them with a smile as he looked at this Entity that he had to admit held a sense of beauty and charm exceeding many of those that came before.
He couldn't quite put his finger on it.
Who would dare to destroy a figure such as this and damn the whole Sanctus Populi along with her?
He only had this thought as his intent weaved out afterwards.
|Do you have any theories regarding what the cause of Damnation could be? What could bring an apocalypse to the Sanctus Populi, Omniversal Pillagers, and even the Imperium?|
He asked a fairly important question.
|Mmm...| And Sona blinked her dazzling eyes as she came to focus on him.

|I can't say for sure. But that level of destruction across the most pertinent forces of the Omniverse shows that whatever is behind it is callous, uncaring, and seems to only think about destruction. Soulless as if it cannot be deterred no matter what.|
WAA!

|The most astonishing thing for me was not being able to change the destruction brought forth in countless possible weavings, but with you added and the rest of the Anomalies we're going to gather...whatever is seeking to bring damnation now has a chance of being wiped out. In time, we'll gradually obtain more information on just what this enemy could be...|
An unknown enemy.
Uncaring and callous in nature!
Noah thought about this closely as he stared ahead where the verdant gold vessel was streaking across, thinking of all the many things he had to do now and in the future to come to prepare.
Because far away from the location of his Dominium Soul, he was about to make a significant move among the many other moves he was carrying out.

He was starting the spark of expansion across the Omniverse himself even before his people were ready to get involved, and this spark would bloom on a nondescript Unique Existential Domain where a certain slightly wealthy Imperium Royal had taken actions to make certain things possible!
Within an Unstable Anomalous Existential Domain.

The Imperium Royal Decimara had a bright smile on his face as he got past many restrictions and danger zones of the of the Unstable Anomalous Existential Domain, his face sweeping around him to see a small army of 49 Automaton Workers shining in bright golden blue luster that he continued to buy and utilize to make headway into this unique domain!
Their statures of muscular humanoid bodies with a pair of blue wings behind them and a golden luster all across made them seem like a menacing celestial army, and because of them...

He had already discovered a cluster of Fruits of Existence in a region that held pulsing unstable existential authority in a singularity, and right now, he stood behind a pulsing wall of violet storms of authority where behind it...seemed to be the core of this Unstable Anomalous Existential Domain.
Past the storm, he caught a glimpse of shining violet metals, crystals, and even Fruits of Existence that seemed to be Unique Fruits of Existence!
|Haha, a treasure trove! No other Royal here to share it with, and I just need to bypass the most dangerous part of the storm...|
Imperium Royal Decimara was gleeful at the scene before him.

He navigated treacherous areas of this Unstable Anomalous Existential Domain while utilizing these Automatons Workers, and he continued to buy them from the Existential Imperium Exchange as if he couldn't have enough of them!
He wanted to amass as many of these products as he could, and at this moment.
|Let's go!|
He commanded them once more to go forward and see which path would be of least resistance since it seemed only Teleios Stage Entities may be able to bypass the storm ahead safely.
The commanded Automaton Workers remained still.
|Huh?| Decimara blinked in confusion as the two Sequor Stage guards behind him became stern, their senses just beginning to go off.
|Why...| And just as Decimara was turning towards the Automaton Workers, he felt a pair of hands land on his shoulders and press down with unfathomable pressure!
His Sequor Stage Guards were the same as when Decimara turned to gaze at his shoulders, he saw invisible hands pressing down as at this moment, they gradually began to gain light and materialize.
Along with it, the brilliance of an Illusory Commander unfolded!

chapters.title: Chapter 3032 Expansion IV
paragraphs: The Illusory Weavings under Noah's banner were invisible, yes, but it didn't mean they couldn't show themselves if they wished.

At this moment, a pair of invisible hands clamped on the Imperium Royal Decimara and his Guards at the Sequor Stage, none of them being able to move an inch as the pressure of three Teleios Stage Entities bloomed out!

The visage of the Illusory Commander Augustus appeared behind Decimara, with the Illusory Weavings of Archon Basileus Ignatius and the Royal Observer Xavier pressing down on the guards as from the Illusory Commander...
|No need to be so hasty.|
A biting intent filled with unsurpassable power boomed out and shook Decimara's will.
His will gazed at the Entity at the Teleios Stage surrounded by blazing purple flames behind him as too many questions arose.
Who were they? How could they have possibly found this place? And were they...friends or foes of the Imperium?
Decimara's head buzzed as before any answers could come...
|You can get all the resources lying behind this Existential storm, but before you proceed...you simply have to pledge fealty.|
Decimara felt like his throat had become extremely dry as he weaved out his intent.
|Pledge fealty to...who?|
He felt an unbelievable sense of danger.
A danger that told him if he said the wrong thing, it would very likely be the last his Dominium would see!
Behind him, the Illusory Commander let go of the body of the Imperium Royal as he walked forward, a smile on his face as he spoke callously.
|To the Weaver of Extremity. Pledge your fealty to the Master of the Illusory Weaving Legions!|
HUUM!
A thick tendril of Tyranny erupted out along with slivers of Conquest.

Before the eyes of Decimara, this thick concentration of existential authority came towards his Body as if his Dominium rejected it, he knew the full pressure of the Teleios Stage Entity before him would eviscerate him!
So Decimara closed his eyes and shuddered while the tendrils of Authority flowed deep into his Dominium.
His pudgy body filled with fat and brilliance trembled as he felt the source of his existence be penetrated, a new authority settling within him that would control his existence for the eons to come!
He didn't fight it.
He was too used to life. He didn't want to end everything because of stubbornness.

And he saw the possibility of taking another path in the next moment as behind him, one of his guards roared out in defiance as the Exclusive Existential Extremity Authority of the Imperium exploded out from him!
|Glory to the Imperi-|
BOOM!

The hand of the Illusory Weaving of the Archon Basileus Ignatius smashed down with an interminable existential authority that was colorless, causing the body of the guard to crack and fold into itself before it shattered into fine dust within an instant!
A Sequor Stage Dominium...turned to fine dust in an instant!
And the more terrifying thing was that within the next few seconds, a light shone from the dust that then coagulated to begin forming...an illusory figure.
A figure that when its humanoid body fully formed looked extremely like his dead Guard!

The pudgy visage of Decimara trembled even more as he suppressed the Exclusive Existential Extremity Authority of the Imperium as far down as possible, not wanting its arrogant quality to rise up and cause him to be killed as within his mind, a voice rose.
A voice telling him to pledge fealty!
It was the last and final straw for him as the moment he did so, his Dominium would forever be bound by another.
And so...
His visage kneeled as he and his remaining guard voiced out at the same time.
|I pledge fealty to the Weaver of Extremity!|
HUUM!
Waves of brilliance shone.
And his weavings completely became bound to another as slowly, he felt the Exclusive Existential Extremity Authority of the Imperium leaving his Dominium!

But in its place...multiple Existential Extremity Authorities shining with a Colorless, Cerulean, and Golden lusters began to present themselves to Decimara with prompts as there would be more choices for him to make.

While this occurred, the Illusory Commander nodded his head and left the dazed Decimara behind, walking towards the chaotic violet storm of a natal Existential Extremity Authority as he also kneeled down and thrust his hand forward.
|I serve the Master.|
His hands were raised up as he was used as a conduit.
From his raised hands, a singularity in the form of a Seed bloomed with a gorgeous blue light of Manadynamics.
It was known as a Miniature Existential Omniversal Seed of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed!

It was part of Noah's construct that the moment it was released into this Unstable Anomalous Existential Domain...it anchored itself in space as Manadynamics began to flow out freely, latching on the tendrils of violet existential authorities ahead and beginning to change and devour them!
Manadynamics.
It stated that essence could neither be created nor destroyed, only changed in different forms.

At this moment, it altered the form of an unknown natal Existential Extremity Authority while a devouring light began to radiate from the Miniature Existential Omniversal Seed- the very reality of this Unstable Anomalous Existential Domain beginning to be devoured even before the deadly storm that prevented Decimara from attaining clusters of Unique Fruits of Existence, Metalloids, and other resources within place was cleared!
The weavings of the Unstable Anomalous Existential Domain seemed to tremble and roar as it began to be eaten up, tendrils of heavy Existential Extremity Authority beginning to gather here.

At the same time, the Automaton Workers flapped their wings and floated towards different areas of this Unstable Anomalous Existential Domain, intent on releasing the power of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed across it as after the Vitalis and Vacuous Existential Domains...this Unstable Anomalous Existential Domain would be the third Domain to be devoured.

It was the true beginning of the expansion of the power of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed- a construct that was adding dozens of Existential Extremity Authorities even at this very moment from the pillars of authorities that made it!

It was the last and final straw for him as the moment he did so, his Dominium would forever be bound by another.
And so...
His visage kneeled as he and his remaining guard voiced out at the same time.
|I pledge fealty to the Weaver of Extremity!|
HUUM!
Waves of brilliance shone.
And his weavings completely became bound to another as slowly, he felt the Exclusive Existential Extremity Authority of the Imperium leaving his Dominium!

But in its place...multiple Existential Extremity Authorities shining with a Colorless, Cerulean, and Golden lusters began to present themselves to Decimara with prompts as there would be more choices for him to make.

While this occurred, the Illusory Commander nodded his head and left the dazed Decimara behind, walking towards the chaotic violet storm of a natal Existential Extremity Authority as he also kneeled down and thrust his hand forward.
|I serve the Master.|
His hands were raised up as he was used as a conduit.
From his raised hands, a singularity in the form of a Seed bloomed with a gorgeous blue light of Manadynamics.
It was known as a Miniature Existential Omniversal Seed of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed!

It was part of Noah's construct that the moment it was released into this Unstable Anomalous Existential Domain...it anchored itself in space as Manadynamics began to flow out freely, latching on the tendrils of violet existential authorities ahead and beginning to change and devour them!
Manadynamics.
It stated that essence could neither be created nor destroyed, only changed in different forms.

At this moment, it altered the form of an unknown natal Existential Extremity Authority while a devouring light began to radiate from the Miniature Existential Omniversal Seed- the very reality of this Unstable Anomalous Existential Domain beginning to be devoured even before the deadly storm that prevented Decimara from attaining clusters of Unique Fruits of Existence, Metalloids, and other resources within place was cleared!
The weavings of the Unstable Anomalous Existential Domain seemed to tremble and roar as it began to be eaten up, tendrils of heavy Existential Extremity Authority beginning to gather here.

At the same time, the Automaton Workers flapped their wings and floated towards different areas of this Unstable Anomalous Existential Domain, intent on releasing the power of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed across it as after the Vitalis and Vacuous Existential Domains...this Unstable Anomalous Existential Domain would be the third Domain to be devoured.

It was the true beginning of the expansion of the power of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed- a construct that was adding dozens of Existential Extremity Authorities even at this very moment from the pillars of authorities that made it!

chapters.title: Chapter 3033 Expansion V
paragraphs: ROAR!
A violet existential authority raged as it began to feel an undeniable devouring.
Across its Unstable Anomalous Existential Domain, different anchors- different Seeds were placed that began to devour everything about it.
Its signature within the very Omniverse itself was being devoured!
This encroached upon its very source. Upon what it stood for.
Violet.
This was the color spread out across the Unstable Anomalous Existential Domain as even though it was a natal Existential Extremity Authority with nobody to command it.

It had reached this current stage even though it was born not too long ago, and if given eons to continue, even with the errors that caused its instability...it may have culminated to become a terrifying Unstable Anomalous Existential Domain!
Because its weavings were grand ones.
Filled with majesty and grace even amidst the chaos of instability, Noah had found the identity of this Authority through the Existential Automatons a while ago!
And at this moment as his Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed devoured it, the chest of an Existential Automaton opened up like a door as from it, Noah's Dominium Body stepped out.
Simmering with wild power.
Glorious Pairs of purple wings on his back and feet.
And his chest laid bare for his sculpted visage to bless the surrounding reality.
He appeared as the moment he did so, dense rivers of violet light seemingly found their target- the one behind all of this as they converged towards Noah's figure in anger!
Noah looked up at the perilous rivers of Existential Extremity Authority as he merely stood there, letting it smash into his body and in this surrounding space as...
CRACKLE!
His body glistened like a reinforced diamond that nothing could pass through.
And amidst this storm, his body began to give off tendrils of golden Dignity.
Of Tyranny.
Of Infinity.
Of Quintessence!
He gave off such brilliance as his intent weaved out!
|Do not be defiant, I will raise you to a level even you cannot fathom.|
WAA!
Surrounded by his own pristine authorities, Noah told the natal Existential Extremity Authority of this Unstable Anomalous Existential Domain to fall in line.
That he would elevate it to a level it couldn't even imagine!
The violet tendrils of light paused while staring at the boundlessly coiling Dignity.
At Quintessence, Infinity, and Tyranny!
And after it ascertained the state of the current reality...
WAA!
The raging rivers of violet light became calm.

It sensed the immeasurable Dignity from the entity before it as this natal authority fully felt like its distinction would not be wasted if it submitted to this being- and there didn't even seem to be much of an option anyway!
The hidden seas of Dignity it was shown just simply granted complete acceptance.
|Come.|
Noah beckoned to it as the violet authority seethed and began to surge its Tendrils of light into Noah's body.
It would do well.
Its extreme would be signified well with this being.
After all, it was the Existential Extremity Authority of Sovereignty!
Sovereignty!
HUUM!
The wings behind Noah's back flapped.
For a brief moment, they seemed to expand and cover the countless light years this Unstable Anomalous Existential Domain stretched out to.
And a moment later...
WAP!

All incoming violet authority of Sovereignty instantly disappeared into Noah's body, and the vast stretches of the Unstable Anomalous Existential Domain also disappeared into the Miniature Existential Omniversal Seeds!
Everything happened in an instant.
The Existential Automatons, Illusory Weavings, and newly conquered Imperium Royal Decimara and his guard were the only ones left behind to bathe in the shocking result of this brilliance!
A result that somehow within the span of an instant, the entire Unstable Anomalous Existential Domain was devoured.
Decimara trembled in shock while the Illusory Weavings kneeled with respect.
They didn't ask how.
While Noah himself...
{You have discovered another feature of the Existential Invictus Dominium Wings!}

{The Invictus Wings are capable of affecting, accelerating, and bringing to fruition the Existential Causality of an action or event that is ascertained to happen with the highest probable chance within the span of an instant.}
Existential Causality.
Cause and effect!
If an event had the highest probable chance of happening, Noah could affect it, accelerate it, or even bring it to fruition in the span of an instant.

Noah's mind buzzed at such a finding as back in the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed, his Dominium Origin felt the influx of the whole Unstable Anomalous Existential Domain of Sovereignty bloom like a singularity atop the Extremity Vein, its authority being assimilated into the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed rapidly as everything within was enriched!
But even as this scene played out, Noah was still stuck thinking about the Invictus Dominium Wings and their capability to affect Causality.
It had just happened naturally without Noah directly putting his mind to it, but what if he focused on an event directly and utilized this terrifying power to bring it to fruition?
An event...
HUUM!
His mind buzzed.

His Dominium Origin was the only one remaining within the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed giving a lecture as the Existential Omniversal Guider, and at this moment, in his humanoid form of his Dominium Origin...he raised his hands up while focusing on an event.
His people only watched him unblinkingly as they wondered what he was doing now.
But Noah was unfettered as he thought about...the production of Fruits of Existence by the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed.
This was an event that would continue to happen for the foreseeable future.

It was something guaranteed with the highest probability....so could he affect Causality and bring to fruition the production of all the Fruits of Existence for some time frame in the future within the span of the next instant?
The production of Fruits of Existence that had its rate already rapidly increased?
This was the idea.

And as soon as he focused on it, the dazzling purple wings behind his back shone, and then proceeded to enlarge with an illusory light as if their wingspan was covering all of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed!
Even the wings on his feet fluttered and radiated a blinding radiance as...

{The Existential Causality Feature of the Invictus Dominium Wings has been applied on the production of Fruits of Existence within the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed for the currently possible maximum time of 24 hours.}
A single prompt.
And an instant later...
BOOM!
A glorious eruption of thousands of Fruits of Existence gushed out in front of Noah, twinkling over the astonished gazes of his people like stellar blinking stars!

chapters.title: Chapter 3034 Causality! I
paragraphs: Thousands of Fruits of Existence!
Each one held its own unique color as they held a uniqueness based on Aletheian Havens of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed.
Looking at the cluster of Fruits of Existence in front of him, it wasn't even Noah who showed off the most reaction- it was his extremes!
{The Extremity of Loot salivates with excitement!}
{Quintessence shines upon this new action with brilliance!}
{The Extremity of Cheats states to do it again! Do it again!}
Shock and awe reverberated across Noah's weavings as what he had just done was more than just broken!
Since something that was guaranteed to happen could be actualized within the span of an instant, many possibilities opened up for him from here on out.
The alteration of Existential Causality could be utilized in so many different situations- even within battles as the applications were endless!
As he saw the eruption of thousands of Fruits of Existence, he let them flow towards his people as these would be utilized as the fuel for their Dominiums.
At the same time, he studied the effects of what he had done as when he looked at his Invictus Wings...
They were much dimmer than they were just seconds ago!
At the same time, he studied the effects of what he had done as when he looked at his Invictus Wings...
They were much dimmer than they were just seconds ago!

Gazing at them, he could feel the reserves of their authority as the shocking alteration of Existential Causality he had just done...had seemingly taken nearly half of the power of his Invictus Dominium Wings.
The action of causing the instant devouring of the Unstable Anomalous Existential Domain of Sovereignty had taken less than a tenth by comparison!

But since he had over half of the reserves of the astounding power of the Invictus Dominium Wings still remaining, with the rest regenerating over time, he could once more affect Causality as he wished right now.
The Wings seemed much dimmer than before, but Noah wanted to continue!
He wanted to affect Existential Causality once more when...
BZZT!
His wings buzzed with a warning.
Warning...from the Invictus Dominium Wings.
As if they were telling him to conserve his reserves of authority.
As if he would very much need their capabilities soon.
What did this mean?
His gaze became stern.
It meant something big was coming!

His Dominium Origin could be ruled out since it was within the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed. And his Dominium Body that had just finished aiding in the devouring of an Existential Domain was a possibility.
And his Dominium Soul traveling with Sona...had an even greater possibility!
But what exactly would be happening, and what level of danger could there be?
Noah could only plan ahead in advance as he began to move.
In the space where the Unstable Anomalous Existential Domain of Sovereignty used to be.

Noah's visage was in front of the Imperium Royal Decimara who was kneeling while raising his head to peek a gaze at the new Master he had signed his Dominium to, with Noah's intent flowing out succinctly as he looked at the distant vessel of Decimara that had his attendants left behind within it.
They would also come to bend the knee soon as first...

|You have tried the products of the Infernal Enclave now. Spread the word about them to your peers, to the Archon Basileus of Existential Domains. Let them know of the amazing constructs of the Automaton Workers that you found and monopolized as if you do well...you could easily rise among the ranks.|
Decimara trembled at Noah's words as if he could already understand everything behind their meaning.
If other Imperium Royals and even Archons of Legacies bought the Existential Automatons of his new Master, wouldn't what just happened to him...happen to them as well?
This terrifying reality caused his Dominium to buzz as thereafter...
|Yes, Master!|
His pudgy body bent even more as he would actually do this action gladly!
He didn't want to be the only one bending the knee from those among the Imperium.
And misery...loves company.
|I will use all my sources to advertise your products for you, and if you have even rarer things than the Automaton Workers...|

|Neonate and Sequor Stage Existential Workers will be produced soon enough. Start with these and measure your progress.| Noah's intent boomed out as Decimara nodded, returning towards his vessel with his guard as in the surroundings, the Illusory Legion also bowed before they began to disappear.
Noah alone was left behind as he wondered...what was about to happen?
Away from this location.
Towards the vessel his Dominium Soul was traversing in with the Anomaly and Sanctus Princess...Sona!
His Dominium Soul gazed at the stern Sona who seemed focused on what was to come when he spoke out calmly.
|Something is coming.|
Something was coming.

A simple sentence that told of many things as Sona absorbed it and gazed up, her eyes becoming sharp as she tapped her finger towards the empty space to instantly cause the descent of the weavings of an Omniversal Authority!
Her Dignity and Psychros flowed into it as glacial golden light shone brightly, with Sona's gaze becoming more difficult as she spoke out succinctly.
|Yes, and it seems unavoidable even if we change our path.|
At this point, she turned to Noah as if to explain further.
|Our path. If we were to separate, it seems I would be able to escape whatever is coming as it seems to be honed in on you. But don't worry, I won't abandon you just yet, Osmont.|

She smiled brilliantly at such words as even though she affirmed danger was coming towards Noah and she would simply be implicated, the option of leaving wasn't even a possibility as the Initiative...stuck together!
They needed to be a cohesive unit in the future to come if the possible weavings of paths absent from Damnation were to ever arrive.
So Sona knew that she would never abandon Noah.
No matter what.
At such conviction, Noah looked deeply into the eyes of this mesmerizing woman as before any other weavings could unfold...
HUUM!
In a close distance, a mere light year away from their vessel...a massive wave of teleportation exploded.

With it came the sweeping auras of two Teracosm Stage Entities that instantly covered trillions upon trillions of light years all around, their eyes blinking in stupefaction when they found signs of life merely a light year away.
And when they further focused on these signs of life...
Incredulity and excitement welled within these two Teracosm Stage Entities as wondrously, it was the target they had been chasing for the past day!
Along with the sweeping of their auras, existence congealed instantly all around as the raucous laughter of a Martial King rang out alongside it.
|Haha, Noah Osmont...the fucking effort it took to find you!|
Noah's gaze became stern as he and Sona rose on their vessel.

He looked ahead and recognized some faces as behind the terrifying auras of two Teracosm Stage Entities, there was a Legion he had just recently clashed with that included Knight Akalusia and Knight Palmino.
There was even the cause of Al-Abalem gazing towards him with incredulity as he truly couldn't seem to believe a Seed like him was currently where he was!
The forces of the Imperium had arrived.
And in tow were two terrifying Teracosm Stage Entities as they really sent two big bosses without sending minions to simply die in numbers!

chapters.title: Chapter 3035 Causality! II
paragraphs: Incredulity.
This was what Al-Abalem felt as he floated in the midst of Imperium Legions while looking at the distant figure of Noah!
Was...was that really the Seed that caused havoc within his past Vitalis Domain?
Someone who should have only been in the Gradations of Extremity?
So why was it now that in mere days, his body shone with the distinct purple grandeur of a Teleios Stage Existential Dominium? How...
Al-Abalem wanted to understand. He wanted to know the root cause of how things ended so spectacularly for him!
He wanted to, but at this current stage...
|Move!|
He was only considered a small piece of the puzzle.

A single booming word echoed out from the smiling Martial King of Cappadocia- Reperiel, that caused the Imperium Legions he brought to instantly disappear and reappear in different points of space light years away- the Knight Commanders holding Codexes of Extremity shining with brilliant light as barriers of golden light bloomed all around them rapidly!
Even Al-Abalem could only grit his teeth and move among the Teleios Stage Knights within the Legion that Knight Commander Akalusia led.
He couldn't even speak at this stage as oh...how times had changed!

The only players deserving to even speak were two terrifying old men at the very forefront who vibrated with waves of Omniversal Authorities while glaring towards the distant visage of Noah, and by the look of green gold hair...a Sanctus Princess with him in tow.
They stared towards the encirclement with sharp eyes as in the hands of the Sanctus Princess, a freezing icy sword appeared freely.
BZZT!
Tendrils of opposing light seemed to clash between their line of sight.
The eyes of the Sanctus Princess and Noah Osmont were locked onto the aged eyes of Martial King Reperiel and Archon Basileus Alderon!
Two young looking entities with unfathomable beauty, against two old men whose golden locks of hair ran over their shoulders like ancient hermits.
It was a unique contrast as Archon Basileus Alderon smiled with a veiled sense of satisfaction and cruelty as he stretched his hands.

|Around a few thousand light years here, the Existential Imperium Blockade enacted by the Exclusive Existential Extremity Authority of the Imperium has been established, not allowing even a Teracosm Stage Entity who doesn't have the authority of the Imperium to pass through.|
The Legions that had moved to the surroundings were all for this purpose.

Alderon didn't say, but all Knight Commanders were holding their Codexes of Extremity and connected to the Imperium Knights within their Legions to also allow the flow of an Omniversal Authority to further reinforce the Imperium Blockade!
And for it to even be broken, all Knight Commanders would have to somehow be killed before it could be opened.
And even then, there were the two of them to deal with.

|Basically, you won't be leaving here anytime soon. And since it did take much effort to find you, I do want to solve some of the mysteries surrounding you...and what the fuck made you so bold as to attack members of the Imperium.|
WAA!
Archon Basileus Alderon began succinctly as beside him, Martial King Reperiel smacked his lips while shaking his head, his intent bright as his body began to buzz with brilliance.

|You get more talkative in your old age, Alderon. Is it because you're seeing the pretty face beside him? Brats like these need to be killed first, and then have the questions asked later. Their records will tell the story.|
Martial King Reperiel was much more straightforward.
He already began to gather the influence of Omniversal Authorities as beside him, Archon Basileus Alderon languidly began to float towards Noah and Sona as his eyes showed countless veiled weavings!

Noah and Sona looked at this unfolding scene as Noah's pairs of wings were already buzzing, analyzing the danger present and the possible weavings of battle that could unfold when beside him, Sona tilted her head while gazing at the dazzling folded barrier that would even stop Teracosm Stage Entities all around them.
She then raised her brows towards the terrifying Martial Kings ahead as her intent weaved out.
|Shouldn't old men like you be retiring? There's an existential nursing home somewhere with your names on it- going around the Omniverse like this...should be beneath you.|
As she spoke, her body began to pulse as she raised the icy sword in her hands, golden tendrils of Dignity booming out as this time, they were supremely fast.
Her eyes became cold as they gazed at the mocking look on Archon Basileus Alderon and the careful visage of Martial King Reperiel.
|And also...to keep me in any cage, those holding it up must ask themselves- do they have more dignity than me?|
HUUM!
Her sword hummed.
And her Dignity was expressed as a flash of golden light that illuminated everything.

Instantly, the face of Knight Commander Akalusia and all other Knight Commanders holding Codexes of Extremity changed drastically as the very Existential Extremity of Dignity was expressed in a horrific way by Sona!
A golden light blared as it questioned whether they had more Dignity than her, and since the answer was no...
CRACK!

The Codexes of Extremity were the first things that shockingly splintered in half, a golden sword flash of Dignity blooming before the bodies of the Commanders holding these books and instantly, their Dominiums were bisected!
HUUM!
It happened in the span of an instant.
The brilliant golden blockade supported by the Exclusive Existential Extremity Authority of the Imperium began to distort and fade away soon after.

The Imperium Knight Commanders cried out as some of them had their bodies cut in half, while others like Knight Palmino were bleeding from their orifices as they grasped shattered and stopped Codexes of Extremity!
It was a shocking scene as only now...did they see that above Sona, there was a tout weaving of an Omniversal Authority already influencing her actions!
Her figure blazed with brilliance as she seemed distinguished across the battlefield.
A single strike from her had put a dozen Teleios Stage Imperium Commanders out of business.
And she then spoke towards Noah beside her as her words caused him to question if he heard correctly.

|Alright big guy, you take on those two old men and I'll clear up the Legion cronies? One of them can't seem to stop looking me up and down...you have to protect me if I'm to be your possession, yes?|
She blinked calmly as she spoke in this absolutely deadly situation!

Far ahead of them, their enemies reacted even more strongly as the visage of the golden haired Archon Basileus Alderon had his eyes wide and his nostrils flaring as his eyes existentially locked onto Sona's visage, his intent weaving out.

|Oh fuck...Reperiel, I want her!| Gazing at the astounding scene of all Imperium Knight Commanders and their Codexes cut down with the barrier even capable of blocking Teracosm Stage Entities cut down...the first intent to leave Archon Basileus Alderon's mouth was a vile one!

chapters.title: Chapter 3036 Causality! III
paragraphs: Archon Basileus Alderon had a vile character very few knew about.
He managed many Existential Domains as the Legacy of Alderon was a grand one!
Martial King Reperiel knew very well about his tendencies as the moment Alderon spoke his vile intent out, Reperiel's intent weaved out.
|Put in some effort if you want her, she seems to be a difficult one.|
The words seemed like a challenge as in the next moment, Alderon's visage released an overwhelming aura of golden brilliance.
The might of a true Teracosm Stage Entity unfurled as when it came to this stage, it was hard to ascertain one's power within it!
The gulf across the Dominium Skies of this stage was so wide that someone at its entry point to be oppressed by the mere pressure of someone at its end stages.
And one wouldn't be the wiser on exactly where in the stage of Progression a Teracosm Stage Entity was until they revealed their power!
Noah analyzed and understood this all very closely.
He sensed the power emanating from the two terrifying Entities ahead as truly, his Dominium didn't yet match theirs in power as in this, he was trialing behind!
But he did have his Concepts.
His Extremes, and his Records.
But most of all, he had the Existential Invictus Dominium Wings.
The progression of the Primordium Core where he had stored a dense number of Dominium Rules simply waiting to be unleashed freely without cost.
And he also had his own reserves of existential authority, and the reserves of authority of the Invictus Dominium Wings to rely on!
And then, of course, there was the weight of his Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed he could apply to his attacks.
But in the face of sheer power, would it be enough?
HOH!
His enemies didn't even give him a chance, nor did he have the chance to analyze countless weavings within an instant.

They also moved within the span of an instant as heavy tendrils of Existential Extremity Authorities erupted from both of the Teracosm Entities while complex weavings of Omniversal Authorities descended on their bodies!
And at such a moment...
HUUM!
Noah's Invictus Dominium Wings...once more buzzed.
{The Invictus Dominium Wings stand as an organ that represents one who is unconquerable and undefeatable.}
{When a weaving unfolds posing any danger directed towards you, the Invictus Dominium Wings breaks down and analyzes what is coming your way to allow you to best react against it and ensure victory.}
In the flash of an instant, he saw many things.
From the body of Martial King Reperiel, he saw the flash of gold as above his head, a dense set of words appeared.

{Backed by the influence of an Omniversal Authority, the concept of Domination seeks to assert its extreme on two targets- you and Sona, rendering your extremes void so long as any part of your Dominium is dominated.}
Such words and more rose above Reperiel as the Archon Basileus Alderon even closer to them...

{Backed by the influence of an Omniversal Authority, the concept of Hypnos seeks to assert its extreme on a single target- Sona. It seeks to hypnotize her existential authorities, Dominium, and everything within her existence as if it were still under her control. It seeks to assert that Alderon is actually a dear and trusted Knight of Sona- somebody who has been with her for eons.}
WAA!
A golden aura of Domination from Martial King Reperiel.
A pinkish aura of maleficence rose around Alderon and surged out rapidly!

Each of them carried a heavy weight as they had the influence of Omniversal Authorities flowing along with them, where even if another weaker entity had concepts grander than these...stopping their advancement was going to be nearly impossible!
But...
|You got it?| The intent of Sona beside him rang in his mind as she was ready to move at any time.
Noah's eyes became sharp as his reply was his own actions.
So what if they were Teracosm Stage Entities? It was still merely Teracosm!
HUUM!
His Invictus Dominium Wings buzzed as the Dominium Rules lying dormant within them began to be released one after another.
{The Dominium Rule of Tyranny questions- who said an attack could bypass it?}
{The Dominium Rule of Quintessence asserts that nothing that isn't Quintessential can bypass it!}
{The Extremity of the Protagonist questions whether the attacks directed against you were released by characters of a high enough caliber. In your grand Fable, do they even deserve a few pages?}
{The Extremity of Fables borrows swathes of Existential Extremity Authority.}
{The Extremity of Fable seeks to assert the reality that the enemies before you never held the chance to affect your Fable.}
One Dominium Rule after another was enacted as for Noah, many prompts rose.
For others, they only saw Noah's visage flash with intermittent lights before suddenly, vast arrays of Distortions of reality began to unfold!
A massive purple throne appeared behind him and released a protective light all around.
A Colorless nine pupiled crystal rose up above everyone and began shining its colorless brilliance!

And then, waves of golden brilliance began to show one after another as an illusory golden book formed above, its pages shining as if it were writing a grand Fable as within some of its pages, it was seeking to erase some names!

Everything was filled with tantalizing Existential Extremity Authorities as to top it all off, the one responsible had his wings shining brilliantly as they already connected to an Omniversal Authority- already borrowing its influence.
It was why in the next moment...
BOOM!
A heavy impact of extremes seeking to assert their influence exploded out.
SHAA!
And the dust was cleared within an instant as the pinkish malevolent light around Alderon was repressed around his body.
And the golden light of Domination had its glow stopped and could not proceed within close proximity to Noah and Sona!
It was a shocking scene of defiance as through spamming multiple Dominium Rules that sought to alter reality to his will, Noah actually withstood the attacks of those much more powerful than him!
|Ho?|
And the eyes of Martial King Reperiel twinkled.
|Wow!| Alderon actually clapped his hands as he seemed to find the situation more entertaining!
His intent was about to weave out once more when...
BZZT! His eyes instantly dilated as he contorted his neck to move his head to the right instantly.
Where his head used to be...
SAA!
Was the sharp tip of a sword shining with blazing Psychros that would have frozen his very Dominium.
Behind it, the hands of Sona shone with glorious splendor as somehow, she had almost sniped the head of a Teracosm Stage Entity!
Her dazzling eyes squinted as she began to disappear while her intent weaved out.
|A shame.|
And towards her actions and the sense of danger they actually brought him, Alderon actually became stern while his existence exploded with pink light!
|A shame indeed, you shouldn't have ever come close to me!|
BOOM!
An eruption of even grander waves of existential authority bloomed in a chaotic battlefield where for the first time, Noah was actually standing and fighting against Teracosm Stage Entities!

chapters.title: Chapter 3037 Causality! IV
paragraphs: 3037 Causality! IV
With age came wisdom.
With age came power.
Such weavings...remained true for the most part in life.
They remained true for Martial King Reperiel and Archon Basileus Alderon no matter how twisted either of their characters may be!
A deep smile bloomed on Alderon as he stared at the disappearing figure of Sona while speaking out.
|Dominium Curse.|
HUUM!
A Dominium Rule spread out in a flash.
It tinged the visage of Sona just barely, but this was enough!
Her figure reappeared beside Noah as she instantly stared above, seeing an illusory marking floating above her head with a devilish purple black light.
KA KA KA!

It was a purple flaming obsidian skull that began to bite down and devour any existential authority, a sea of thick obsidian liquid sloshing behind it and crashing down as it sought to encase everything in the Existential Extremity Authority of Curses!
WAA!
Noah's figure instantly appeared above Sona as his hand thrust out, a cluster of Dominium Rules booming out as behind him, a dazzling blue sea of planes of existence formed.
Each one was more dazzling than the last as they carried with them the endless expanse of Infinity!
[Infinity questions the Extemity of Curses- how does its vile authority compare to its endless expanse?]
The cerulean sea of planes of Existences ballooned up to swallow the obsidian purple sea of curses.
It was supported by other Dominium Rules as it trembled with interminable splendor, and between its brilliance...
SAA!
The icy sword of Sona struck out as she uttered while frost leaked from her red lips.
|Glacial Dignity.|
A dignity that froze and shattered all things.
It erupted from the tip of Sona's sword, merging with the endless sea Noah threw out as in the next instant, everything above them shattered into stellar shards of white blue.
The Existential Extremity Authority of Curses was wiped out into oblivion, but in the next moment...
|You youngsters are still wet behind the fuckin ears...|
BOOM!

Martial King Reperiel instantly appeared behind Noah as he swung his hand like a whip, while Archon Basileus Alderon appeared to the left of Sona with his hands forming constant symbols- a pink cloud blooming from him as the Existential Extremity Authority of Carnality erupted!
It was a high paced battle.
One wrong move, one delay in overcoming the extreme of another person, and the whole tide of battle would shift instantly.
One wrong move, and everything could be decided!
At such a moment, Sona's eyes fluttered as her sword instantly turned its tip towards her chest- instantly sinking into her Dominium as in the next instant...
WOO!
A piercing white light bloomed that covered and froze everything.
All bodies were frozen- even Noah's visage included as only moments later did he and Sona begin to get free, but Martial King Reperiel and Archon Basileus Alderon remained frozen!

A heavy and costly Dominium Rule of Psychros was utilized as the brilliance in Sona's eyes was a little dimmer, her hand slowly moving in the frozen space as she yanked the sword tip from her chest and swung it towards Archon Basileus Alderon who still emanated vile pink clouds of existential authority.
Her intent weaved out while she swung her sword down, the illusion of a massive golden sword of Dignity forming behind her as she sought to sever the Dominium of this being!
|Why are all the authorities you release so vile, old thing?|
BOOM!
Her icy sword bathed in golden brilliance was about to smash on the skull of Alderon when in the frozen state, a burst of pinking light erupted as the neck of this entity twisted unnaturally.

And his mouth opened wide as in the next moment, his pristine white teeth clamped down on the descending sword- dense pink shields of existential light covering everything as three Omniversal Authorities expressed their influence above this being simultaneously!
His eyes shone with malice and vile brilliance as he laughed while the sword buzzed in his teeth.

|Haha, I won't lie to you. At my level of power and as eons pass, I've only found myself enjoying eating and fucking- thus, my authorities are geared towards this. Fruits of Existence are the tastiest, and captured Sanctus Princesses and even Omniversal Pillagers...man do you all give me a rush!|
Distasteful words were uttered out as the teeth of this entity but down, and the sword in Sona's hand was shockingly shattered!
WU! WU!
His body then began to pulse with a pinkish purple light that turned into a liquified solid slime like material- tentacles erupting out a moment later.

Sona's gorgeous visage shook its head at such a scene as she released the hilt of her broken sword, her palms coming to meet in front of her chest as dazzling Golden wings of Dignity erupted from her back, the scripture of [S] on her forehead beginning to shine radiantly.
Her bright eyes held utmost distaste as her intent weaved out.
|You're a genuine dirty old man? Shit, you're gonna have to die today.|
|Haha...|
Brilliance unfolded.

Beside Sona, Noah's right hand clashed with the massive hand of Martial King Reperiel as his whole body trembled, a multicolored light beginning to cover him as the brilliance of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed started to spread from him!
He looked into the eyes of the Teracosm Stage Entity right before him as behind his back and on his feet, the Invictus Dominium Wings began to buzz.
He wanted to play with Causality.
The moment this thought arose, his wings began to buzz as he wondered, what thing had the highest probability of happening that he could bring to fruition?
What thing could be brought forward in the next instant to allow some leeway in this heavy battle where their enemies were truly not just some run of the mill extras?!

sentences.text: 3037 Causality!
IV
With age came wisdom.
With age came power.
Such weavings...remained true for the most part in life.
They remained true for Martial King Reperiel and Archon Basileus Alderon no matter how twisted either of their characters may be!
A deep smile bloomed on Alderon as he stared at the disappearing figure of Sona while speaking out.
|Dominium Curse.|
HUUM!
A Dominium Rule spread out in a flash.
It tinged the visage of Sona just barely, but this was enough!
Her figure reappeared beside Noah as she instantly stared above, seeing an illusory marking floating above her head with a devilish purple black light.
KA KA KA!

It was a purple flaming obsidian skull that began to bite down and devour any existential authority, a sea of thick obsidian liquid sloshing behind it and crashing down as it sought to encase everything in the Existential Extremity Authority of Curses!
WAA!
Noah's figure instantly appeared above Sona as his hand thrust out, a cluster of Dominium Rules booming out as behind him, a dazzling blue sea of planes of existence formed.
Each one was more dazzling than the last as they carried with them the endless expanse of Infinity!
[Infinity questions the Extemity of Curses- how does its vile authority compare to its endless expanse?]
The cerulean sea of planes of Existences ballooned up to swallow the obsidian purple sea of curses.
It was supported by other Dominium Rules as it trembled with interminable splendor, and between its brilliance...
SAA!
The icy sword of Sona struck out as she uttered while frost leaked from her red lips.
|Glacial Dignity.|
A dignity that froze and shattered all things.
It erupted from the tip of Sona's sword, merging with the endless sea Noah threw out as in the next instant, everything above them shattered into stellar shards of white blue.
The Existential Extremity Authority of Curses was wiped out into oblivion, but in the next moment...
|You youngsters are still wet behind the fuckin ears...|
BOOM!

Martial King Reperiel instantly appeared behind Noah as he swung his hand like a whip, while Archon Basileus Alderon appeared to the left of Sona with his hands forming constant symbols- a pink cloud blooming from him as the Existential Extremity Authority of Carnality erupted!
It was a high paced battle.
One wrong move, one delay in overcoming the extreme of another person, and the whole tide of battle would shift instantly.
One wrong move, and everything could be decided!
At such a moment, Sona's eyes fluttered as her sword instantly turned its tip towards her chest- instantly sinking into her Dominium as in the next instant...
WOO!
A piercing white light bloomed that covered and froze everything.
All bodies were frozen- even Noah's visage included as only moments later did he and Sona begin to get free, but Martial King Reperiel and Archon Basileus Alderon remained frozen!

A heavy and costly Dominium Rule of Psychros was utilized as the brilliance in Sona's eyes was a little dimmer, her hand slowly moving in the frozen space as she yanked the sword tip from her chest and swung it towards Archon Basileus Alderon who still emanated vile pink clouds of existential authority.
Her intent weaved out while she swung her sword down, the illusion of a massive golden sword of Dignity forming behind her as she sought to sever the Dominium of this being!
|Why are all the authorities you release so vile, old thing?|
BOOM!
Her icy sword bathed in golden brilliance was about to smash on the skull of Alderon when in the frozen state, a burst of pinking light erupted as the neck of this entity twisted unnaturally.

And his mouth opened wide as in the next moment, his pristine white teeth clamped down on the descending sword- dense pink shields of existential light covering everything as three Omniversal Authorities expressed their influence above this being simultaneously!
His eyes shone with malice and vile brilliance as he laughed while the sword buzzed in his teeth.
|Haha, I won't lie to you.
At my level of power and as eons pass, I've only found myself enjoying eating and fucking- thus, my authorities are geared towards this.
Fruits of Existence are the tastiest, and captured Sanctus Princesses and even Omniversal Pillagers...man do you all give me a rush!|
Distasteful words were uttered out as the teeth of this entity but down, and the sword in Sona's hand was shockingly shattered!
WU!
WU!
His body then began to pulse with a pinkish purple light that turned into a liquified solid slime like material- tentacles erupting out a moment later.

Sona's gorgeous visage shook its head at such a scene as she released the hilt of her broken sword, her palms coming to meet in front of her chest as dazzling Golden wings of Dignity erupted from her back, the scripture of [S] on her forehead beginning to shine radiantly.
Her bright eyes held utmost distaste as her intent weaved out.
|You're a genuine dirty old man?
Shit, you're gonna have to die today.|
|Haha...|
Brilliance unfolded.

Beside Sona, Noah's right hand clashed with the massive hand of Martial King Reperiel as his whole body trembled, a multicolored light beginning to cover him as the brilliance of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed started to spread from him!
He looked into the eyes of the Teracosm Stage Entity right before him as behind his back and on his feet, the Invictus Dominium Wings began to buzz.
He wanted to play with Causality.
The moment this thought arose, his wings began to buzz as he wondered, what thing had the highest probability of happening that he could bring to fruition?
What thing could be brought forward in the next instant to allow some leeway in this heavy battle where their enemies were truly not just some run of the mill extras?!
[The Existential Extremity Authority of the Protagonist blares with brilliance and states that no matter how vibrant an extra is, it is still an extra that cannot outshine the Protagonist.]

chapters.title: Chapter 3038 Causality! V
paragraphs: 3038 Causality! V
The battle was an intense one!
While utilizing many of the means available to him, Noah was only able to rebuff against the terrifying enemies as neither were seriously damaged or injured.

In the surroundings, the Teleios Stage Knight Commanders that had survived against the deadly attack from Sona had gathered the Imperium Knight Legion as they now moved in a formation- weaving all of their power together as they also prepared to attack.
And then, there was this Martial King Reperiel before him who...
|Thinking about so many things in the middle of battle, are you? What gives you such confidence, little guy?|
His body blazed gold as his skin entirely took on this color, the Exclusive Existential Extremity Authority of the Imperium fully cascading over his visage.

Layers of the influence of Omniversal Authorities also supported him as he seemed like a staunch and unbeatable golden entity- his hand that was swung like a whip down at Noah bearing down with even greater pressure as Noah's hand holding against it began to vibrate!
[The Existential Extremity Authority of the Body states that even though its Dominium is not here, its extreme remains unfettered and unbroken.]
His own body began to vibrate with a multicolored sheen.
He pondered on the weavings of the Protagonist as his Invictus Dominium Wings began to buzz, Intent on showing how they couldn't be conquered!
But at such a moment, weavings from Sona began to flow into his mind.
|These dirty old fools seem a little more sturdy than they should be, and this battle will take a ridiculously long time even if you start pulling out one or two surprises from here.|
The unbound visage of Sona sent such weavings as Noah replied back succinctly.
|Resources are the things I lack the least as in a prolonged battle, I will always come out on top. But what is the alternative?|
Their intents exchanged within the span of an instant as their enemies were bound to respond in the next moment!
But Sona had already been connected to the weavings of an Omniversal Authority as she laid out a possibility.

|Let's make it as chaotic as possible. Our original plan was to continue on this path towards the Imperium for the twins, but if we change things a little and go towards another place, I know exactly how things can become truly chaotic.|
|Oh?|
Even though they couldn't read facial expressions in this span of an instant, Noah felt like he could see the lips of Sona curve into a smile as she voiced out.

|The next one that is set to join the Initiative. The Omniversal Pillager. They are not alone at this moment and are in a somewhat precarious location and thus I placed them second on the list. But if we go to where they are right now, it would be the perfect stage to erase these dirty old fools. The only issue becomes in getting there as it truly is a vast distance. Do you have any ideas?|
It was as if she knew Noah should have the answer.
But she wasn't too sure as she asked!
Listening to her weavings, Noah's eyes flashed with Quintessence as he looked at multiple probabilities.
And his Wings buzzed even more as within him, the weavings of the Protagonist began to alter their initial path.
A few pieces of the puzzle began to fall as Noah asked lightly.
|What is the precarious location of our target Omniversal Pillager?|
The moment his intent finished, he received the weavings of a place in the distant corner of the endless Omniverse.
Hidden within veils of extremes.
And further veiled with the chaotic weavings of Omniversal Authorities.
A place very few set their feet in as it was within the areas under the control of the Omniversal Pillagers!
|The Nest of Turbidity...are you able to get us there? There will be opportunities amidst the chaos.|
The Nest of Turbidity.
A pocket within the expanse of the Omniverse containing Omniversal Pillagers!
Eventually, Noah and Sona would have made their way there.
And now that this event was brought up in advance, the probability of them being there was even higher.
But was it a high enough probability to distort Existential Causality?
HUUM!
Noah's wings began to buzz in an answer.
A deeply purple hue began to spread as the eyes of Martial King Reperiel became stern, turning to focus on the wings behind Noah's back and feet as his pupils dilated as if he discovered something.
His hand that was swung down began to rise up as at such a time, Noah's own hand clamped down like an unbreakable construct.
Behind him, Sona came and embraced his back with a smile as icy tendrils of light locked onto the obsidian purple tentacles being released from Archon Basileus Alderon, and at such a moment...
WU! WU!

Noah's wings flashed brilliantly as they seemed to cover everything visible to the naked eye, a brilliant light covering not just their four figures...but even the Teleios Stage Knight Legions far away as in an instant, they all disappeared!
Immense silence descended in this region of the Omniverse.
Existential Causality was twisted and distorted in a shocking fashion as Noah forcefully took himself and multiple other parties- willing and unwilling, towards a place even he had never been to!
But he would have eventually been to this place sometime in the future.
So Causality became twisted.
Space, time, existence, and records warped!
Multiple entities were shuttled across the Omniverse amidst a blinding light of purple radiance.
And as soon as this radiance died down, a booming voice echoed out even before any wills could fully ascertain where they were now.
|Haha! An Omniversal Organ! This kid has actually already developed an Omniversal Organ! This ki....!|
The booming intent of Martial King Reperiel came to a halt.
This was because his will had spread out and captured their surroundings.
Amidst the explosion of his voice, multiple titanic eyes shining with terror-inducing radiance became locked onto their figures.
They were the eyes representative of a single group of Entities across the Omniverse.
And among those in this region, three massive ones shimmered with the radiance of the Teracosm Stage!
It was many sets of eyes that landed on Noah and others at this moment- the eyes of Omniversal Pillagers in what was known as the Nest of Turbidity!

chapters.title: Chapter 3039 Little Beast! I
paragraphs: 3039 Little Beast! I
It was a moment of immense silence as if neither side could believe what was currently happening.
Within the Nest of Turbidity, thick obsidian rivers flowed as they only added to the feel of a deluge of heavy and dark Existential Extremity Authority.
There were dozens of Teleios Stage Entities who took the forms of various beastly abominations strewn about, with the central of the Nest of Turbidity having three Entities taking the spotlight.
One was a beast with the head of a squid, but the lower half showed 9 thick and furry obsidian legs fit more so on an Ox.

The other seemed like a massive predatory fish that had a long appendage sticking out of its head, this appendage holding a luminous singularity at its end as it allowed light to shine on Its horrific face and jaws that swirled with thousands of jagged teeth.
The third Entity had the form of a starfish as at its center, there was the face of an exceedingly gorgeous woman!

It was currently staring at them with the same stupor that Martial King Reperiel and Archon Basileus Alderon stared with- a moment after Martial King Reperiel stated with surprise that Noah had formed an Omniversal Organ.
And in such a shocked staredown...
The eyes of Sona who was tightly hugging Noah's back during the teleportation gazed around shiftily as if she was looking for something.
The three terrifying Teracosm Stage Omniversal Pillagers didn't even seem to enter her eyes as after she swirled her head multiple times, her eyes finally came to lock onto a certain spot.
A spot that had no other Omniversal Pillagers, but there was a small round creature that had black and white fur shining with stellar brilliance.
It had two wide eyes and a small mouth, the eyes shining with red-black pupils that shone of innocence and ingenuity!
It seemed to be blinking in surprise right now at what was occurring just as all others, when all of a sudden- Noah's voice rang out as it acted like a scorching spark.
It didn't even originate from him as it seemed to emanate from the mouth of Knight Palmino who was bunched up with other Imperium Knights in this terrible location.
|Our Great Imperium has located the nest of Omniversal Pillagers- we shall eradicate all of them!|
The intent acted akin to a trigger.
The three massive Teracosm Stage Omniversal Pillagers instantly blazed with thick and tenebrous brilliance as roars boomed out!

|Motherfucker!| Archon Basileus Alderon cursed out with distaste as his body erupted within even more purple black tentacles, while Martial King Reperiel came to gaze at Noah's visage...only to see him flashing a devilish smile as his figure disappeared in a hazy Illusory light.
BOOM!
And chaos unfolded right after as heavy bouts of Existential Extremity Authority clashed!
Knight Palmino, Akalusia, and others of the Imperium Legions roared out as a dense number of Teleios Stage Omniversal Pillagers rushed towards them.

And in all this blooming chaos, Noah and Sona's figure retracted the auras of their Dominiums as much as possible as the two of them materialized in front of the little creature Sona had locked her eyes onto.
The moment they appeared, the eyes of this creature widened with curiosity as from these eyes, one couldn't sense even an ounce of fear!
In front of such a creature, Sona smiled as her intent weaved out.
|Hey Little CaCuLaTan!|
She smiled as if she were speaking to a child, and the Little Beast in front of her became surprised and drew closer towards her in an instant.
|Woah! Big Sis, how do you know my name? Nobody knows that!|
|Don't worry about that. Say, Little Beast, do you want to eat up everything here?|

In the midst of blooming chaos behind them, and other auras locking onto them in the surroundings, Noah watched with sharp eyes as Sona actually picked up the Little Beast and rubbed its fur as if it were the most normal thing in existence.
The Little Beast even seemed to like this as it smiled sheepishly while shaking its round body.
|I want to, but it will never end well if I do, it's so sad Big Sis.|

Its big eyes turned down to express its sadness at not being able to eat and devour everything as towards this, Sona raised the Little Beast in her hands directly in front of her face as she spoke seriously.
|Mmm, but what if I help you? You can eat up them, them, and all of them too.|
As she spoke, she pointed her face towards Martial King Reperiel and Archon Basileus Alderon, towards the three Teracosm Stage Omniversal Pillagers, and all others in the surroundings!
Hearing such a proposition, the eyes of the Little Beast shone with a sense of excitement.
|You'd do that, Big Sis?|

|Yep, and the only thing you have to do is listen to me and this Big Boss here...| Sona pointed towards Noah behind her as the Little Beast looked towards him and nodded while bouncing around happily.
|Okay! Okay!|
|Mmm, good. Now, my foundation will not be as compatible with you as the Big Boss here, so why don't you join up with him and begin eating things up?|
She took the Little Beast in her hands and pointed it towards Noah as the two of them stared at each other.

Noah's senses were quaint as he could sense a terrifying amount of authority and mystery on the tiny creature, and the Weavings of Sona flowed into his mind a moment later as she held this beast towards him like a present.
|The third member of our Initiative. You're probably much more compatible with this little thing so...have a go with it.|
A simple proposition.
One that Noah knew wasn't so simple as his weavings were buzzing while looking at this creature!
Through these weavings, he began to see a glorious pathway form as his hand reached out, the bouncing fur ball in front of him shaking with even more excitement as it flew toward his right hand.
Its round structure then instantly warped and became as pointy as a needle, sinking into Noah's palm and disappearing into his hand entirely!
[The temporary fusion with an unknown Omniversal Existential Parasite has begun!]

chapters.title: Chapter 3040 Little Beast! II
paragraphs: 3040 Little Beast! II

Sona gazed at the scene before her carefully while Dignity began to blaze around her akin to flames- actually attracting the eyes and wills of the Teleios Stage Entities nearby, and those who were hiding close to them ready to sneak attack them also became visible.
She let out this small brightness at this moment because they had to get a grasp of just how terrifying the Little Beast would be- especially if it was fused with someone else who wasn't her.
When she had fused with the Little Beast before, its physiology was much more complex than the current her as she couldn't utilize it with great efficiency.
After all, at this point, she had only achieved the Teracosm Stage and wasn't even at its peak.
Her Dominium Soul was the strongest, with her Body being much weaker as its complexity was much less.

During the fusion with the Little Beast in the possible future weavings she observed, her whole body would bulk up in size to accommodate the complex weaving, her skin turning tenebrous and tout as the limbs the Little Beast used to initially fuse with her body turned into an amalgamation of thousands of tentacles.
These tentacles moved to latch onto and devour anything they came across as much of Sona's beauty and grace was taken away during the fusion!

Over time, the transformation wouldn't be as drastic as within the possible weavings she saw over time while she became stronger, she became less susceptible to changes on her own weavings and existence until the only change that occurred was her fair skin turning a caramel color.
Noah's foundation should be much different compared to the current her as how drastic of a change would he exhibit initially?
She watched expectantly.
And she continued to watch.
But...why wasn't the man before her undergoing any change at all?

The Lineage of the Existential Omniversal Emperor!
|Woah!|

|Big Boss, why is everything in here so sturdy? Why is-Woah!|

[Your Invictus Dominium Wings grant passage after analyzing the Source of the Unknown Omniversal Existential Parasite.]

[The capability of Omniversal Absolute Eater can now be expressed through your right hand by communicating with Little CaCuLaTan.]

WAP!
The tentacles retracted while miniaturizing and swallowing everything it had touched!
Out of all the Teleios Stage Omniversal Pillagers targeting them nearby, none could be seen anymore.
And within Noah, waves of authority and Prompts exploded!
