chapters.title: Chapter 3041 Catalyst! I
paragraphs: It was a scene of utmost horror.

His body was becoming ever radiant akin to a seething engine, and his raised right hand shot out thousands of tentacles at shocking speeds that bypassed the Dominiums of Teleios Stage Omniversal Pillagers before dragging them all onto his open palm!
Massive creatures with tentacles, segmented bodies, and other variations of monstrosities all found their bodies becoming smaller while disappearing within Noah's palm.
And once they were in it...
CRACKLE!
A force of absolute authority began to break them down as their Dominiums cracked and splintered within that same instant.
{Any Entity Unable to resist or overcome the pull of the Omniversal Absolute Eater will have the weavings of their Records, Extremes, and Existence devoured within the span of an instant.}
{59 Teleios Stage Entities have been devoured and broken down by Omniversal Absolute Eater.}
{The Omniversal Authority of Gulosity has been triggered by the catalyst that is CaCuLaTan.}
{CaCuLaTan is a unique Parasite that has received the recognition of the Omniversal Authority of Gulosity!}
A shocking development.
Noah's eyes blinked a few times to make sure he was Seeing things right, but truly...he had just come across his first named Omniversal Authority.
The Omniversal Authority of Gulosity!

Above Noah, a blinding crimson pillar of illusory shot down and focused on his right hand, causing the weavings of existence to distort and bend as Noah did not consciously call upon this Omniversal Authority!
To call upon Omniversal Authorities, one had to utilize the very power and authority of their Existential Dominium as it was taxing.

It required a great deal of resources and it strained one as they merged the weavings of their Extremes to the complex computations of hundreds or thousands of Existential Extremity Authorities within an Omniversal Authority.

So having an Omniversal Authority flow down and grant its heavy influence out of its own volition...was something that only truly powerful entities who were recognized by Omniversal Authorities due to their extremes and existence were capable of doing!
The Little Beast...was actually one such entity.
HUUM!
The beam of crimson light illuminated Noah's hand as it pulsed a moment later, untold waves of pure authority from all the devoured Teleios Stage Entities instantly becoming magnified as...
{The Omniversal Authority of Gulosity imposes its influence on the devoured nutrients.}
{The entirety of existence of all 59 Nutrients and all records they had achieved over their lifetimes have been elevated by a factor of 3.}
{In equal parts the existence of all devoured Nutrients will be sublimated Into the Dominiums of the Host and Parasite.}
The usage of the Omniversal Parasite showed itself.
It could quickly devour powerful entities, and with the influence of an Omniversal Authority of Gulosity, it actually amplified the existence of all those devoured by a factor of three!
In totality, Noah would get 150% while the Little Beast would also obtain 150% of the existence of those devoured.
And just as this authority was about to spread within Noah and Little CaCuLaTan...
WU!
{The Authorities of Loot and Quintessence shine on the devoured light of existence.}
Noah's extremes began to surge.
{The already amplified devoured nutrients have been amplified by a factor of 2!}
59 Teleios Stage Omniversal Pillagers were devoured.
But after everything was over and done, it was akin to devouring 354 Teleios Stage Entities divided between Noah and Little CaCuLaTan!

Within the span of an instant, the tendrils of Little CaCuLaTan merged with Noah's cells and spread this dense concentration of nutrients, Noah's Invictus Dominium Wings blazing heavily as visible to the naked eye...they enlarged in size just a little.
And on the surface of the gorgeously purple Invictus Dominium Wings, intricate and unknown scriptures began to form.
And the aura surrounding Noah...became immeasurably deeper.
|Wow! Big Boss, we should eat up more! We seem to be really good at eating...|

In a voice akin to being in a drunken stupor, the voice of Little CaCuLaTan rang out in Noah's mind as beside him, Sona was nodding with a thoughtful look while gazing in the distance where a chaotic battle was blooming between the two Teracosm Stage Imperium Martial Kings and three Teracosm Stage Omniversal Pillagers- and the heavy fight of the scattered Imperium Legions in the surroundings!
|Alright, the weavings of possible futures are aligning with a little bit more favor...so let's erase some disgusting old men from existence.|
HUUM!
Her eyes blazed with brilliance.
Even though she didn't show it, she heavily disliked the comments and actions of the Archon Basileus Alderon towards her!
Her hands began to buzz with brilliance as Psychros gathered to form a dazzling icy sword, her left hand shining with a brilliant golden light as a blazing sword of golden Dignity formed within it.

Beside her, Noah's wings buzzed as they were about to join the chaotic battle ahead when at this time, the wily visage of Archon Basileus Alderon gazed towards their direction with sharp eyes as he rebuffed the massive starfish shaped Omniversal Pillager- his intent then booming out all around.

|Those Youngsters over there are our enemies who brought us all here to cause chaos- likely waiting for a chance where us two or you three are exhausted or killing each other before they reap the rewards. Why don't we kill them first, and then we can continue this battle?|
Sona's pupils dilated.
Why was this disgusting old man so good?
The wills of the three Teracosm Stage Omniversal Pillagers pulsed as these entities were not foolish ones, their gazes beginning to turn this way as before anything else could progress...
SHING!
Wings flapped.

And the glorious visage of Noah appeared behind the thick scale like exterior of the massive starfish that had the face of an exceedingly gorgeous woman at its center, his hands holding a multicolored spear that carried the brilliance of none other than the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed and the force of his own foundation that was under the catalyst that was Little CaCuLaTan!
BOOM!
An impact that even caused the ears of the Teracosm Stage Entities to buzz resounded...along with the intent of the Weaver of Extremity meant to continue to muddy the waters.
|You're right, Archon Basileus Alderon...these insects will believe anything.|
Words to implicate them and place them in the same camp.
UUU!
Along with it, the roar of Omniversal Pillager reverberated out!

chapters.title: Chapter 3042 Catalyst! II
paragraphs: Omniversal Pillagers.
It was a unique distinction that was given to Entities that many believed to have originated outside of the Omniverse.

There were also just as many beings who believed that the Omniversal Pillagers were born within the weavings of the endless Omniverse, and that apart from this Omniverse, there could be nothing else out there.
But the one unique thing was the fact that the Omniversal Pillagers thrived on devouring Existential Domains and the Dominiums of others.
And due to this or a variety of other factors, Omniversal Pillagers were capable of influencing and connecting to Omniversal Authorities much faster and more efficiently!
Their bodies were normally massive in size and took on monstrous forms, with the regions they inhabited being where most instability resided.
Their attacks were random and with out any set strategy, with there being immense fear towards any Leader that may be controlling the Omniversal Pillagers!
If placed side by side and compared to other lifeforms across existence, it was ascertained that Omniversal Pillagers were more powerful and much harder to kill.
Noah found out about this truth firsthand.
BOOM!

The entire weight...and weavings of multiple Existential Extremity Authorities that the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed had elevated- all of this smashed onto the posterior of the murky obsidian purple starfish with a woman's face, and yet all it did was shatter a thick veil of the Existential Extremity Authority of Digestion.

And just as his spear was about to pierce until its jelly like skin, he had to pull it back as the weavings of Digestion returned and even flourished around this Entity, backed by an Omniversal Authority as it was trying to gnaw and eat up the dazzling spear in his hands!

No single Teracosm Stage Entity was easy to defeat and destroy, this reality being affirmed again and again as right after his attack, Noah was faced with the eruption of trillions of miniature starfish shaped obsidian singularities gushing from the back of the Omniversal Pillager.
It was filled with a heavy extreme that wanted to break down and digest everything!
But towards such a terrifying authority...
|Omniversal Absolute Eater|
HUUM!

Noah thrust his right hand out as his palm opened a smiling mouth with stellar white teeth, the jaws opening wide and acting akin to a funnel that drew in and devoured all of the incoming trillions of miniature starfish singularities!
And such a reality continued to unfold until all of this tenebrous authority was pulled into Noah's palm.
{A dense convergence of Existential Extremity Authority has been devoured and broken down by Omniversal Absolute Eater.}
{The Omniversal Authority of Gulosity has been triggered by the catalyst that is CaCuLaTan.}
{The devoured authority has been elevated by a factor of 5 and has begun to spread across your existence to refill the Reserves of all possible authorities!}
WU!
Noah's visage felt like it was getting full.
His Invictus Dominium Wings buzzed as a decent amount of their authority continued to be refilled!

Noah observed all of this while also looking at the constantly changing battlefield- observing the figure of Sona appearing near Martial King Reperiel and attacking the squid like Omniversal Pillager opposite it as if she was giving reinforcement to the Imperium forces.
In all this, both sides threw heavy attacks and went all out as in battles with Teracosm Stage Entities, things could change within the span of an instant!
Noah didn't like such a flow of events as he once more turned towards his Invictus Dominium Wings.
He wanted to see whether he could bring forth the Existential Causality of death.
He wanted to know whether there was a high enough probability of the Teracosm Stage Entities here dying, and if he could bring this event forward to occur right now!
So his Invictus Dominium Wings began to buzz.
And he looked at Martial King Reperiel and Archon Basileus Alderon.
...neither of the two had an extremely high probability of death in the near future that Noah could alter the Causality of!
It was a ridiculous reality as these two old men were truly powerful, with Noah turning his gaze towards the Omniversal Pillagers to see where there was a high enough probability of their death.
His Wings shone brightly and reflected a similar red light he saw on Reperiel and Archon Basileus Alderon, and he saw the same light on the squid like Omniversal Pillager, and...
|Oh?|
His eyes brightened up.
The Fish like Omniversal Pillager that had an appendage with a radiant singularity at its head shone with a green light.
Whether through him or Sona, or the two Imperium Martial Kings currently in the field- it actually made it so that this creature had the highest probability of death in the very near future!
The one to die first.
Noah nodded at such a probability as he spoke lightly.
|Let me just...bring your death forward a little earlier.|
HUUUM!
He could sense that it would cost a great deal.
To the extent that even with Little CaCuLaTan catalyzing his processes and granting him immense waves of authority, he would be drained entirely!
Even the conditions of allowing it to happen by bringing all parties here were rare.
But since it held a high probability, he could affect its Causality!
If he could successfully pull it off, it would mean he would manage to kill a Teracosm Stage Entity himself...by altering Existential Causality.
WAA!
His Wings shone with astounding radiance and enlarged upwards.
The eyes of all Teracosm Stage Entities were drawn to such brightness as at this point, the means of the Invictus Dominium Wings could not be stopped.
They could only unfold!
{You seek to affect a unique Existential Causality with the Invictus Dominium Wings.}
{An Existential Causality of Death.}

{When affecting Existential Causality to bring about the death of an Entity in advance, an extra cost can be paid to cause the altered Existential Causality to unfold in unique ways known as Existential Invictus Fatalities.}

{A dense convergence of Existential Extremity Authority has been devoured and broken down by Omniversal Absolute Eater.}
{The Omniversal Authority of Gulosity has been triggered by the catalyst that is CaCuLaTan.}
{The devoured authority has been elevated by a factor of 5 and has begun to spread across your existence to refill the Reserves of all possible authorities!}
WU!
Noah's visage felt like it was getting full.
His Invictus Dominium Wings buzzed as a decent amount of their authority continued to be refilled!

Noah observed all of this while also looking at the constantly changing battlefield- observing the figure of Sona appearing near Martial King Reperiel and attacking the squid like Omniversal Pillager opposite it as if she was giving reinforcement to the Imperium forces.
In all this, both sides threw heavy attacks and went all out as in battles with Teracosm Stage Entities, things could change within the span of an instant!
Noah didn't like such a flow of events as he once more turned towards his Invictus Dominium Wings.
He wanted to see whether he could bring forth the Existential Causality of death.
He wanted to know whether there was a high enough probability of the Teracosm Stage Entities here dying, and if he could bring this event forward to occur right now!
So his Invictus Dominium Wings began to buzz.
And he looked at Martial King Reperiel and Archon Basileus Alderon.
...neither of the two had an extremely high probability of death in the near future that Noah could alter the Causality of!
It was a ridiculous reality as these two old men were truly powerful, with Noah turning his gaze towards the Omniversal Pillagers to see where there was a high enough probability of their death.
His Wings shone brightly and reflected a similar red light he saw on Reperiel and Archon Basileus Alderon, and he saw the same light on the squid like Omniversal Pillager, and...
|Oh?|
His eyes brightened up.
The Fish like Omniversal Pillager that had an appendage with a radiant singularity at its head shone with a green light.
Whether through him or Sona, or the two Imperium Martial Kings currently in the field- it actually made it so that this creature had the highest probability of death in the very near future!
The one to die first.
Noah nodded at such a probability as he spoke lightly.
|Let me just...bring your death forward a little earlier.|
HUUUM!
He could sense that it would cost a great deal.
To the extent that even with Little CaCuLaTan catalyzing his processes and granting him immense waves of authority, he would be drained entirely!
Even the conditions of allowing it to happen by bringing all parties here were rare.
But since it held a high probability, he could affect its Causality!
If he could successfully pull it off, it would mean he would manage to kill a Teracosm Stage Entity himself...by altering Existential Causality.
WAA!
His Wings shone with astounding radiance and enlarged upwards.
The eyes of all Teracosm Stage Entities were drawn to such brightness as at this point, the means of the Invictus Dominium Wings could not be stopped.
They could only unfold!
{You seek to affect a unique Existential Causality with the Invictus Dominium Wings.}
{An Existential Causality of Death.}

{When affecting Existential Causality to bring about the death of an Entity in advance, an extra cost can be paid to cause the altered Existential Causality to unfold in unique ways known as Existential Invictus Fatalities.}

chapters.title: Chapter 3043 Fatality! I
paragraphs: A unique reality presented itself with the latest usage of the Invictus Dominium Wings- with the alteration of Existential Causality that brought about the death of lifeforms paving the way for something unique.
Existential Invictus Fatalities.
{Any Existential Causality that finishes with a Fatality will have its subsequent Loot increased by a factor of 2.}
{Currently, two Existential Invictus Fatalities are available- the Severing Box of Mercy and the Infinite Blades of Quintessence.}
A unique world of possibilities opened as with a glimmer of brilliance, Noah uttered out.
|The Infinite Blades of Quintessence.|
HUUM!
The wings on his feet and back buzzed.

Among the wills of the multiple Teracosm Stage Entities here, the Fish like Omniversal Pillager with a bright appendage felt its Dominium constrict as an infallible and undeniable sense of death made its descent.
{The Existential Causality of Death has been brought forward for Rhynchactis Desmond.}
...! The name of the Omniversal Pillager was uttered as along with it, a brilliant colorless and blue hue began to blaze above it.
{The Existential Invictus Fatality of Infinite Blades of Quintessence has been deemed for Rhynchactis Desmond!}
He wasn't directly attacking it.
He didn't exceed its defensive parameters or overcome its Existential Extremity Authorities backed by Omniversal Authorities.
He was simply bringing forward an action with the highest probability that was bound to happen in the future.
He was simply playing with cause and effect.
With Existential Causality!
Such a power caused Noah to take a brief moment of reflection on the terrifying capabilities that Entities could have out there.
And the reason for his...was the Omniversal Organ that was born from his own unique pathway that he forged with his Dominium.
His Invictus Dominium Wings that called for one to be undefeated and Unconquerable made it possible!
And after his brief reflection, he saw the dazzling scene of the first Fatality unfold.
It all happened within the span of an instant as nobody could alter its result!
In the distance, the eyes of Sona shone brightly as she and all others observed.
A dazzling blue sword twice as big as the Rhynchactis appeared, swinging down from above akin to an undeniable sword of judgment!
WU!
The Rhynchactis bellowed out as Existential Extremity Authorities and the Influence of Omniversal Authorities gathered around it, but...
SHIING!
The sword swung down and ignored all of these Authorities as if they didn't exist.
After all, it wasn't an attack against Authorities.
It was simply a future being brought forward in advance!
In a shocking unfolding of reality, the head of the Rhynchactis was cleanly bisected.
It didn't seem real.
It didn't seem feasible.
But the massive head of the Rhynchactis Was operated from its head and pulled down below- where a dazzling colorless singularity suddenly bloomed as the head was pulled into it and disappeared!

Thereafter, thousands of massive blue blades appeared around the remaining fish like body of the Rhynchactis and chopped down with fervor, bisecting all parts of its body constantly as if this Entity was on a platter!
SAA! SAA! SAA!

The blades didn't stop chopping until its body turned into slivers of meat, and they continued further until everything about its body and Dominium turned into shimmering blobs of blood that exploded a moment later.
And everything contained within this explosion redirected itself towards the man responsible, his right hand thrust out as jaws opened on his palm and devoured everything.
Everything that used to be a Teracosm Stage Omniversal Pillager!
And uniquely, his left hand was also thrust out...a colorless singularity blooming around it as the bisected head of the Rhynchactis that had disappeared could now be seen in his hand!
He grasped on the cylindrical appendage leading to the glowing light on this Entity...that at this time had turned entirely dim.
Noah floated there, holding the decapitated head of a Teracosm Stage Entity as if he were a grand champion that had claimed his victory!
The Archon Basileus Alderon and Martial King Reperiel stared at him with eyes showing disbelief.
The starfish and squid shaped Omniversal Pillagers stared at him blankly as if they couldn't believe what had just occurred.
Undoubtedly, all eyes on this chaotic battlefield turned towards Noah!
But he wasn't the least bit afraid.
Because power-ups during battles were where he was Quintessential at.

And the death of a Teracosm Stage Entity that he would now devour and even amplify its existence he would assimilate with Little CaCuLaTan...this would grant a boost that nobody on this battlefield but him understood!
It would make it so that he would no longer be on par or even struggling against these Teracosm Stage Entities before him!
At least, these were the weavings of his thoughts.
With the Fatality completed, tentacles erupted from his right hand and swallowed the massive head he was holding onto entirely, prompts beginning to bloom as many eyes remained on him.
{A Quintessential Achievement!}
{The Existential Invictus Fatality of the Infinite Blades of Quintessence was successfully brought to fruition!}

Prompts had begun to flourish while Little CaCuLaTan and his own existence began to tremble with interminable fervor, but at the same time, the roars of Omniversal Pillagers rang out as alongside Martial King Reperiel and Archon Basileus Alderon...the blazing auras of four Teracosm Stage Entities instantly abandoned everything and surged towards him alone!
The moment this occurred, a sigh was heard as the visage of Sona appeared in front of Noah.
|You know how to become the center of attention...|
As she spoke, her adornments began to burn as an entirely flaming icy white battledress bloomed on her body.
She seemed to have thought about something deep as she felt the blazing auras of four Teracosm Stage Entities coming in from behind, and she moved forward while her intent weaved out.
|Hold on to something for me real quick.|
She came in front of Noah with a sense of decisiveness and determination, taking his right hand and bringing it towards her chest.
|Be delicate with it.|
With such words, she took his hand and pierced her own chest, bringing it towards her beating heart!

chapters.title: Chapter 3044 Fatality! II
paragraphs: 3044 Fatality! II
His hand pierced her chest, right between her blessed breasts as it was leaning more towards the left side.
The flaming white battle dress blazed with icy light around her as Noah squinted his eyes while locking onto the pupils of Sona.

Seeing four Teracosm Stage Entities surging towards him after he inexplicably eradicated one, she likely thought he was in a precarious situation as she forced herself to resort to something that could overcome this.
She led his hand towards her beating heart, her intent moving to have his hand wrap around it before...
SQUELCH!
She rapidly pulled her body backward.
And Noah's hand contained in it...a heart.
It was pure gold in color, seeming like a crystalline heart shaded with a beautiful halcyon Luster.

The veins and arteries connecting it to the rest of the body seemed cleanly cleaved off, with the chest of Sona closing up and healing right away as right after, a terrifying aura began to build around her.
|I've given you my heart.|
She spoke succinctly as her eyes blazed with golden, verdant, and icy blue lights.
Her visage was so gorgeous and vulnerable at this moment as if she lay naked before Noah's eyes!
|Please...do not hurt me.|
BOOM!
With these words, Authorities surrounding Sona and all around turned utterly wild.
A beam of cerulean Omniversal Authority twisted space and came to cover her entirely, her pupils entirely disappearing as her eyes became icy white!

And from her body, waves of immeasurable frost instantly erupted to cover everything within the Nest of Turbidity- even the figures of the four rushing Teracosm Stage Entities and the remaining Imperium Legions battling with Teleios Stage Omniversal Pillagers.
Everything became frozen!
Regardless of what it was, it was all frozen.
On her forehead, the ecriture of S blazed into blue flames as an aurora of two pairs of butterfly-like wings unfurled from Sona's back.
Two icy blue blades burning with icy flames appeared in her hands, her gaze becoming increasingly apathetic as this being...moved without a heart!
And her gaze turned towards the four incoming frozen Teracosm Stage Entities whose bodies had already begun to buzz and free themselves...and she shot towards them like a freed bullet.
Even Noah was surprised at the progression of events as he looked at the glistening golden heart in his hand, unique weavings rising in front of him in the form of prompts.
[You have been granted the authority to grasp the Omniversal Organ- the Existential Fidelis Dominium Heart.]
WAA!
[The Fidelis Dominium Heart is extremely delicate, with the low pressure of unknown scale being capable of crushing it in the case it is not properly protected.]
[By obtaining the Fidelis Dominium Heart, you have lifted the restrictions and limitations of its owner.]

[If you so choose to devour the Fidelis Dominium Heart, you will attain authority potent enough to allow you to scale past the Teracosm Stage, attain the recognition of Greater Omniversal Authority, and form a random Omniversal Organ within your body.]
|Fucking hell...| Noah could help but gaze at the figure of Sona that had given him such an object!
Who could she trust to ever give such a thing to hold?
Were it anyone else but Noah, he didn't doubt they would devour it right away for the things it promised.
Along with all of this...were Restrictions and Limitations.
Some beings took such concepts towards utterly ridiculous levels.
The Omniversal Organ in Noah's hand actually acted as a limiter, and now that it was released...just how terrifying had Sona become?
Noah had this future weaving to understand.
But while holding onto a ridiculously delicate Omniversal Organ, there was also a vast array of prompts raining down because of the existence of a Teracosm Stage Entity he just devoured.
So his eyes flashed as he took the golden heart in his hands and placed it towards his own chest, a brilliant light releasing from him as it carefully took this heart into Noah's Dominium Soul!
Then, he gazed at the shocking changes about to unfold within him in this small period where everything was frozen by Sona.
[The Entity granted death through Existential Causality did not have their Existence Analyzed, and thus, no Illusory Weaving was created.]

[The devoured and amplified Existence of Rhynchactis through the Existential Invictus Fatality of Infinite Blades of Quintessence, and further amplification by the boons of Little CaCuLaTan, is being analyzed and assimilated into your Dominium concurrently in order to bring to fruition its Illusory Weavings.]

[Because the Analysis is occurring on the amplified Existence of Rhynchactis, the Illusory Weaving born will be of this quality Of existence, and not the lesser quality of the original Rhynchactis itself.]
A bonus reality came as Noah felt a terrifying Illusory Weaving forming within his Dominium!
His Dominium that at this moment was akin to a dried sea.
Starved of any authority after what he had just done!
And yet sensing the unbounded excitement of Little CaCuLaTan and its connections with his Dominium, his Dominium wasn't going to be dry for much longer.
BOOM!
[The amplified Existence of Rhynchactis is being assimilated into your Dominium.]
Little CaCuLaTan amplified the Existence, and then Loot supported by all his other extremes further amplified the devoured existence.
The Invictus Dominium Wings shone brilliantly, the color purple becoming even denser as from this organ...tendrils of purple light began to bloom.
Tendrils that...caused space to twist and distort as they seemed to be pulling upon Omniversal Authorities!
[The amplified Existence, Dominium, Records...all the weavings of a Teracosm Stage Entity are being assimilated into your Dominium as you rapidly scale across the Invictus Stage.]
[The Existential Omniversal Organ has advanced even further.]
[The Invictus Dominium Wings reach out towards the endless Omniverse for the recognition of an Omniversal Authority.]
WAA!
Those in the Existential Dominium Realm traversed across multiple stages.
At the Teleios Stage and Teracosm, some may begin to pull upon and influence Omniversal Authorities to aid the power of their existence and Extremes.
Very rarely...
There were those who had the recognition of an Omniversal Authority.
They didn't need to exhaust their Dominium to call upon an Omniversal Authority.
They always had it by their side!
At this moment, Noah's Omniversal Organ advanced ever further from the fuel of a Teracosm Stage Entity and spread out tendrils of light to attain the recognition of an Omniversal Authority!

chapters.title: Chapter 3045 A Little Broken I
paragraphs: 3045 A Little Broken I
Obscene.
This was how the Authority and power of others could be.
Something even more obscene in the Existential Dominium Realm was one's link to Omniversal Authorities!
Some people knew much more than others regarding how unique this link could be, with Sona being among those who were very knowledgeable.
As she arrived before the frozen bodies of Teracosm Stage Entities, her Will caught onto the glorious scene of Noah's Omniversal Organ radiating tendrils of light upwards.
Tendrils of light that were seeking to pull on Omniversal Authority!
This was the man she had just given her heart to.
Her own Omniversal Organ!
Since she gave it away, not once did she look back to observe whether Noah had a sense of greed that won when he looked at her golden heart.
After all, eating it granted one shocking boons!
Even though Weavings told her he wasn't like that, could one ever be entirely sure?
At the depths of her heart, a small part of her asked what if?
But no.
She could feel her heart entirely safe this whole time.
'Very well.'
Her thoughts were linear and without blemishes.
'I'll put in my all.'
HUUM!
She instantly arrived before the figure of Archon Basileus Alderon who had just managed to free 90% of his body when both the icy sword in her hands swung down.
|OOH!|
Alderon bellowed out grandly as the Existential Extremity Authority of Lust erupted with a protective pink cloud of light, but the force Sona wielded currently was too powerful!
Waves of Psychros emanated in waves all around her as they slowed down even the circulation and utilization of Authorities!
The cloud of pink barely formed.
SAA!
The two icy swords swung down and cut through the heavy golden Teracosm Dominium barrier, freezing everything it touched!
|VILE!|
BOOM!
A singularity of glacial impacts bloomed right after as shockingly, a half frozen visage of Archon Basileus Alderon with his body cut into three pieces could now be seen.
His expression was one of shock and a sense of fear as horrifically, a grievous injury now coursed across his Dominium!
Who was he?
How many eons worth of accumulation of Fruits of Existence and power did he have?
He was a notch above any Teracosm Stage Entities out there as only Martial King Reperiel came close to his capabilities!
For him to be hurt so greatly by a young bitch like this?!
To the point he felt fear and all his Authorities were currently frozen as her sword came down again?!
|OUTRAGEOUS!|
His anger allowed his Lust to burn.
But even that wasn't fast enough.
The freezing swords of Sona came to irreversibly damage his Dominium once more as his Authorities weren't reacting!
|Vile creatures like you deserve to die in even worse ways.|
The intent of Sona blazed around and descended with her sword as true trepidation dawned on Archon Basileus Alderon.
But in this period of peril...
|HO!|
A golden bastion of light came down to block the deathly sword.
The visage of his old friend appeared, Reperiel intervening as even with his intervention...
BOOM!
The golden Bastion of the Imperium was shattered.
Reperiel was pushed back while holding onto the injured visage of Archon Basileus Alderon, the Authority of Omniversal Authorities surging around them as these two old men stared at their opponent.
A beam of cerulean Omniversal Authority was constantly cascading around her freely as this was one of the main reasons her extremes seemed unstoppable right now.
The influence of a Greater Omniversal Authority!

The fear and trepidation within Archon Basileus Alderon slightly eased with his friend by his side as his heavily injured Dominium rejoined itself, both of them becoming extremely serious as they knew at this moment, they were fighting for their lives.
They had come across too terrifying of an anomaly in their search for Noah Osmont!
And just as things seemed so supremely dark with the relentless visage of a gorgeous woman bathed in an icy light surging towards them without fear...
WU!
Her figure was stopped once more as she pointed her swords left and right.
The pointed tip of the massive body of the starfish shaped Omniversal Pillager was on one side, and one of the many limbs of the squid like Omniversal Pillager was on the other.

All four Teracosm Stage Entities had broken out of the frozen world of ice as after Sona heavily injured one and was about to kill him, another came to defend him as now...even the two Omniversal Pillagers attacked her to stop her advancement!
|Martial Kings of the Imperium and Omniversal Pillagers working together...what a day this is.|
The Intent of Sona vibrated out, supported by the influence of a heavy Omniversal Authority.
|As one!|
|As one!|

Around her, Four Teracosm Stage Entities did not want to be killed off one after another- and they sought to work together to quickly eliminate at least the threat of Sona as far from them, their wills still looked with worry towards the man who had already killed one of them!
They had to be fast!
HUUM!
Existential Extremity Authorities with the support of Omniversal Authorities blazed and bloomed forth.
But yes.
Sona was not alone.

In the midst of his elevation and assimilation of a Teracosm Stage Entity, Noah felt his Invictus Dominium Wings pulse with enrichment and fulfillment as the Reserves of their authority were filled to the brim!
So he gazed at Sona being ganged up on as he asked.
|Is there a high enough probability of death now?|
Reality had changed.
Sona unveiled tremendous power to nearly kill another Teracosm Stage Entity as in the coming future...was his death sealed?
Could Noah bring its Causality forward just a little bit faster?
Towards his question...
HUUM!
Noah smiled as he saw a bright green light.
It hung above the figure of the injured Archon Basileus Alderon like a blade of death.
It was his Invictus Dominium Wings telling him that in the near future, there was a high probability of death for the vile creature known as Archon Basileus Alderon!
Now, he could just distort Causality to bring it forward.
The only question was...what Existential Invictus Fatality did this disgusting old man deserve?

Her own Omniversal Organ!

She could feel her heart entirely safe this whole time.
'Very well.'
Her thoughts were linear and without blemishes.

chapters.title: Chapter 3046 A Little Broken II
paragraphs: 3046 A Little Broken II
Of the two available Existential Invictus Fatalities to choose from, which one was best?
The moment this question arose, Noah's wings buzzed right after while they radiated even more massive tendrils of purple light.
[The Invictus Dominium Wings have scaled vast stretches of the Dominium Skies as even now, their transformation is ongoing.]
[New Existential Invictus Fatalities have been added whenever affecting the Existential Causality of Death.]
[The Existential Invictus Fatalities of Gang of Tyranny, the Coffin of Chronos, the Quintessential Iron Maiden, and Fire Starter have been added as those available to use.]
The amplified Existence of a Teracosm Stage Entity was not for show.
Their weavings flowed into Noah's Dominiums and powered up his extremes alongside it, every part of his potential and power being expanded as he wasn't alone in this!
Even as he was focusing on the prompts of the task at hand regarding the Existential Invictus Fatalities, there were other prompts he was receiving relating to Little CaCuLaTan.
[For the first time, Little CaCuLaTanis devouring the amplified Existence of a Teracosm Stage Entity.]
[Little CaCuLaTan had begun its metamorphosis towards a Teracosm Stage Dominium.]
The third member of the Initiative.
Its existence was a unique one as it was benefitting itself just as much as it was benefitting Noah.
But Noah filtered out of these prompts and others to focus on the buzzing of his Wings and how they could alter Causality.
|Let's bring forth the set death of this great Archon Basileus...|
It was akin to a snowball effect.
The first death of a Teracosm Stage Omniversal Pillager allowed for the next death, and after the death of Alderon...
would that not make it even more likely that the remaining three Teracosm Stage Entities would have a high chance of meeting an early end?
It was a terrifying reality.
Even Noah clicked his lips at such an obscene capability!

His intent weaved out as he communicated with his Wings, sensing the obscene amounts of authority he had to spend on someone as powerful as Archon Basileus Alderon as even with his elevated Dominium and Invictus Dominium Wings he would have 30% of his authority remaining after this!
But the cost was paid.

Amidst the worried gazes of four Teracosm Stage Entities surrounding Sona who constantly had Noah under watch, they observed the wings on his feet and back shine again before their light flashed to eclipse the whole Nest of Turbidity.
|OOH!|
And each of them bellowed out with their own Authorities as they all understood the power of a developed Omniversal Organ- and how hard it was to defend against it!
They had just seen what happened to the Rhynchactis- they didn't want to be the next Entity to go through that!
But...
[The Existential Causality of Death has been brought forward for Archon Basileus Alderon.]
Existential Causality twisted and distorted.
Being defended by Martial King Reperiel, Archon Basileus Alderon instantly raised his head upwards as his face turned ashen.
[The Existential Invictus Fatality of Gang of Tyranny has been deemed for Archon Basileus Alderon.]
Gang of Tyranny.
This was the Existential Invictus Fatality chosen by Noah for Archon Basileus Alderon as the moment it was determined, booming rays of multicolored light descended around this target!
No matter how much authority he was radiating, the visage of Martial King Reperiel protecting Archon Basileus Alderon felt an undeniable repulsive force as his figure was pushed away from this area.
Archon Basileus Alderon came to be alone, his body bubbling with immense authority as at this moment...
|Dominium Burn!|
HUUM!
He felt the descending threat of death and actually began to burn his very existence for power.
Rays of multiple Omniversal Authority were pulled towards him as he sought to resist!
But...how could one resist a determined future that was only being brought to occur early?
WU!
As Alderon gathered his power with urgency and fear, the Existential Invictus Fatality of the Gang of Tyranny unfolded.
Different colored lights manifested around Alderon as they came to form humanoid Entities with Noah's devilish likeness.

In front of Alderon, the visage of Noah covered with the colorless brilliance of Quintessence could be seen, but he was adorned in a colorless tank top and obsidian pants, his hands holding onto a colorless spiked bat.

To the right of Alderon, a manifestation of Tyranny could be seen adorned in a regal purple baseball cap worn backward, a purple tank top around him and majestic baggy pants as he held a dazzling smooth purple bat!

Further around Alderon, other figures with Noah's devilish likeness continued to appear as the cerulean manifestation of Infinity appeared with a blue handkerchief tied around his head, this handkerchief reflecting an endless sea behind him as in his hands, a cerulean axe could be seen that he threw up and down.
In another direction, the manifestation of Loot appeared as he was adorned in countless bejeweled items, his hands coming out and showing golden jeweled brass knuckles as the weapons of choice!
The manifestation of the Protagonist appeared as Noah in a white tank top and white pants, crouching far above like a gangster as his hands held white slippers as the weapon of choice.
Alongside this, the visage of Cheats actually appeared.

Sleek in a golden white suit, Cheats had two assault rifles in his hands, floating semi-automatic submachine guns, rail guns, nuclear warheads that seemed compact with singularities of cosmos and planes of existence...and even more unfathomable weapons.

Multiple parts of Noah's extremes appeared and surrounded Archon Basileus Alderon like a gang, with this esteemed Entity erupting with all of his extremes and the Influence of Omniversal Authorities, but...
HO!
Quintessence in a tank top swung his spiked bat to the right of Alderon while Tyranny swung his smooth bat from the left.
The glorious pink and purple Extremes of Alderon burning all around him and supported by Omniversal Authorities...
seemed like nothing in front of these bats.
They simply passed through them!
It was ridiculous.
It was unfair.
Frankly, it was just a little broken.
CRACK!

The two bats smashed at the same time, the head of Archon Basileus Alderon becoming deformed and nearly shattering as a moment later, Loot appeared in front and swung his brass knuckles into the chest of Alderon, the sounds of cracking bones and barriers of his Dominium shattering alongside it!

Even before anything else could be done, a cerulean axe swung down below and cleaved the legs of Alderon, a pair of white slippers appeared from behind and smashed onto the back of this vile Entity causing everything to cave in!
All the meanwhile, gunshots began to reverberate at a ridiculous rate as from Cheats, a hail of bullets began to shred the body of Archon Basileus Alderon as truly an unfathomable scene played out.
A scene of utmost unfairness as it seemed like a gang beat down was taking place- ignoring eons worth of hard work of a Teracosm Stage Entity as none of his defenses did anything to prevent it.
It was simply...the alteration of Existential Causality!

chapters.title: Chapter 3047 Insane! I
paragraphs: 3047 Insane! I
The scene was carved into the wills of all those watching- whether they would live to ponder on and tell the tale, or whether they would join Archon Basileus Alderon in the very near future.

His Existential Extremity Authorities did nothing against the ongoing attacks, with his mangled body continuing to get shredded by a hail of bullets from the manifestation of Cheats as before Alderon could even rest...
BOOM! BOOM!
A spiked bat, a smooth bat, brass knuckles, slippers, and an axe crashed onto the body of this being as within the span of an instant, it became more and more mangled!
Until finally...
|YAT!|

The manifestation of Tyranny seemed fed up as he threw his purple bat upwards, his body jumping along with it before descending down in a dropkick with both legs that smashed right on top of Alderon's head, and then...
SAA!

The golden axe in the hands of Infinity swung at the neck of Alderon which had nearly been flattened with the force of the drop kick from Tyranny, the head of Alderon becoming cleaved cleanly as at such a moment...Quintessence was already in position with the colorless spiked bat.

The spiked bat was swung with force and precision as it smacked onto the cleaved head- the mangled expression and visage of Alderon with his Dominium already destroyed being flung across space until it came to land...in the left hand of Noah.

His Dominium Soul that had initiated this Existential Invictus Fatality of the Gang of Tyranny was presented with the mangled head at the very end- and he held onto it like a victorious champion while Martial King Reperiel and the two remaining Omniversal Pillagers observed with their wills in shocked silence!
Noah then gazed at the head he held in his left hand with distaste as an instant later, tentacles erupted from the mouth on his right palm that devoured it entirely.
As for the rest of the body...
SAA! SAA!

Apart from being shredded by the deadly barrage of bullets from Cheats, the axe wielded by Infinity continued to cleave everything before the white flippers of the Protagonist smashed onto this badly beaten foundation of a Teracosm Stage Entity- everything becoming thrown in Noah's direction as he devoured it all into his right hand!

Thereafter, all the manifestations that had carried out the Fatality came to float together like a deadly group up to nothing good, glaring at the three remaining Teracosm Stage Entities threateningly as the manifestation of Tyranny even pointed his smooth purple bat towards the squid like Omniversal Pillager as their figures began to vanish.
As if Tyranny was telling it...you may just be next!
The many limbs of the squid like Omniversal Pillager trembled.
[A Successive Quintessential Achievement!]
[The Existential Invictus Fatality of the Gang of Tyranny was successfully brought to fruition.]
Everything about the unique Entity that was Archon Basileus Alderon was devoured and amplified.
The leader of many Existential Domains.
Ruling over the Legacy of Alderon!
Unfathomable Imperium Legions led by Teleios Stage could move under his banner.
His power as a Teracosm Stage Entity was a notch above the rest!
And yet...

[The devoured and amplified Existence of Archon Basileus Alderon through the Existential Invictus Fatality of the Gang of Tyranny, and further amplification by the boons of Little CaCuLaTan, is being analyzed and assimilated into your Dominium concurrently in order to bring to fruition it's Illusory Weavings.]
All he could be was the fuel for another Entity.
The fuel of the Existential Omniversal Emperor!
And as such a reality settled in, the visage of Martial King Reperiel became extremely ugly.
His golden hair vibrated on his face as the Exclusive Existential Extremity Authority of the Imperium surged around his body.
The Rhynchactis had fallen.
And now, Archon Basileus Alderon had fallen.

It wasn't hard to guess what would be happening next as the power of the Omniversal Organ from Noah seemed terrifying, and the Authority radiating from Sona seemed just as unfathomable as she was even currently moving right now towards them without skipping a beat!
Martial King Reperiel stared at the starfish shaped Omniversal Pillager and the squid like Omniversal Pillager.
And Instant later...
SHAA!
All three chose different directions and ran!
Across the glacial Nest of Turbidity turned into a frozen wasteland by Sona!
They were Entities that had lived eons.
For any who had lived such a long time, they valued life more than anything else with absolute certainty!
Why remain in a reality where two Teracosm Stage Entities had already perished in shocking means?
Such a reality was not an entirely shocking one as the moment it occurred, Sona shot out towards the retreating Martial King Reperiel while her intent weaved towards Noah.
|You got the other two?|
A daring intent.
One that Noah who had begun to accept the amplified Existence of Archon Basileus Alderon replied to just as daringly!
|Yeah.|
HUUM!
Along with his words...a prompt rose.
[The analysis of the amplified Existence of Rhynchactis has been completed, and the Illusory Weaving of Rhynchactis is coming to fruition.]
Golden blue light flourished.
A massive illusory construct of a deep sea fish bloomed with a terrifying aura, multiple Omniversal Authorities gathering around its conception!
Its scales shone with a deeply cerulean hue as in front of its head with thousands of sharp golden teeth, a long cylindrical appendage with its end shimmering with a dazzling blue singularity formed.
The moment this Illusory Weaving appeared, it radiated a profound liquid gold light as its appendage lowered towards Noah- his command booming out.
|Don't let it escape.|
WU!
With a flash of brightness, the Illusory Weaving of Rhynchactis disappeared towards the direction of the squid like Omniversal Pillager!
As for Noah himself, he stared briefly at the frozen wasteland of the Nest of Turbidity that Sona had entirely frozen.

Here, the figures of the dozens of remaining Teleios Stage Omniversal Pillagers and the Teleios Stage Imperium Knight Legions remained frozen and unmoving- their wills alive but their bodies unable to escape the terrifying power of Sona!

Unfathomable Imperium Legions led by Teleios Stage could move under his banner.
His power as a Teracosm Stage Entity was a notch above the rest!
And yet...

[The devoured and amplified Existence of Archon Basileus Alderon through the Existential Invictus Fatality of the Gang of Tyranny, and further amplification by the boons of Little CaCuLaTan, is being analyzed and assimilated into your Dominium concurrently in order to bring to fruition it's Illusory Weavings.]
All he could be was the fuel for another Entity.
The fuel of the Existential Omniversal Emperor!
And as such a reality settled in, the visage of Martial King Reperiel became extremely ugly.
His golden hair vibrated on his face as the Exclusive Existential Extremity Authority of the Imperium surged around his body.
The Rhynchactis had fallen.
And now, Archon Basileus Alderon had fallen.

It wasn't hard to guess what would be happening next as the power of the Omniversal Organ from Noah seemed terrifying, and the Authority radiating from Sona seemed just as unfathomable as she was even currently moving right now towards them without skipping a beat!
Martial King Reperiel stared at the starfish shaped Omniversal Pillager and the squid like Omniversal Pillager.
And Instant later...
SHAA!
All three chose different directions and ran!
Across the glacial Nest of Turbidity turned into a frozen wasteland by Sona!
They were Entities that had lived eons.
For any who had lived such a long time, they valued life more than anything else with absolute certainty!
Why remain in a reality where two Teracosm Stage Entities had already perished in shocking means?
Such a reality was not an entirely shocking one as the moment it occurred, Sona shot out towards the retreating Martial King Reperiel while her intent weaved towards Noah.
|You got the other two?|
A daring intent.
One that Noah who had begun to accept the amplified Existence of Archon Basileus Alderon replied to just as daringly!
|Yeah.|
HUUM!
Along with his words...a prompt rose.
[The analysis of the amplified Existence of Rhynchactis has been completed, and the Illusory Weaving of Rhynchactis is coming to fruition.]
Golden blue light flourished.
A massive illusory construct of a deep sea fish bloomed with a terrifying aura, multiple Omniversal Authorities gathering around its conception!
Its scales shone with a deeply cerulean hue as in front of its head with thousands of sharp golden teeth, a long cylindrical appendage with its end shimmering with a dazzling blue singularity formed.
The moment this Illusory Weaving appeared, it radiated a profound liquid gold light as its appendage lowered towards Noah- his command booming out.
|Don't let it escape.|
WU!
With a flash of brightness, the Illusory Weaving of Rhynchactis disappeared towards the direction of the squid like Omniversal Pillager!
As for Noah himself, he stared briefly at the frozen wasteland of the Nest of Turbidity that Sona had entirely frozen.

Here, the figures of the dozens of remaining Teleios Stage Omniversal Pillagers and the Teleios Stage Imperium Knight Legions remained frozen and unmoving- their wills alive but their bodies unable to escape the terrifying power of Sona!

chapters.title: Chapter 3048 Insane! II
paragraphs: Among those frozen, the figures of Imperium Knight Akalusia and Knight Palmino could be seen, along with the visage of Archon Basileus Al-Abalem.

His eyes seemed to betray their light of utter disbelief for what was currently happening, but no matter how much his Existential Extremity Authorities struggled, the weavings of Psychros only tightened around him and all other Teleios Stage Entities even further!
They wouldn't be able to escape.
Noah gazed at all of them coldly as....
|Stay still until I'm back...|

Terrifying words that caused the Dominiums of the Imperium Legions to tremble echoed out, Noah's figure turning into a streak of purple light as his Invictus Dominium Wings that were digesting the existence of a second Teracosm Stage Entity became ever stronger, his weavings calling out to them as asked once more.
|Of the remaining three...are there any with a high probability of death we can send on their way?|
WAA!

He wanted to continue altering Existential Causality as he followed the weavings of the starfish shaped Omniversal Pillager, but even as he discerned from the Invictus Dominium Wings...nothing shone green!
There may have been a probability of death for these beings among the many possible paths.
But all the weavings of their possible paths weren't entirely filled with their deaths as it didn't meet the requirements of being the highest probability.
All three remaining Teracosm Stage Entities were the strongest ones!

Sona chased after Martial King Reperiel as in time, his probability of death would likely increase until it met the requirements, and this would be the same for the squid like Omniversal Pillager that Noah's Illusory Weaving of Rhynchactis was chasing, and the starfish shaped Omniversal Pillager Noah himself was chasing.
|Wait...|
But Noah stopped in his tracks an instant later.
He thought of a what if.
And he acted on it right away as he changed his intent and weavings.
He formed a new purpose and intent of no longer chasing the starfish shaped Omniversal Pillager, but instead adding himself to the chase of the Squid like Omniversal Pillager!
And...
HUUM!
A green hue was instantly reflected in his eyes as the image of the retreating squid like Omniversal Pillager instantly appeared in front of him.
Among the many possible weavings of its paths, its death reached the highest probability the moment Noah was added to its chase in addition to the Illusory Weaving of Rhynchactis.
Existential Causality could now be twisted!
This...was utterly insane.
Noah hadn't even moved a step- he had only changed his intent to say that he would be chasing after this being!
and the moment he did so, this changed the possible future results and added more weavings of dead paths for this Entity, and because of this...
|Existential Invictus Fatality.|
Noah could call upon a Fatality.
He could call upon Existential Causality and distort it through his terrifying Omniversal Organ brought about by the Realm he was pioneering!
An Omniversal Organ that even now was radiating even more terrifying tendrils of thick purple light, calling upon Greater Omniversal Authorities for recognition!
{Robbed Honor and glory become commonplace, their process undeniable once in place.
To ends of existence to the beginnings of extremes, a pioneer rises that has never been seen!}
His own prophecy had foretold it.
And now, he seemed to be fulfilling it as he called out lightly.
|Quintessential Iron Maiden.|
A new Fatality was called out for the Entity Noah had altered the Causality of by merely changing his intent.
Far from the Nest of Turbidity.
Space buzzed from the sheer speed of a Teracosm Stage Entity as he seemed to be riding the wave of an Omniversal Authority.
Its appendages spun like rotators below its squid like body as behind it, the Aura of a terrifying Entity coming closer could be felt!
But this Omniversal Pillager felt threads of possible paths of escape as its Dominium burned even faster.
It could escape.
It could esca-...HUK!

Its figure that was riding up the tendrils of the complex weavings of an Omniversal Authority was stopped in its tracks in the most gruesome way possible- a long chain with a hook piercing its head as it was forcefully pulled upwards!
In the space above, the hooked chain was receding into the massive construct that looked like an iron box with spikes filling its inner compartments and wide open doors.

Above this construct, the face of none other than the man that had killed two Teracosm Stage Entities prior could be seen, his devilishly handsome visage looking twisted and angry as colorless flames burned out of his eyes, nose, and mouth!

It caused the spikes on the terrifying iron box to also blaze with fiery colorless flames as the figure of the squid like Omniversal was pulled into it by the long chain no matter how much it struggled.
SQUELCH!

Thousands of spikes were gouged into its body the moment it arrived in the Quintessential Iron Maiden, its massive crimson eyes vibrating in shock and pain as moments later, these eyes saw the spiked iron doors that were flung open...close in rapidly as their flaming spiked would be directed towards all parts of its body!
CLANG!

The massive spiked doors flung themselves shut once as black and gold blood gushed out like rivers within the Quintessential Iron Maiden, the doors flinging open an instant later to show the mangled visage of the squid like Omniversal Pillager as what followed...
CLANG! CLANG! CLANG!
What followed was simply too gory to even describe as a Teracosm Stage Entity was skewered.
Its shattered dominium and existence on the other hand was constantly leaking out and disappearing into the folds of the Omniverss as all of it returned back to a single Entity.
An Entity who had wondrous prompts flowed past his eyes as he breathed out terrifying words.
|Just two more...|
Just two more!
Of five Teracosm Entities, three were already decimated by him as it was time to wrap up this wondrous incident!

chapters.title: Chapter 3049 Insane! III
paragraphs: {Yet another Successive Quintessential Achievement!}
{The Existential Invictus Fatality of the Quintessential Iron Maiden was successfully brought to fruition.}

{The devoured and amplified Existence of Cephalopoda Prima through the Existential Invictus Fatality of the Quintessential Iron Maiden, and further amplification by the boons of Little CaCuLaTan, is being analyzed and assimilated into your Dominium concurrently in order to bring to fruition its Illusory Weavings.}
Prompts passed over Noah's eyes with a twinkle of brilliance and wonder.

The Doors of the Iron Maiden snapped open and shut so many times until the terrifying Omniversal Pillager within was unrecognizable, with everything about it being transferred towards Noah's Dominium as even now, it was being analyzed to produce something even grander.

The terrifying existence that was Little CaCuLaTan was benefitting immensely as well, Noah feeling his right hand vibrating as an aura at the Teracosm Stage far exceeding what even Archon Basileus Alderon had been able to radiate was currently rising!
As for himself...his Existential Dominium Realm had continued rising across the vast Dominium Skies.
His Invictus Dominium Wings continued to pulse with ever increasing authority as they urged him to wrap up the current weavings of reality to really enjoy and understand their elevation!
And for this...
{The analysis of the amplified Existence of Archon Basileus Alderon has been completed, and the Illusory Weaving of Archon Basileus Alderon is coming to fruition.}
HUUM!
Space twisted and distorted as the complex weavings of an Omniversal Authority burning with a pink light helped in the construction of a new weaving.
Clad in black robes and filled with vile Authorities within, the visage of the old man who didn't know when to stop spouting vile things could be seen before Noah!
On his face, he only had eyes and a nose as no mouth could be seen- as if even his weaving was being told not to speak too much.
He bowed towards Noah as with sharp eyes, he gave the command to this Illusory Weaving and the Illusory Weaving of Rhynchactis that currently had no target.
And their target now as Noah would try to twist Existential Causality once more...was none other than the Martial King Reperiel who led the Imperium Legions to hunt him.
Sona was already after him.
If he sent two Teracosm Illusory Weavings as well as him making the intent to go there himself...would the death of this being be the major probability across most of his future weavings?!
BOOM!
His path was blocked by a dazzling woman bathed with a light of frost and Dignity.
Martial King Reperiel had an extremely somber gaze as his voice boomed out in low tones, extricating his nearly cleaved golden right arm from a frozen sword.

|I am not some run of the mill Martial King within the Imperium. Nor was Alderon a run of the mill Archon Basileus. We shoulder too many things as our deaths will undoubtedly seal your own. If you stop here, the death of Alderon could be overlooked...|
When pure power didn't work, one turned to reason.
As the Martial King of Cappadocia, Reperiel truly held a high position!
If he died...
|Imagine the chaos the Sanctus Populi will be embroidered in. There has not been an open war for eons between us, but this...will definitely trigger it.|
BOOM!

Yet around him, dozens of frozen swords continued to smash towards him senselessly, with Sona calmly raising her hand up in the distance and conjuring a massive frost sword above that was a thousand times their size!
Her calm face was acting as if she couldn't hear any of the intents of Martial King as his Dominium continued to be slowed down!
|You may not be greatly affected by the war, but think of all your Sisters.|
WAA!

|Think of the Elder Queens that will sacrifice themselves when faced against the Omniversal Imperium Legions. Against those treading on the paths past Teracosm. Think of all the blood that will be spilled from your single action here...Causality- you can change the future greatly just by making a different choice here.|

His intent painted a very possible and likely future due to his high status, his latest round of mind games causing Sona to look at him with sharp eyes before she spoke while swinging down the massive sword of frost.
|You...overestimate just how important you are within this Omniverse. You and many others are already set for Damnation...let me just give you your Damnation earlier.|
BOOM!

The whole region for light years turned into a frozen wasteland as akin to an icicle breaking free, Martial King Reperiel burned with the Exclusive Existential Extremity Authority of the Imperium as he simply retreated once more!
Yet in the next moment...
WU!
His figure became anchored in space.
His expression greatly changed as he felt an impending threat that seemed unavoidable, his limbs feeling an uncontrollable force that stretched them outwards as moments later...
Crimson gold light flashed as five women appeared around him.

They burned with fiery brilliance as they seemed to be manifestations of Saintesses of Fiery Damnation, their fingers coming to land on the extremes of the limbs of Martial King Reperiel as the fifth Saintess...appeared with a smile above Reperiel!

Her eyes smiled brilliantly as she put a finger on her lips as if to shush the trembling and hardened visage of Reperiel, her other hand pointing towards his face as Reperiel's mouth was forcefully opened.
Thereafter, her index finger pointed into his open mouth as in the next moment...
BRRRRR!
Blazing balls of fire shot out akin to high speed bullets!

They shot out senselessly and with wild abandon as Martial King Reperiel's body began to shake and bloat, trillions of fireballs beginning to fill his existence as when his entire weavings were filled with them...it was hard to say how painful and massive the explosion was going to be!
Sona watched on coldly in the distance as this wasn't her doing.
But she could sense the weavings of Causality.
She could see that her partner had done something unique yet again.
It was the enactment of another Existential Invictus Fatality!
Around this same time.
Within the depths of the Imperium where a certain Enclave had already begun spreading the news regarding a coming genocide.
Great undercurrents began to rise as the Dominium Crystals of two unique Martial Kings of the Imperium were fracturing!
