chapters.title: Chapter 3050 War!
paragraphs: Within the vast stretches of the Imperium.
Past innumerable Existential Domains, under the glorious golden banner of the Source of the Imperium, there was a halcyon colored Plane of Existence.

Inside such a plane of existence, there was a golden floating pathway that was comprised of a single golden block- this block constantly moving around a space that was littered with thousands upon thousands of dazzling golden stars.
Stars...that one could easily grasp in their own hands.
And yet these stars held austere brilliance and wonder as the regal aura of a Teracosm Stage Entity emanated from each of them!
Atop the golden block floating amidst these stars, there was a woman sitting peacefully while she wrote on a dazzling Codex.
The Codex radiated a multicolored light that put all others to shame, her fingers acting akin to a pen that was writing something in the Codex!
Her hair was a mixture of gold and white strands as her skin was tan, grace and unfathomable beauty rising and falling from her as her pure white robe hid the extensive majesty underneath.
A small dark mole that only added to her exotic demeanor could be seen on her lower right cheek.
Such a being didn't radiate any aura at all as one could think she was a normal entity who hadn't even grasped the workings of mana.
And yet such a being was watching over an unfathomably large number of Dominium Crystals- with the word watching only being a very small part of what she actually did!
At this moment...
CRACK!
The light within a distant Dominium Crystal instantly dimmed and cracked, the eyes of the seated woman fluttering as she blinked, and the golden block she sat on instantly disappeared.
The next moment, it was before the cracked Dominium Crystal that was leaking golden blood.
A crystal that the moment she saw, she furrowed her brows and tapped on Its remnants.
And in the next moment, illusory screens shining the last moments of the owner of this Dominium Crystal began to play out.
The illusory scenes showed...a scene that caused the beautiful woman to blink in surprise as it wasn't one that you would expect to see.
It was a a scene of Alderon surrounded by rough looking manifestations that jumped him as if it were a gang beatdown!
But the most unique thing the woman caught was how Alderon's Authorities were not even able to put up an ounce of defenses!
|An Omniversal Organ...|

Her voice was barely a whisper as she watched the scenes playing out, and she then raised the Codex in her hands- closing it and opening it again as when she did so, a page with the title of [Archon Basileus Alderon] appeared.
She read on carefully before she muttered.
|Last movements...tracking down Noah Osmont and his compatriots.. the Sanctus Populi. Noah...Osmont?|
The name rolled off her tongue naturally.
She was about to continue reading when...
CRACK!
Another sound that caused her gaze to change bloomed as she had just gotten to the part where a few words stated that Archon Basileus Alderon did not leave alone!
The name on the page caused her gaze to change as she once more disappeared along with her block, coming to appear in front of a second bleeding crystal.
At this time, her eyes blazed with multicolored radiance as she seemingly grasped the weavings of everything within an instant, her expression changing yet again as this time, she sighed!
|Why is it you...?|
In the leftover weavings of the broken Dominium Crystal, she had seen the image of a woman that she had landed eyes on since many years ago!
A woman that appeared in certain weavings.
A Woman who should not have had a hand in the death of an Imperium Martial King, much less two.
|Sona...Noah Osmont...|
She uttered the name of the woman she would meet in certain weavings of the future, and the name of the man she had never seen before.
Not even once over the past eon she had been living in had she heard anything about Noah Osmont.
And now for him to appear with her...
A small sigh escaped her lips as with a light of unwillingness, she glimmered with a golden light- allowing a clone to appear that then teleported to a different location.
In a darkly lit up space.
The woman's clone appeared in such a space while reaching out towards a dull transparent Codex at the very center.
The moment she touched it, light began to bloom as within moments, like anchored stars...points began to shine and form the manifestations of multiple different beings.

Their manifestations alone held a sense of interminable light and power as they totaled 81 in total, being a mixture of men and women as they all looked towards the woman in front of the transparent Codex!
Under the gazes of all of these important beings, the woman spoke succinctly while shooting out weavings of lights that went out to all 81 manifestations.
|Alderon and Reperiel have perished.|
Simple words.
But they were words that caused the surrounding space to begin trembling chaotically!
And moments after...
|First it is news of genocide, and now this...|
A deep voice boomed out and caused the nearby weavings of Lesser Omniversal Authorities to tremble.
|It all lines up.|
Another voice chimed in.
|The weavings of the Omniverse always flow in the most optimum direction.|
|Yes.|
Voices of agreement arose one by one.
At the center of it all, the one who had relayed the news of the deaths of two Martial Kings closed her eyes as she knew what was coming!
|War.|
HUUM!
|War.|
The voices were akin to drums decimating the surrounding space as they only continued!

|Before the Sanctus Populi, there were the Watchers. Before the Watchers, there was a certain Existential Omniversal Lineage. At this point, the time has merely come for the Sanctus Populi to make way. As before, history will only repeat.|
|War!|
HUUM!
A resonant but affirmative cry began to ring out within the depths of the Imperium!

sentences.text: Within the vast stretches of the Imperium.
Past innumerable Existential Domains, under the glorious golden banner of the Source of the Imperium, there was a halcyon colored Plane of Existence.

Inside such a plane of existence, there was a golden floating pathway that was comprised of a single golden block- this block constantly moving around a space that was littered with thousands upon thousands of dazzling golden stars.
Stars...that one could easily grasp in their own hands.
And yet these stars held austere brilliance and wonder as the regal aura of a Teracosm Stage Entity emanated from each of them!
Atop the golden block floating amidst these stars, there was a woman sitting peacefully while she wrote on a dazzling Codex.
The Codex radiated a multicolored light that put all others to shame, her fingers acting akin to a pen that was writing something in the Codex!
Her hair was a mixture of gold and white strands as her skin was tan, grace and unfathomable beauty rising and falling from her as her pure white robe hid the extensive majesty underneath.
A small dark mole that only added to her exotic demeanor could be seen on her lower right cheek.
Such a being didn't radiate any aura at all as one could think she was a normal entity who hadn't even grasped the workings of mana.
And yet such a being was watching over an unfathomably large number of Dominium Crystals- with the word watching only being a very small part of what she actually did!
At this moment...
CRACK!
The light within a distant Dominium Crystal instantly dimmed and cracked, the eyes of the seated woman fluttering as she blinked, and the golden block she sat on instantly disappeared.
The next moment, it was before the cracked Dominium Crystal that was leaking golden blood.
A crystal that the moment she saw, she furrowed her brows and tapped on Its remnants.
And in the next moment, illusory screens shining the last moments of the owner of this Dominium Crystal began to play out.
The illusory scenes showed...a scene that caused the beautiful woman to blink in surprise as it wasn't one that you would expect to see.
It was a a scene of Alderon surrounded by rough looking manifestations that jumped him as if it were a gang beatdown!
But the most unique thing the woman caught was how Alderon's Authorities were not even able to put up an ounce of defenses!
|An Omniversal Organ...|

Her voice was barely a whisper as she watched the scenes playing out, and she then raised the Codex in her hands- closing it and opening it again as when she did so, a page with the title of [Archon Basileus Alderon] appeared.
She read on carefully before she muttered.
|Last movements...tracking down Noah Osmont and his compatriots.. the Sanctus Populi.
Noah...Osmont?|
The name rolled off her tongue naturally.
She was about to continue reading when...
CRACK!
Another sound that caused her gaze to change bloomed as she had just gotten to the part where a few words stated that Archon Basileus Alderon did not leave alone!
The name on the page caused her gaze to change as she once more disappeared along with her block, coming to appear in front of a second bleeding crystal.
At this time, her eyes blazed with multicolored radiance as she seemingly grasped the weavings of everything within an instant, her expression changing yet again as this time, she sighed!
|Why is it you...?|
In the leftover weavings of the broken Dominium Crystal, she had seen the image of a woman that she had landed eyes on since many years ago!
A woman that appeared in certain weavings.
A Woman who should not have had a hand in the death of an Imperium Martial King, much less two.
|Sona...Noah Osmont...|
She uttered the name of the woman she would meet in certain weavings of the future, and the name of the man she had never seen before.
Not even once over the past eon she had been living in had she heard anything about Noah Osmont.
And now for him to appear with her...
A small sigh escaped her lips as with a light of unwillingness, she glimmered with a golden light- allowing a clone to appear that then teleported to a different location.
In a darkly lit up space.
The woman's clone appeared in such a space while reaching out towards a dull transparent Codex at the very center.
The moment she touched it, light began to bloom as within moments, like anchored stars...points began to shine and form the manifestations of multiple different beings.

Their manifestations alone held a sense of interminable light and power as they totaled 81 in total, being a mixture of men and women as they all looked towards the woman in front of the transparent Codex!
Under the gazes of all of these important beings, the woman spoke succinctly while shooting out weavings of lights that went out to all 81 manifestations.
|Alderon and Reperiel have perished.|
Simple words.
But they were words that caused the surrounding space to begin trembling chaotically!
And moments after...
|First it is news of genocide, and now this...|
A deep voice boomed out and caused the nearby weavings of Lesser Omniversal Authorities to tremble.
|It all lines up.|
Another voice chimed in.
|The weavings of the Omniverse always flow in the most optimum direction.|
|Yes.|
Voices of agreement arose one by one.
At the center of it all, the one who had relayed the news of the deaths of two Martial Kings closed her eyes as she knew what was coming!
|War.|
HUUM!
|War.|
The voices were akin to drums decimating the surrounding space as they only continued!
|Before the Sanctus Populi, there were the Watchers.
Before the Watchers, there was a certain Existential Omniversal Lineage.
At this point, the time has merely come for the Sanctus Populi to make way.
As before, history will only repeat.|
|War!|
HUUM!
A resonant but affirmative cry began to ring out within the depths of the Imperium!

chapters.title: Chapter 3051 Greater I
paragraphs: History will tend to repeat itself.
The woman standing at the center of the transparent Codex repeated these words in her mind as she thought of the many weavings she saw- the many possibilities out there.
If she could alter them, she could.
If she could change the nature of the Imperium, she would.
But she was bound by too great a purpose.
There were others like her.
A certain Dragon Knight Emperor of the Sanctus Empress.
Another Martial Emperor similar to her in the Imperium.
A Star within the Omniversal Pillagers.
And even...Sona of the Source of Dignity.
But it seemed like all of it was unavoidable.
Like all the weavings she had seen, especially after receiving the recent weavings of genocide...

'Will the weavings of the Omniverse only stand as stable as they are with all our deaths? And you...the Weaver...are you merely a tool utilized in our destruction, or do our actions enrage you so much to warrant this?'
The Weaver.
One of the few clues they had on the instrument of the Genocide!
She had begun to see small amounts relating to this Entity ever since the news of the Omniversal Genocide appeared.
But his visage was clouded.
This either meant he was under the influence and protection of multiple Greater Omniversal Authorities, or he belonged to an unknown force that was protecting his weavings.
'Who are you?'
As the drums of war began to beat, a Martial Empress wondered.
Martial Empress Yelena wondered just what the Weaver could be, and how it all came together!
In her musings...
|Yelena, this culprit for the deaths of Alderon and Reperiel...this Noah Osmont...|
A voice cut through the calls of war and came straight to Martial Empress Yelena as she turned in a certain direction that held the manifestation of an Entity who seemed to be in his teens.
And yet his eyes were filled with age as Yelena's visage bowed down slightly before replying.
|If we are to wage war against the Sanctus Populi, would they not also be swept up in it and perish along the way?|
She didn't want the unfavorable paths she had seen to unfold.
She didn't want to see the shattered Domains of so many beings!
But against her wishes...

|No. Reperiel was smart, and Alderon was even more cunning. They must have not underestimated this enemy, and yet they still perished. This needs to be addressed by itself in the highest order. You...will lead the Legions of 10,000 Martial Kings to ensure the complete erasure and eradication of this problem.|
WAA!
Terrifying words boomed out as the eyes of Martial Empress Yelena slightly vibrated.
10,000 Teracosm Stage Martial Kings.
And even her at the forefront!
This...
|Is this not a force equivalent to a battalion that would be directed towards the Source of the Sanctus Populi?|
It was entirely overkill.
Especially if she were to lead!
But against her wishes, the young visage of the manifestation she looked at only stared at her calmly while replying.
|Even against an ant, we must use the strongest possible force. Actually...I will send my Existential Omniversal Doppelganger to join this expedition alongside you and ensure its success.|
Now, these words caused the pupils of Martial Empress Yelena to dilate before she voiced out sternly.
|Sir, you are one of the 81 Pillars of the Imperium, your glorious role cannot be jeopardized with-|
|I decide, Yelena.|
HUUM!

|I will take on the role of gathering all weavings of him and those around him. Their lineage, their thoughts, their likings, their homes, their loved ones. We will destroy all of these things first before they even know we are looking for them. By the time we even come across each other, it will be to give them the shattered Dominiums and corpses of their husbands, wives, children...their entire lineages. Before they even know we are coming for them, all the weavings they are connected to will be destroyed.|
Her words never finished.

The Entity that was one of the Pillars of the Imperium was actually going to send something termed an Existential Omniversal Doppelganger alongside Martial Empress Yelena to ensure the smoothness of a single operation!
An operation intent on hunting down a few beings.
Sensing the undeniable intent, Yelena kept her sternness as she bowed.
|As you wish.|
With this bow, a new reality was set in stone.
Causality was twisted and it now paved the way towards a single direction.
In an entirely different region of the vast Omniverse.
{Back to back! Waves of Successive Quintessential Achievements!}
{The Existential Invictus Fatality of Fire Starter was successfully brought to fruition.}

{The devoured and amplified Existence of Martial King Reperiel through the Existential Invictus Fatality of Fire Starter, and further amplification by the boons of Little CaCuLaTan, is being analyzed and assimilated into your Dominium concurrently in order to bring to fruition its Illusory Weavings.}
Prompts after prompts come as Noah devoured his fourth Teracosm Stage Entity.

The amount of power his Existence was accumulating because of all of this was so maddeningly potent that he had been able to utilize the Authority of his Invictus Dominium Wings to warp directly in front of the most powerful Omniversal Pillager that had made its escape from the Nest of Turbidity.
|It is time to finish this.|
His voice calmly echoed out.
The starfish shaped Omniversal Pillager with the face of an exceedingly gorgeous woman stopped and silently looked at Noah as it didn't even gather any Existential or Omniversal Authority.
It stared at Noah silently as within the next moments, the Causality of Death of this being would twist towards certainty no matter how strong it was as there would only be a single path for it!
But at such a moment...

|There is something you cannot obtain even if my Dominium and Weavings lay shattered for you to peruse through. Something that even those above the Teracosm Stage would want. And its weavings will be lost at the most of my death.|
The Omniversal Pillager didn't beg.
Instead, it calmly stated something that caused Noah to raise his brows!

chapters.title: Chapter 3052 Greater II
paragraphs: The star shaped Omniversal Pillager spoke its intent succinctly in order to escape certain death.
And it didn't even move a muscle as around it...
SHAA!

Illusory figures appeared one after another to surround it, the sparkling visage of Sona also arriving here as she looked around between Noah and the Omniversal Pillager- her eyes eventually coming to land on the Illusory Weavings she could barely grasp the existence of nearby.
They included the Rhynchactis, Archon Basileus Alderon, the Cephalopoda Prima, and Martial King Reperiel!
Four Teracosm Stage Entities radiating tremendous waves of power!

Meanwhile, Noah himself had his Existential Invictus Dominium Wings on his back and feet pulsing with interminable splendor, tendrils of massive purple light akin to Omniversal snakes were chaotically clashing and smashing into the weavings of the Omniverse around him.
Sona looked at the staredown between the two beings before she spoke.
|What is this? A light hearted talk before death?|
The eyes of the massive starfish shaped Omniversal Pillager blinked as Noah looked at its weavings closely while its intent echoed out again.
|With my death, what I mentioned is forever gone. Those two...|
The Omniversal Pillager pointed to the Illusory Weavings of the Rhynchactis and Cephalopoda Prima as it continued.
|They also knew of it, but if you have already begun perusing through the weavings of their Dominiums and the Records they hold, you can confirm that nothing like this is recorded within.|
The Records of the two Omniversal Pillagers he had already thoroughly analyzed!
Even as Noah compressed and analyzed eons worth of memories, nothing like what this Entity before him was talking about could be seen.
This Entity.
After observing its weavings, it was known as Asterias Virgo!
Noah smiled brilliantly under the purple light he radiated as he nodded.
|Very well. You can trade your life for this information. But of course, you will have to bend the kne-|
BOOM!
Noah didn't get a chance to finish his words.

His Invictus Dominium Wings that were feeding on so much potent Existence instantly exploded with trillions of thin tendrils of purple light as the moment they did, the surrounding Omniverse shuddered!
As if these trillions of tendrils of light were coursing through the Omniverse and spreading a message.
They crossed this region and the Nest of Turbidity, and spread even further for an unknown number of light years.
And not too long after, above Noah...
HUUM!
Space trembled as the complex weavings of Lesser Omniversal Authorities in the surroundings made way.
Authorities made up of the curling of data of a few hundred or a few thousand Existential Extremity Authorities made way for something even grander!
And this something...began to shine like a distant star as it was purple blue in brilliance.
It formed into a massive pillar of cylindrical light that beamed down at Noah- this beam of light being filled with so much potent authority that it nearly froze everything in the surroundings!
Sona looked at such a light as her eyes came to lock onto the visage of Asterias Virgo.
|You better not move a single muscle.|
She could see it.
An unfathomable Greater Omniversal Authority was on its way to recognize nobody else other than Noah as he couldn't be interrupted!
The only question was...what exactly the identity of this Greater Omniversal Authority was!
While Sona wondered, Noah's visage was bombarded by prompts.
|Your pace of scaling the Dominium Skies is unfathomably fast regardless of the high difficulty.|
|You have reached a stage where few manage to truly take hold and usage of, your Omniversal Organ radiating a signal to the very Omniverse regarding your readiness.|
|Your Existential Invictus Dominium Wings released a signal, and the Greater Omniversal Authority of Aitia answered the call.|
WAA!
Dazzling streams of purple blue light cascaded into Noah and bathed the entirety of his existence.
Little CaCuLaTan who was fused with him trembled as boons were generated to it as well!
The Recognition of a Greater Omniversal Authority!
As it began to flow into Noah's existence...
|You no longer need to exhaust the Authority of your Dominium to call upon the influence of Lesser Omniversal Authorities.|
|After the Recognition of the Greater Omniversal Authority of Aitia, a small glimmer of your Omniversal Organ is enough to bring down the influence of its authority instantly.|
|For the sake of Recognition, the musings of the Greater Omniversal Authority of Aitia will flow through you and mold your Existence towards a grander extreme.|
BOOM!
The inflow of the purple blue authority felt like an endless sea.
A sea of what could have been tens of thousands or even millions upon millions of thousands of weavings of Existential Extremity Authorities!
This was how terrifying this Omniversal Authority was as it was a wonder for it to have recognized Noah.
As for the reason why his Invictus wings may have pulled and gained this specific recognition...
|You smoothly and efficiently carried out one of the aspects of the Greater Omniversal Authority of Aitia, its baptism of your existence being even more Quintessential due to this.|
Aitia.
As the dense weavings of what seemed like countless Existential Extremity Authorities flowed across him Noah understood a semblance of what this Authority meant.
Its definition was not at all that clear as Noah could best make out that it related to Cause, or Reason, or Explanation. Something that dealt closely with...Causality.
And he...had been playing with Causality a great deal in the past hour!
And as such an authority overflowed across his existence...
|Your Dominiums and Omniversal Organ are undergoing a change as they absorb the pure authority of a Greater Omniversal Authority.|
|Your Distinctions as the Weaver of Existence and Weaver of Extremity are undergoing a change as they absorb the pure authority of a Greater Omniversal Authority.|
|Your Distinctions as the Weaver of Existence and Weaver of Extremity are moving past the stages of Infancy and are currently scaling to Adulthood.|
|Your Existential Omniversal Emperor Lineage bathes in the Greater Omniversal Authority of Aitia and begins to burn with brilliance!|
Fundamental changes began within his Existence- in addition to everything that was being granted to Noah from devouring Four Teracosm Stage Entities.
But as this began, his Will vibrated as immense droves of weavings came to him!
|Your Distinctions of the Weaver, supported by the brilliance of the Greater Omniversal Authority of Aitia, are pulling musings across the Omniverse that are related to you.|
|A large number of Authorities are reaching out to seek to grasp your weavings and the weavings of those around you!|

chapters.title: Chapter 3053 Greater III
paragraphs: A large number of Authorities were reaching out to grasp his weavings!
And not just his alone.
They sought to grasp the weavings of even those around him!
For what purpose? Surely, it could be nothing else but nefarious.
His Records were his own. His weavings were hard to grasp. But the weavings of his people? They may just be somewhat more accessible!
But now, there was the recognition of the Greater Omniversal Authority of Aitia.

Its complex weavings coursed through his existence and elevated it along with his Distinctions- his capabilities as the Weaver of Existence and Extremity rising due to it as new capabilities unfolded before his eyes!
|Authorities originating from various points of Existence across the Omniverse seek to unravel your weavings and those around you, seeking to violate the dignity and privacy of the Weaver!|
|The Intent of all discerning weavings are filled with malice.|

|More Authority is required within your very existence to allow the maturing distinctions of the Weaver of Existence and Extremity to fully uncover and protect the countless weavings across the Omniverse.|
More authority was required.
His Existential Omniversal Emperor Lineage was undergoing a change along with his Distinctions and Dominiums themselves, but they needed more fuel.
Noah did not need to look far, though.
He felt the boundless purple blue light of the Greater Omniversal Authority of Aitia as he closed his stern eyes and pulled on it!
To understand.
To grasp what truly made up this massive Authority!
He could see the countless complex weavings that looked like tens of thousands of lines intersecting and resonating with each other, all of them following set pathways amidst the chaos.
From among these complex lines, some were bigger than others as he...pulled on their weavings.
HUUM!
And the massive beam of light that was the Greater Omniversal Authority of Aitia seemed to focus even more on him, and through the ongoing Recognition...
|Your Existential Dominium has grasped the Existential Extremity Authority of Causality!|
|Your Existential Dominium has grasped the Existential Extremity Authority of Probability!|
|Your Existential Dominium has grasped the Existential Extremity Authority of Possibility!|
|Your Existential Dominium has grasped the Existential Extremity Authority of Weavings!|
|Your Existential Dominium has grasped the Existential Extremity Authority of Manipulation!|
|Your Existential Dominium has grasped the Existential Extremity Authority of Luck!|
Multiple shocking Existential Extremes that were flowing within the Greater Omniversal Authority of Aitia were branded onto Noah's Soul!
|OOOH!|

And his Dominium couldn't help but bellow out a glorious bellow while his Invictus Dominium Wings buzzed, the fuel that was multiple Teracosm Stage Entities burning rapidly and depleting within him as his Existence expanded and reinforced itself to handle this explosion of Authorities.
Causality, Probability, Possibility, Weavings, Manipulation, and Luck.
The Existential Extremity Authorities of all of these concepts flowed through Noah- coursing across his existence and being altered to match him as he took everything in!
As he did so, multiple different colored tendrils of light exploded around his body, Sona and Asterias Virgo gazing on with bright eyes as they sensed the pressure Noah gave out only scaling upwards.
He gained a small component of what made up the massive Omniversal Authority of Aitia.
And yet these extremes alone should allow him to more easily and terrifyingly manipulate Causality, as well as understand it with his Weavings!
But this wasn't all.
This was just the fucking cusp of what was to come!
The massive purple blue beam of light seethed and gushed out a round ball of pure cerulean authority that smashed and was absorbed into Noah's figure in the next moment.
|You have attained enough authority to be capable of withstanding and utilizing one of the Four Components of Aitia.|
|The Component of Efficiency can now be utilized and manipulated by you in limited amounts, its usage requiring the Omniversal Authority of an Omniversal Organ to activate.|

|The Component of Efficiency deals with the manipulation of the effectiveness of all things and Authorities within the Omniverse, with you gaining the capability to increase or decrease the effect or probability of chosen targets.|
|This can vary from reducing the efficiency of a target's Existence, making their Extremes hold no actual authority, or making their attacks utterly harmless towards others permanently.|

|Other variations include placing or removing limiters of existence on others, being capable of manipulating how much power an individual or group can exhibit across the Omniverse, along with Improbability Inducement, Structure Weakening or Strengthening, Variable Manipulation, and more...|
Waves of interminable concepts flowed across his existence.
Mere one of the Four Components of Aitia!
Efficiency!
Its umbrella was too massive as the applications alone were endless.
The Efficiency of something.

It was a hard concept to fully wrap one's mind around, but when Noah focused within himself, he found the weavings of Causality, Probability, Manipulation, Weavings...and many of the concepts relating to Aitia rotating around a dazzling blue circle of light within his Existence.
This circle of cerulean light had countless thin blue lines radiating from it that connected outwards to the vast light of Aitia!
His Invictus Dominium Wings buzzed as they were the only thing that could activate this bundle of authority that represented one of the components of Aitia- Efficiency!
And Noah probed it at this moment with somber eyes his pairs of wings shone.
He looked at himself as he moved to increase the Efficiency of his own Existence!
HUUM!
|The Component of Efficiency is being utilized to manipulate the Variables that makeup Noah Osmont.|
|Your current access to Aitia has allowed the Efficiency of your Existential Dominiums to be increased by 1%.|
|Your current access to Aitia has allowed the Efficiency of your Extremes to be increased by 1%.|
|Your current access to Aitia has allowed the Efficiency of your Lineage to be increased by 1%.|
|...Everything regarding the Efficiency of Noah Osmont has been increased by 1%!|
A relatively small percentage when everything was considered.
But it applied very, very differently when it came to the Efficiency of an Existence.
Just this seemingly small 1%...
BOOOM!

Caused Noah's visage to explode with so much potent Existential light that an erupting volcanic sea of authority bloomed all around him, Sona and Asterias Virgo bringing their limbs in front of their bodies to protect themselves as everything in this region was blown backward!

chapters.title: Chapter 3054 Greater IV
paragraphs: |The Existential Extremity Authority of Quintessence has its Efficiency increased by 1%.|
|The Existential Extremity Authority of Tyranny has its Efficiency increased by 1%.|
|The Existential Extremity Authority of Infinity has its Efficiency increased by 1%.|

Amidst an incredible volcanic eruption of authority surrounding him, Noah saw dozens of prompts flashing over his eyes as all parts of his existence had their Efficiency increased by a single percentage!
A single percentage...but why was the change so profound?
This answer could only truly be answered after one gained a better understanding of what one of the Four Components of Aitia meant.
The Component of Efficiency.
Noah had first tested it on himself as the results were currently unfolding, but there was so much else to think about that it was maddening.
What if he altered the variables of existence of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed?

What if he removed any variables of limitations on the existence of his people? Have their Efficiency increased? What if the variable of Fruits of Existence or other Existential Treasures could be altered?
There were so many terrifying applications that before any of them were even tested, the results of what Noah had just done to himself had to be ascertained!
|The Breadth of all three Aspects of your Existential Dominiums has increased by 50%.|
|The Distinction of your Existential Omniversal Emperor Lineage has been elevated in an unquantifiable direction.|
|The Distinctions of the Weaver of Existence and Extremity have been elevated in an unquantifiable direction.|
As the initial eruption he had caused calmed down, his body was left behind showing interminable splendor.
Weavings of his extremes seemed to be dancing with exuberance and new found might as among all of them...
HUUM!
The colors of blue and gold were spreading around madly.
|The Weavings of Infinity latch on to unfathomable weavings of the Greater Omniversal Authority of Aitia.|
|The Existential Extremity Authority of Infinity with an increased Efficiency has begun to expand its extreme towards an unknown direction.|
|The Weavings of Fables latch on to unfathomable weavings of the Greater Omniversal Authority of Aitia.|
|All possibilities and causalities are ultimately Recorded and Possible Unrecorded Fables.|
|The weavings of the Existential Extremity Authority of Fables tightly flow to the heavy Authority of Aitia!|
WU!
Golden splendor raged around him.
And in the midst of all of this...
Dazzling flames too radiant in color began to burn around him as his Distinctions of the Weaver of Existence and Extremity finally attained a sufficient power.
At the same time, his very Lineage began to boil!
|Those daring to peek at you and those around you have earned the ire of your very Bloodline.|
Redish pink flames began to burn, hues of purple and blue glaringly gushing out from it due to the influence of Aitia.
|As the Weaver of Existence and Extremity, Veils and Machinations of Weavings surrounding you become immeasurably clear.|
|The Source of the spread of your weavings to the Omniverse that has led to others seeking to unravel who you are and the weavings of those around you has been located.|

|The Source of the spread of your weavings to the Omniverse originated from a Prophecy that initially unfolded from you, but was later misdirected and influenced by an unknown influence that latched on to Greater Omniversal Authorities.|
HUUM!
Incandescent brilliance bloomed from Noah as this time, it was filled with boundlessly rising wrath!

In the distance, the visage of Sona had just returned to her old position while staring at Noah with some eyes, her Will locked onto Asterias Virgo who didn't run during this chaotic time as this starfish shaped Omniversal Pillager also watched carefully.
As if he knew he couldn't run.

Both of them returned to their old positions as they thought that the eruption of authority should now be calming down as the entity ahead of them consolidated whatever gains he had made, but in the next moment...
|WHO?!|
BOOM!
Sona covered her ears while smacking her lips as the shout of this intent alone may have been able to shatter the eardrums of a weak Teracosm Stage Entity.
It was filled with boundless anger of Existential Extremity Authority as it would make one wonder...what the who in the single question was referring to.
Just who had earned the wrath of this terrifying being before them?!

Noah was the only one who had the answer as his existence was currently burning with controlled rage, the Existential Extremity Authority of the Protagonist blooming upwards at this moment to contribute to this intent!
It had produced the Prophecy.
And all of Noah's weavings had seen how threads of an Omniversal Authority had come down as a part of the prophecy had changed after this influence.
{Twist and turn, and turn again, all existence and non-existence shall bend all the same.
Twist and turn, and turn again, serfs and kings shall feel the same pain.
Twist and turn, and turn again, till the wheel of existence deviates and shatters from pulsing veins.
Twist and turn, and turn again, till a new Realm resonates with eons reign!}
The latter part of the prophecy.

Noah had left it alone as the sentences within it seemingly foretold his coming grand Fable, where even if the words couldn't be clearly understood with something like the wheel of existence deviating and shattering from pulsing veins, they still seemed to pertain to him.
Especially the last sentence!
But for it to not be a mere influence that only made his prophecy better, but for it to actually be a sense of misdirection? Something purposeful done by something else?!
Something that had latched onto not one, but multiple Greater Omniversal Authorities to misdirect weavings of his Prophecy and also utilize this to spread weavings about him across the Omniverse.
For what purpose?
Why were malicious intents and wills across the Omniverse currently looking for him and the weavings of those around him?
|Your Distinctions uncover an intricately veiled plot to force you to take on the path of an Omniversal Destroyer.|

chapters.title: Chapter 3055 Conspiracy! I
paragraphs: In the midst of heavy flows of authority.
With the Breadth of his Existence greatly expanded and a large number of Existential Extremity Authorities added, his Distinctions uncovered veiled weavings!
Weavings that sought to push him on the path of an Omniversal Destroyer.
What was an Omniversal Destroyer?
Something that brought damnation and apocalypse onto the very Omniverse itself!
Before Noah even received the weavings of what was uncovered, his gloriously buzzing will already put many things together.
Many parties and intents seeking to uncover his weavings and the weavings of his people.
Sona seeing Marks of Damnation on all things regardless of their factions, with something unknown coming to cause genocide over countless Existential Dominiums!
And then him...and whatever influence tried to influence weavings to set him on the path to become an Omniversal Destroyer.
It wasn't too hard to begin connecting the weavings together!
HUUM!
He rarely became angry.
HUUM!
He rarely became angry.
Rarely did he express rage as he was very laid back, and few things could bring him to anger!
But what he hated the most was others trying to control him. Others trying to steer his fate or destiny!
Nothing else filled him with such distaste compared to this.

|First recognizing you due to the Dead Paths you took to the Existential Extremity Authorities- a requirement for any recognition of Greater Omniversal Authorities, the Unknown Source observed through the stacking of multiple Greater Omniversal Authorities.|

|Their influence being severely limited, the only action capable of being carried out was through the intricate twisting of weavings of millions of Existential Extremity Authorities through Greater Omniversal Authorities, eventually leading to the veiled spread of your weavings and the set up of paths that were never among the many probabilities and causalities.|
HUUM!
His Dead Paths drew this Unknown Source in!

But it seemed severely limited in what it could do- with this being one of the more terrifying things as even with such supposed severe limitations, something as dreadful as steering the pathways and causalities of the future was able to be done.
|Your Distinctions of the Weaver of Existence and the Weaver of Extremity wrap around the entirety of your Existence to prevent any understanding or weavings of your existence to spread or be found.|
|The Greater Omniversal Authority of Aitia is pulled upon to veil your existence and even set up a false Weaving of who you are and what path you follow!|
Yes.
Noah didn't know where the severely limited Unknown Source was still capable of observing even now.
But he didn't want it to be too blatant.
He didn't want it to be entirely clear that he had found out everything!
Let them believe he was still following the path they influenced.
Let even those trying to seek his weavings and the weavings of his people not come across a blank wall of nothing- let them find false weavings and plan their Machinations from there!
HUUM!
|The Existential Extremity Authority of the Protagonist burns with interminable rage.|
|The Existential Extremity Authority of Quintessence burns with endless brilliance!|
|The Existential Extremity Authority of...|
His weavings expressed their intents as none could stand for the conspiracy that had nearly unfolded!
|Your Existential Omniversal Emperor Lineage seeks unfathomable retribution!|
|Cheats simmers in silent contemplation.|
|Cheats gazes at the countless possibilities of the Greater Omniversal Authority of Aitia and beckons towards all other Extremes.|
|The Protagonist steps forward to lead and rectify a blatant error!|
|All parts of your weavings seek greater control of Causality.|
|All parts of your weavings seek greater access and control of all weavings relating to you across the Omniverse.|
Interminable authority surged around him.

Everything that Sona and Asterias Virgo thought the Authorities around him would calm, everything only became wilder as the massive cylindrical beam of purple blue radiance continued to bathe him with brilliance.
His pairs of Wings folded into his body as if they were doing their best to contain and process unfathomable power!
They could all tell that whether through his Omniversal Organ or Extremes, Noah was doing something grand he pulled in the Greater Omniversal Authority of Aitia to support what he wanted to do.
At such a time, Sona was watching intently when...
HUUM!
Her gaze changed.
Her eyes shone with an icy gold and blue light, bits of verdant exploding as she closed them!
Her weavings had always been keeping track of anything related to those who would bring Damnation to the Sanctus Populi, Imperium, and even Omniversal Pillagers.
At this moment, some weavings were finally able to be discovered after so long- even though they still seemed just as veiled and complex!
What was it?
What exactly was the bringer of Damnation?!
Sona's weavings began to buzz as above her, reality twisted as a cerulean light of a Greater Omniversal Authority descended on her visage.

As this occurred, the Weaver of Existence far ahead of her had all parts of his existence focused on the design of something that had much greater control of Causality and his weavings across the Omniverse.
The result of this was a unique one.
|The Feature of the Existential Proofreader is being reconstructed, reformed, and elevated.|
|The Feature of Existential Omniversal Editing is being born.|
WAA!
Brilliant blue and golden lights exploded out.

Noah's vision altered greatly as in the next moment, all the surging Authorities faded as if they never existed, with his will opening its eyes to find itself in an expanse of blue and gold all around him.
Blue and gold.

This was the only thing that could be seen for light years, with immense calmness and serenity flowing all around as Noah knew this was...the representation of the newly born Feature of Existential Omniversal Editing!
This was further cemented as in the next moment...
WAP!
An illusory screen appeared that showed a group of Teracosm Stage Entities within an unknown Existential Domain.
Existential Extremity Authorities and distortions of Omniversal Authorities shone around them as at the forefront, the voice of one of these entities could be heard.
|Weaver...what are you? Where are you?|
WAP!
As the events of this illusory screen appeared, another illusory screen also came to be as this process continued one after another.
It was the advent of a feature too terrifying to even comprehend!

Others trying to steer his fate or destiny!
Nothing else filled him with such distaste compared to this.

|First recognizing you due to the Dead Paths you took to the Existential Extremity Authorities- a requirement for any recognition of Greater Omniversal Authorities, the Unknown Source observed through the stacking of multiple Greater Omniversal Authorities.|

|Their influence being severely limited, the only action capable of being carried out was through the intricate twisting of weavings of millions of Existential Extremity Authorities through Greater Omniversal Authorities, eventually leading to the veiled spread of your weavings and the set up of paths that were never among the many probabilities and causalities.|
HUUM!
His Dead Paths drew this Unknown Source in!

But it seemed severely limited in what it could do- with this being one of the more terrifying things as even with such supposed severe limitations, something as dreadful as steering the pathways and causalities of the future was able to be done.
|Your Distinctions of the Weaver of Existence and the Weaver of Extremity wrap around the entirety of your Existence to prevent any understanding or weavings of your existence to spread or be found.|
|The Greater Omniversal Authority of Aitia is pulled upon to veil your existence and even set up a false Weaving of who you are and what path you follow!|
Yes.
Noah didn't know where the severely limited Unknown Source was still capable of observing even now.
But he didn't want it to be too blatant.
He didn't want it to be entirely clear that he had found out everything!
Let them believe he was still following the path they influenced.
Let even those trying to seek his weavings and the weavings of his people not come across a blank wall of nothing- let them find false weavings and plan their Machinations from there!
HUUM!
|The Existential Extremity Authority of the Protagonist burns with interminable rage.|
|The Existential Extremity Authority of Quintessence burns with endless brilliance!|
|The Existential Extremity Authority of...|
His weavings expressed their intents as none could stand for the conspiracy that had nearly unfolded!
|Your Existential Omniversal Emperor Lineage seeks unfathomable retribution!|
|Cheats simmers in silent contemplation.|
|Cheats gazes at the countless possibilities of the Greater Omniversal Authority of Aitia and beckons towards all other Extremes.|
|The Protagonist steps forward to lead and rectify a blatant error!|
|All parts of your weavings seek greater control of Causality.|
|All parts of your weavings seek greater access and control of all weavings relating to you across the Omniverse.|
Interminable authority surged around him.

Everything that Sona and Asterias Virgo thought the Authorities around him would calm, everything only became wilder as the massive cylindrical beam of purple blue radiance continued to bathe him with brilliance.
His pairs of Wings folded into his body as if they were doing their best to contain and process unfathomable power!
They could all tell that whether through his Omniversal Organ or Extremes, Noah was doing something grand he pulled in the Greater Omniversal Authority of Aitia to support what he wanted to do.
At such a time, Sona was watching intently when...
HUUM!
Her gaze changed.
Her eyes shone with an icy gold and blue light, bits of verdant exploding as she closed them!
Her weavings had always been keeping track of anything related to those who would bring Damnation to the Sanctus Populi, Imperium, and even Omniversal Pillagers.
At this moment, some weavings were finally able to be discovered after so long- even though they still seemed just as veiled and complex!
What was it?
What exactly was the bringer of Damnation?!
Sona's weavings began to buzz as above her, reality twisted as a cerulean light of a Greater Omniversal Authority descended on her visage.

As this occurred, the Weaver of Existence far ahead of her had all parts of his existence focused on the design of something that had much greater control of Causality and his weavings across the Omniverse.
The result of this was a unique one.
|The Feature of the Existential Proofreader is being reconstructed, reformed, and elevated.|
|The Feature of Existential Omniversal Editing is being born.|
WAA!
Brilliant blue and golden lights exploded out.

Noah's vision altered greatly as in the next moment, all the surging Authorities faded as if they never existed, with his will opening its eyes to find itself in an expanse of blue and gold all around him.
Blue and gold.

This was the only thing that could be seen for light years, with immense calmness and serenity flowing all around as Noah knew this was...the representation of the newly born Feature of Existential Omniversal Editing!
This was further cemented as in the next moment...
WAP!
An illusory screen appeared that showed a group of Teracosm Stage Entities within an unknown Existential Domain.
Existential Extremity Authorities and distortions of Omniversal Authorities shone around them as at the forefront, the voice of one of these entities could be heard.
|Weaver...what are you?
Where are you?|
WAP!
As the events of this illusory screen appeared, another illusory screen also came to be as this process continued one after another.
It was the advent of a feature too terrifying to even comprehend!

chapters.title: Chapter 3056 Conspiracy! II
paragraphs: Within the Source of the Imperium.
Inside a location within the heart of the Visionary Enclave.

A group of men and women shining with the resplendent light of gold and the grand aura of the Teracosm Stage could be seen sitting down, a shining golden singularity made up of Existential Extremity Authority swirling at the center of their encirclement.
Tendrils of power leaked from them to join this golden singularity as at the forefront, a man shrouded in the Exclusive Existential Extremity Authority of the Imperium muttered.
|Weaver...what are you? Where are you?|
They had been searching this whole time to no avail as the weavings of the one to bring genocide among the many possible paths out there were hidden too deeply!
Shrouded in golden light, the Martial King looked at the 11 other Teracosm Stage Entities who were contributing all their power and influence as he spoke with tremendous righteousness.
|We will find them no matter what- in this, do not falter!|
His intent bolstered their efforts as moments later...
|Oh!|

An old man to the left let out a bellow of surprise as he caught onto something and magnified it- the rest of them quickly coming towards this weaving they had found with difficulty as it looked like a massive wriggling tenebrous worm filled with malice and destruction!
Their gazes shifted quickly as they held onto this weaving, beginning to scour it carefully.
|The Omniversal Destroyer...|
The face of a Teracosm Stage Entity paled as her golden hair was filled with sweat.
From the weaving, they could barely see the form of an endlessly devouring black mass, tenebrous black wings expanding behind it and covering everything!
|Who are you...?!|

The dozen Martial Kings of the Visionary Enclave geared towards the discernment of Weavings bellowed out, the influence of Omniversal Authorities in the surroundings becoming even more intense as finally, another clue was uncovered.
The 12 Teracosm Stage Entities breathed out while the singularity in front of them shattered, gazing at each other as they each repeated the same thing.
|The Omniversal Destroyer...Alekzandr!|
They gazed at each other as they had come across critical information, their weavings instantly erupting as this had to be shared!

This unfolding reality...this scene that was occurring right here at this very moment...an illusory screen showing everything unfolding was visible in front of the eyes of the Weaver in an entirely different location.

Noah watched with calm eyes as the identity of the Omniversal Destroyer was decided, his eyes moving to another illusory screen among the many that had risen in the serene space of blue and gold brilliance.
This illusory screen showed a woman sitting on a golden block, gazing at distant sparkling Dominium Crystals as her hand held a closed Codex of Extremity.
Her voice could be heard clearly from the illusory screen as if Noah was right there!
|I've seen the possible paths where you and others die...but this is the first time that I will be the one responsible for your death, Sona.|
Her gaze was no longer filled with reluctance as her mind was made up.
Everything else aside, she had her duty.
A duty that was much too heavy to cause it to falter for an Entity she only knew of from possibilities.
|Through you, I will get this Noah Osmont...|
As she spoke, she showed a bewildered expression before she began to raise her head and look around.
As if she felt a pair of eyes watching her, but her weavings felt nothing nearby.
Was she just imagining things, or...
Her suspicious eyes gazed around as moments later, a multicolored brilliance unfurled behind her, an Entity stepping out of it as they bowed towards the woman on the golden block.
|Martial Empress Yelena, I have come to take over during your absence.|

At such words, Yelena nodded without looking back as within a moment she disappeared- leaving the golden block empty just briefly before a man adorned in multicolored brilliance stepped on it with a somber light.
An aura of varying colors that depicted a stage above Teracosm!

Noah gazed at this screen and made note of how Existential Omniversal Editor was not Absolute in its surveillance, with those more powerful being somewhat capable of sensing something as he moved to another illusory screen.

To his left, an illusory screen showing the scene of an Entity dressed like a Butler could be seen, his visage floating amidst waves of darkness as he bowed towards a massive Omniversal Pillager whose body hid a terrifying multicolored light!
|Weavings of our target seem to slowly be getting unveiled...how do you wish to ensure the coming destruction?|
|Haha, how do you earn the rage of any being? It is to destroy that which they care for...let us find out what this Harbinger of Destruction cares for...|
Noah's eyes became sharp as he didn't focus on this screen too much, remembering what just occurred with another Entity that exceeded the Teracosm Stage as his eyes moved to another screen!
Here, he saw the scene within the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed.

His people were grouped together gazing at his distant figure that was undergoing a transformation similar to his Dominium Soul, their Guidance currently stopped as they absorbed and assimilated their current gains.
Gazing at them, Noah's will churned as he sought to put to use another function of this blooming feature.
It was the Existential Omniversal Editor, was it not?
His hand pointed towards his people as his Invictus Dominium Wings began to buzz, powering up the mass of cerulean brilliance within him as...
|Through the Existential Omniversal Editor, the Weaver seeks to alter the Variables of Existence of multiple targets.|
|The Efficiency of multiple targets is being increased.|
He increased his own Efficiency and faced tremendous results as he began to remove limitations on himself.
What about his people?
HUUM!
One of the Four Components of Aitia buzzed.
And the change began with his Son at the forefront.
Then the Queens of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed.
And then all others followed.

They had been annealing their Existence and assimilating the Fruits of Existence granted to them when in the next instant, their figures exploded with unfathomable brilliance as nearly all of them...felt the weavings of Dominiums beginning to form.
All of them.

Among many, the eyes of the Daughter of Hatred trembled as she actually felt her Existential Soul, Body, and Origin Dominiums beginning to come to fruition as she and many others began a mass advancement to the Primordium Stage!

chapters.title: Chapter 3057 Conspiracy! III
paragraphs: The Existential Dominium Realm was not something entirely easy to grasp as many took a great number of years, resources, and Authorities before their Aspects of Existence became Existential.
Yet at this moment, a few hundred Vassals underwent this transformation as the very variables of their existence were altered!
If they had low potential before.
If the process of elevating their Existence was slow.
All of this was altered as one of the Four Components of Aitia- Efficiency, was increased on their existence!
Within the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed.
RAA! RAA!

A grand Emperor Penguin raised its beak up high as the rebirth and transformation of its existence allowed the aura of the Existential Dominium Realm to radiate from its body- a lustrous golden light blazing for miles as the Existential Extremity Authority of Pride pulsed with majesty!

In another direction, Little Henry's Existential Dominiums burned so brightly that it was blinding, the Existential Extremity Authority of Nepotism working overtime to ensure that the greater the brilliance of his father, the greater his brilliance was.

|Unfathomable...| The mutterings of Dr. Hall could barely be heard in another direction as he didn't even focus on the fact that the Existential Extremity Authority of Medicine was now pulsing with an Existential light, but more so on the changes to his very existence that were initiated elsewhere.

In another direction, Little Henry's Existential Dominiums burned so brightly that it was blinding, the Existential Extremity Authority of Nepotism working overtime to ensure that the greater the brilliance of his father, the greater his brilliance was.

|Unfathomable...| The mutterings of Dr. Hall could barely be heard in another direction as he didn't even focus on the fact that the Existential Extremity Authority of Medicine was now pulsing with an Existential light, but more so on the changes to his very existence that were initiated elsewhere.
He knew the only being who could be responsible for this.
And he just wondered...
How?!
HUUM!

Swirling storms of brilliance boomed all around as in another direction, the Cimmerian Architect shook her head with disbelief while Ishtar and Sargon were dazed, with the most bombastic figure currently being the Primogenitor of Steel whose body had turned massive, enlarging from a world and beginning to expand towards light years as he warped himself to another location- the glamor of Steel, Blacksmithing, and other things causing a unique transformation as he looked like bronze statue of old!
One Entity after another went through their own transformation.
But a single truth remained the same.
On this day, an army of Existences following a different Realm Progression compared to the masses was born!

This blooming reality was observed by Noah with his connection to the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed and the screens shown by the Existential Omniversal Editor, Noah gaining a semblance of knowledge on just how profound the new tool he had formed was.
It was made possible by his Distinctions as the Weaver of Existence and Extremity, along with his Lineage and Extremes that sought to rectify an unknown influence!
An Influence that even at this moment...
|The Unknown Source that was seeking to influence your path remains unknown, their weavings obscured by multiple Greater Omniversal Authorities.|
The culprit was still unknown.
The one who had done all of this was still someone that Noah had no information about as he couldn't sit still!
He had to continue exploding ever upwards in power as at this moment, the path of extremes led towards more and more Existential Extremity Authorities.
And since one's Dominiums could not entirely contain millions of such Authorities, the answer was the influence of Omniversal Authorities!
Just like the Unknown Source that was hiding its weavings behind multiple Greater Omniversal Authorities, Noah had to attain the recognition of just as many, if not more.
But herein lay a terrifying truth.
Just the Greater Omniversal Authority of Aitia alone felt so massive.
He felt like he had only just touched the cusp of what this Omniversal Authority held, with him barely gaining access to one of its Four Components!
And even this Component of Efficiency alone, he had only just begun playing with it.

A unique weaving of emotions swirled within him as he felt like he had all the time in the world since it took others millions or eons to achieve what he was achieving, but he also felt like it was moving so slowly!
He achieved within minutes and hours what others needed eons for.
And yet even this seemed too slow!
|Faster...|
HUUM!
His intent burst out.
And his Invictus Dominium Wings began to buzz.
Causality was twisted!
His transformation was massive and impressive, and it would take some time to complete as surely...there was a high probability of its grand completion.
So Noah simply sent his Will out and let it be known that Causality can be twisted to achieve the end result of this transformation!
The end result of all the Teracosm Stage Entities he had devoured and assimilated.
The end result of the transformation of Little CaCuLaTan merged with him.
HUUM!
Brilliance unfolded.
Because at this moment, when it came to Causality...Noah had even more tools under his banner!
|The Existential Extremity Authority of Luck was triggered towards the ongoing Existential Causality.|
|The Existential Extremity Authority of Manipulation was triggered towards the ongoing Existential Causality.|
|The most optimum and profound end result has been set forth from all the possible paths of this Existential Causality.|
|The Existential Extremity Authority of Luck has triggered Quintessential Ascension during the transformation of this Causality!|
|Weavings of Fortune and Destiny overlap and amplify, Probability being distorted in a Quintessential fashion as the Efficiency of this altered Existential Causality has been increased by 1%.|
Causality was distorted.
What was bound to happen was forced to happen and finish in an instant, and the manner in which it happened was amplified and elevated multiple times over!
The result...
BOOM!
An illusory flash of purple wings radiated outwards for light years as an instant later, all surging Authorities faded.
In the distance, Sona opened her eyes.
The humanoid face of the starfish shaped Omniversal Pillager that was Asterias Virgo gazed forward with scrutiny.

Their eyes were locked onto the visage of an Entity adorned with garments made up of Existential Extremity Authorities, his fair skin sparkling with radiance as on his feet and back...iridescent pairs of wings could be seen pulsing brightly.
Their makeup still remained a powerful purple aurora of royalty, but at this moment...fantastical golden feathers gracefully flowed in intricate parts of these wings!
It was a mixture of purple and golden radiance.
Purple represented the Teleios Stage while gold represented Teracosm.
Noah was traversing in neither of these stages as his Invictus Dominium Stage now showed hues of purple and gold!

chapters.title: Chapter 3058 Entropic Fervor! I
paragraphs: Causality was distorted as everything finished all at once.

Noah's body was shrouded in Existential Extremity Authorities that came together to form an Emperor's Robe, with his Invictus Dominium Wings pulsing to release a swirling aurora of authority that circled around him and made him look so supremely unique!
If one looked even closer to him with piercing eyes, they may be able to see a series of colorful auroras rising up and burning around his body akin to haki, but they were invisible to the naked eye.
|Your Existential Invictus Dominium Wings radiate an Innate Existential Causality Defense.|

|Any attacks sent your way will have to go through a series of constantly regenerating shields of Causality that reduce and lower any probability of damage reaching you. This Innate Existential Causality Defense costs no resources to keep active and will be with you until your existence deems it unnecessary.|
Noah raised his hands up to observe the invisible auroras of authority, his right hand wiggling at this moment as a creature came out of it.
A furry ball of black and white that had gained stripes of gold formed as its wide eyes blinked with a sense of loss and sadness for leaving Noah.
Yet its own body was shaking with interminable power as the gains it had made were immeasurable.
Prompts continued to rise before Noah's eyes as he ascertained the changes.
|Your Distinctions as the Weaver of Existence and Weaver have entered the Adult Stage.|
|Past the Adult Weaver Stage, the Weavings of the Elder Weaver and Ancient Weaver have been observed ahead.|
An Adult Weaver of Existence and Extremity!
It allowed him to grasp weavings about himself and others at a shocking pace and control, all the while hiding his own weavings and controlling what others knew about him.
Ahead, there were the stages of the Elder Weaver and Ancient Weaver to look out for, with there being many unknowns for what these stages would bring!
|Your Existential Omniversal Emperor Lineage has become a Greater Omniversal Lineage.|

|Being more intertwined with the Omniverse and Existence, the Breadth of your existence will be supported and expanded passively to accommodate more Existential Extremity Authorities, with certain Lesser Omniversal Authorities passively applying their influence on your existence to increase your advancement across the Dominium Skies.|

|All those of your Lineage in the Existential Dominium Realm will be capable of gaining the influence of a Lesser Omniversal Authority, with those reaching the Invictus Dominium Stage capable of gaining the recognition of a Lesser Omniversal Authority right away.|
|You can choose when to apply the advancements of your Lineage to your Vassals at any time.|
His Lineage was bringing in shocking Authority.
And whenever he so chose, the benefits and boons would flow down to his forces as they experienced something only those who had moved for eons had the chance to!

By the time they all finished their transformations into the Existential Dominium Realm and Noah applied the benefits of his Lineage to even give them the influence of Lesser Omniversal Authorities, he could send this army out for the Conquest of Existential Dominium!
And when speaking about armies...

|The Illusory Weavings of your defeated enemies were born from your analysis and weavings, and they now carry a trace of your brilliance as the blood of the Existential Omniversal Emperor flows through them.|
|All Illusory Weavings that have reached the Teleios Stage or an equivalent Stage will gain the Lesser Invictus Dominium Wings- carrying a small shred of weavings that mimic your Omniversal Organ.|

The Rhynchotis, Archon Basileus Alderon, Martial King Reperiel, and Cephalopoda Prima that were unseen in the surroundings showed blazing illusory purple and gold feathery wings on their backs and on their lower limbs as the power they radiated was far exceeding their former past weavings!
Noah's brilliance was astounding, but he never kept it all to himself.
It was always shared.

And as he was still determining just how profound his power had risen, especially the offensive capabilities of Causality that the Invictus Dominium Wings now had, the visage of Sona appeared before him.
|Your strength seems to be catching up...maybe even exceeding mine at this point.|
Her utterly gorgeous visage that was now without her Heart spoke just as confidently as before.

The icy blue light of a Greater Omniversal Authority still lingered around her as she came to Noah and gazed at him up and down, her bright eyes taking everything in as she even sniffed him as if she were confirming something!
Her voice then rang out as it held a trace of seriousness.

|More of the weavings about our enemy are becoming available. The Omniversal Devourer- Alekzandr...it feels off though. My senses even say that it's bullshit, but I don't have any weavings to support it. The unique thing is that there were many paths of destruction, but a great deal of them have faded as of right now. But, Damnation is still the majority.|

Noah looked at her closely as she spoke, with there not even being a debate in his mind on whether he would let this Entity before him know about the fact that he was the enemy she was looking for and forming this whole Initiative about!
It wasn't even a matter of trust or what his own weavings were telling him.
It was the fact that this Entity had literally given him her heart- her Omniversal Organ that could break with a little pressure!
So he spoke calmly as behind him, the image of the Omniversal Devourer- Alekzandr, that he released for anyone seeking information regarding these possible weavings of damnation could see...
|I put out the weavings of Alekzandr since I realized the Omniversal Destroyer was planned to be me.|
Sona's pupils dilated.
The icy blue beam of cylindrical light that represented a Greater Omniversal Authority brightened and nearly solidified!
She was inches away from Noah as within an instant, her right hand snaked out and grasped his neck tightly!
The Innate Existential Causality Defense didn't stop the hand whatsoever as this...wasn't an attack.

An instant later, Sona came even closer to Noah and wrapped her legs around his body, her left hand grabbing his vibrant hair as with her right hand still grasping his neck, she pushed her red lips onto his!

It was an action that caused Little CaCuLaTan on the side to blink and turn around as if he was seeing something he shouldn't see, with Sona breaking from the kiss after a second as her intent rang out.
|My guy, what a fucking relief!|

chapters.title: Chapter 3059 Entropic Fervor! II
paragraphs: It was a shocking turn of events!
Most would expect a feeling of betrayal if they were told the enemy they were looking for this whole time was right in front of them.
A fight may have broken out with things turning extremely sour!
And yet the moment Sona heard Noah's revelation, after the initial shock, she jumped on him to share a relieved kiss amidst the confusion.
She kept her hand on his neck as even though it wasn't an attack and she showed relief, it also seemed like she was ready to attack at any point.
She was a unique existence.
Why would Noah be the Source of Damnation?
Why would he choose to tell her right now?
If he truly was the bringer of Damnation, what purpose would it serve him to reveal this information?
Even more, he held her heart as with a light pressure, he could end her existence!
Well, she had a failsafe if the worst possible thing happened, but with his current self, he may just be able to bypass it.
And it was also the way he phrased his words.
'I put out the weavings of Alekzandr since I realized the Omniversal Destroyer was planned to be me.'
Since he realized that the Omniversal Destroyer was planned to be him.
He realized it.
Planned.
These words were crucial!

She didn't jump straight to conclusions as with their faces an inch away, her lips came to his ear as she looked behind him at the disappearing visage of the Omniversal Destroyer she had seen in her weavings.
|Explain, Big guy. There's a lot of things on the line here.|
Their bodies were entwined like glue as Sona could feel Noah's vibrant existence ever closer, as well as her heart within him.
His voice came out naturally as if he were talking about the calmest thing.

As he spoke, pinkish blue flames of the Weaver began to burn around them, the glow of purple and blue from the Greater Omniversal Authority of Aitia beaming down around them as their figures became veiled!
Even Little CaCuLaTan and Asterias Virgo could no longer see or grasp any weavings happening between them, nor could any unknown influence outside of this space.

|An Unknown Source I haven't yet unveiled has tried to set things in motion for me to take on the weavings to become the Omniversal Destroyer. To carry out genocide across this Omniverse. I only just found out about it now as at this point, this Unknown Source still believes I'm on this path.|
His words caused Sona to grasp onto him even tighter as she replied with icy brilliance.
|So you altered what others could see just now, the breakthrough I made is what you allowed others to see...|
Her mind was a brilliant one as many things began to click.

But even with all of this, her eyes still turned sharp a moment later as she spoke. |But this Unknown Source...what cause or hatred could they have to steer things towards Damnation? Not just of the Imperium, but Sanctus Populi, and Omniversal Pillagers? And even more, why wouldn't they carry out the Damnation themselves? Why use others?|
Yes!
What was the why behind all of this? Why steer things to push Noah to be the Omniversal Destroyer? For what reason?!
Understanding the why could lead to the who, but things were too convoluted!
Noah nodded at Sona's words as his right hand reached out to grasp the vibrant asset behind her, feeling its softness as he continued with simmering brilliance.

|Yes, my Weavings show a few possibilities, but none of them fully match. The highest one so far on what could have so much hatred is the Omniversal Lineage of the past that has been destroyed and all descendants from it used as Seeds over the past eons, but even this hatred should only be directed towards the Imperium. So why damn everyone and everything?|
Noah's words caused Sona to move her face and come stare at him in genuine shock.
Yes!
Noah's highest theory on what the Unknown Source could be was actually an extremely powerful Entity from the Omniversal Lineage that the Imperium destroyed and enslaved.

Because as someone with his own Omniversal Lineage, his Invictus Dominium Wings paved the way for him to attain the recognition of a Greater Omniversal Authority as the stronger one was, the more recognition they would have!
So the Unknown Source who was hiding behind multiple Greater Omniversal Authorities...could genuinely be residues of this decimated Omniversal Lineage.
Sona stared into Noah's nine pupiled eyes as her intent came out.

|Yes...it would explain why they may not move themselves. Maybe their authority is wounded or they have some form of major limitation. But still...why damn everything? The Sanctus Populi succeeded the decimated Watchers in eons past as we have been fighting the Imperium to save as many Entities from their Existential Farms as we could. We help those who may carry a trace of the past Omniversal Lineage and work for the will of the people. So why...|
The weavings didn't line up.
Noah nodded lightly as he grasped the assets on the back of Sona ever tighter while his intent weaved out.

|Another possibility is of course something outside of this Omniverse. It's more supported due to them wanting to damn everyone, but again...why use someone else for their purpose? And with this theory, there are very few points of evidence to support it as absolutely nothing about such Entities is unknown, whether they even exist is another question.|
It was hard to say.
But the anxiousness and heavy weight Sona felt one her all these years faded as she breathed lightly onto Noah's lips while continuing.

|And the weavings of Damnation were ones I had been seeing for quite some time, before anything about you came in. Even if you were placed at the forefront of it right now...if you were to be replaced for another Omniversal Destroyer, the same weavings may remain.|
A truly complex conundrum!
Sona smiled brilliantly with such a heavy topic in hand, her voice now filled with noticeable ease as it emanated.
|...even with all of this, you don't know how important of a breakthrough this is. So important that I think I deserve a prize.|
WAA!
|You deserve a prize?|

Noah blinked questioningly at this gorgeous entity before him as she nodded while the icy garment covering and hiding her blessings began to disappear into flickers of Existential Extremity Authority.
|Yeah. Who cares about anticipation...this finding deserves a celebration. So, the guy who may be the one to bring my Damnation and the Damnation of the masses...you think you can take me?|
A daring question.
One that seemed like a challenge as the Weaver of Extremity...was not one to challenge lightly!
HUUM!
Purple blue brilliance unfolded along with a glimmer of icy blue, two Grea
ter Omniversal Authorities descending as their authority was being used for something they were not in any way intended for!
