chapters.title: Chapter 3060 Entropic Fervor! III
paragraphs: Sanctus Princess Sona challenged the Weaver of Extremity on whether he could take her!

Such a daring challenge started a session of Dual Cultivation of the highest possible order, with the influence of two Greater Omniversal Authorities glaring down towards an area where no others could see.

Little CaCuLaTan didn't know what was occurring meters away, while Asterias Virgo also remained right where she stood- her weavings telling her this was the only option that may not result in destruction!
Meanwhile, within the blazing pillars of icy blue and purple brilliance.
|The Weavings of your existence are resonating Quintessentially with the weavings of a unique entity.|
|Your Omniversal Organ is resonating with the Source of another Omniversal Organ within the Entity Sona.|
|An Existential Quintessential Catalytic Reaction has begun as the weavings of both parties begin to experience elevation.|
A positive feedback loop.
With both of them having unimaginable types of existence and secrets of their own, their Dominiums fed off of each other and only propelled themselves higher due to their current actions!
And alongside it...
|The Authority of Lust pierces along the scales of an Existential Extremity Authority as the other Seven Deadly Sins gaze on in envy.|
There were also some less...savory authorities that jumped to take centerpoint at this moment as another round of scaling the Dominium Skies began, but this time through a different path.
And even as this path unfolded...the Invictus Dominium Wings buzzed and expressed an intent.
|Would you like to distort Causality and arrive at the end result of the current weavings?|
The Invictus Dominium Wings asked whether Noah wanted to skip what he was currently doing to arrive at the end result right away.
There was nothing wrong with this action.
Noah had distorted Causality multiple times now to arrive at the end result quickly and with the most optimum results!
But when he heard his Invictus Dominium Wings express this intent, he nearly wanted to smack them.
No.
Some events had to be fully experienced!
Within the Nest of Turbidity.

Tenebrous darkness was still retained amidst the frozen glacial locks, the figures of dozens of Teleios Stage Imperium Knights and Omniversal Pillagers still remaining frozen due to Sona's single attack.
No matter what they did, they could not break out of the constraints of Psychros as their Dominiums only became colder and colder!
If left alone, they would eventually be entirely frozen of their Existential Extremity Authorities as they would only feel an endless darkness encapsulating them from here on out.

In such a place, space distorted as Noah's Existential Body Dominium appeared- with his Will leaving the Dominium Soul with Sona a distance away from here as he arrived to clean up the last remnants of the battlefield.
His arrival caused trepidation and fear amongst all the Teleios Stage Entities here as not too long ago, he had told them to stay still!

His Dominium Body also held the same fantastical purple gold feathery wings and an aurora of swirling brilliance around him, his eyes quickly locating the Imperium Legions as he tapped his finger towards them.
CRACK!
The glacial waves of Psychros began to crack around them, especially in front of figures like Knight Akalusia.

Moments later, torn and barely healed Codexes of Extremity began to come out of the frozen glacial cracks, along with a buzz of authority as the illusory figure of Sona's face actually formed from the frozen cracks of Psychros that were her authority!
She had a playful expression as she looked at Noah's other body and the actions he was carrying out, her intent flowing out.
|And here I thought you were giving me your full attention...|

The disruption of her glacial prison alerted her as her will manifested amidst the dual cultivation of her main body, with Noah's brows rising at her unfettered figure as his Dominium Soul that was connected with her quite a distance away did something, and Sona's Will that had just manifested here changed her gorgeous expression as with a crimson flush, she disappeared!
Noah then continued his actions here as multiple Codexes of Extremity gathered around him, his weavings looking at them closely while he gazed towards the frozen Imperium Legions.
He saw the figure of Al-Abalem far in the distance, frozen and filled with complex emotions.
Ice cracked and shattered around him as he wheezed, his figure coming out of the glacial enclosure as he trembled, his skin cold and blue as he gazed toward Noah.
It was a unique reality.
Days ago, he was an Archon Basileus of the Existential Domains of Vitalis and Vacuous, and now...he looked like a freezing extra who was about to fall apart at any second!
Meanwhile, days ago, Noah could only be considered a Seed under his farm.
The two stared at each other as many emotions seemed to cross through their eyes.
But at the end of the day...
Noah sighed while voicing out with a raise of his hand, his finger tapping out.
|Merely an extra...|
PAH!
A tap of a finger.
And the visage of Al-Abalem stared forth before it began to crack, its Dominium and existence flickering into grains of stellar dust as if he were absolutely nothing to begin with.
Noah then stared at the rest of the Teleios Stage Entities before he called out.
|Existential Invictus Fatality.|
Prior to his advancement, he could carry out the Fatality of a single being by distorting Causality, but now...he felt that carrying out mass Fatalities was possible.
Especially if those he was carrying them out against were lesser beings!
The authority of his glorious wings began to buzz while in the distance, the frozen bodies of Teleios Stage Entities beginning to tremble as they felt the threat of death descending!

From the cracks of the glacial prison, the area where Knight Akalusia was now had some more freedom due to Noah breaking it to attain Codexes of Extremity, and nearby, the mouth of Knight Palmino was barely free as he spoke out with a raspy voice.
"Knight...Commander Akalusia...is of important heritage. If...kill, there will be war!"
He barely got the last words out as he was freezing with his whole existence.
Akalusia was relatively more free, but she didn't say a thing as she only grit her teeth and glared towards Noah!
At the words of Knight Palmino, Noah smiled as dazzling lights of Causality began to shine above all Teleios Stage Entities here.
His intent was a terrifying one as it rang out.
|Didn't you know?|
WAA!
|A war is already starting across the Omniverse. A shame that none of you will be there to witness it, but your illusory weavings will bear witness.|

|The Authority of Lust pierces along the scales of an Existential Extremity Authority as the other Seven Deadly Sins gaze on in envy.|
There were also some less...savory authorities that jumped to take centerpoint at this moment as another round of scaling the Dominium Skies began, but this time through a different path.
And even as this path unfolded...the Invictus Dominium Wings buzzed and expressed an intent.
|Would you like to distort Causality and arrive at the end result of the current weavings?|
The Invictus Dominium Wings asked whether Noah wanted to skip what he was currently doing to arrive at the end result right away.
There was nothing wrong with this action.
Noah had distorted Causality multiple times now to arrive at the end result quickly and with the most optimum results!
But when he heard his Invictus Dominium Wings express this intent, he nearly wanted to smack them.
No.
Some events had to be fully experienced!
Within the Nest of Turbidity.

Tenebrous darkness was still retained amidst the frozen glacial locks, the figures of dozens of Teleios Stage Imperium Knights and Omniversal Pillagers still remaining frozen due to Sona's single attack.
No matter what they did, they could not break out of the constraints of Psychros as their Dominiums only became colder and colder!
If left alone, they would eventually be entirely frozen of their Existential Extremity Authorities as they would only feel an endless darkness encapsulating them from here on out.

In such a place, space distorted as Noah's Existential Body Dominium appeared- with his Will leaving the Dominium Soul with Sona a distance away from here as he arrived to clean up the last remnants of the battlefield.
His arrival caused trepidation and fear amongst all the Teleios Stage Entities here as not too long ago, he had told them to stay still!

His Dominium Body also held the same fantastical purple gold feathery wings and an aurora of swirling brilliance around him, his eyes quickly locating the Imperium Legions as he tapped his finger towards them.
CRACK!
The glacial waves of Psychros began to crack around them, especially in front of figures like Knight Akalusia.

Moments later, torn and barely healed Codexes of Extremity began to come out of the frozen glacial cracks, along with a buzz of authority as the illusory figure of Sona's face actually formed from the frozen cracks of Psychros that were her authority!
She had a playful expression as she looked at Noah's other body and the actions he was carrying out, her intent flowing out.
|And here I thought you were giving me your full attention...|

The disruption of her glacial prison alerted her as her will manifested amidst the dual cultivation of her main body, with Noah's brows rising at her unfettered figure as his Dominium Soul that was connected with her quite a distance away did something, and Sona's Will that had just manifested here changed her gorgeous expression as with a crimson flush, she disappeared!
Noah then continued his actions here as multiple Codexes of Extremity gathered around him, his weavings looking at them closely while he gazed towards the frozen Imperium Legions.
He saw the figure of Al-Abalem far in the distance, frozen and filled with complex emotions.
Ice cracked and shattered around him as he wheezed, his figure coming out of the glacial enclosure as he trembled, his skin cold and blue as he gazed toward Noah.
It was a unique reality.
Days ago, he was an Archon Basileus of the Existential Domains of Vitalis and Vacuous, and now...he looked like a freezing extra who was about to fall apart at any second!
Meanwhile, days ago, Noah could only be considered a Seed under his farm.
The two stared at each other as many emotions seemed to cross through their eyes.
But at the end of the day...
Noah sighed while voicing out with a raise of his hand, his finger tapping out.
|Merely an extra...|
PAH!
A tap of a finger.
And the visage of Al-Abalem stared forth before it began to crack, its Dominium and existence flickering into grains of stellar dust as if he were absolutely nothing to begin with.
Noah then stared at the rest of the Teleios Stage Entities before he called out.
|Existential Invictus Fatality.|
Prior to his advancement, he could carry out the Fatality of a single being by distorting Causality, but now...he felt that carrying out mass Fatalities was possible.
Especially if those he was carrying them out against were lesser beings!
The authority of his glorious wings began to buzz while in the distance, the frozen bodies of Teleios Stage Entities beginning to tremble as they felt the threat of death descending!

From the cracks of the glacial prison, the area where Knight Akalusia was now had some more freedom due to Noah breaking it to attain Codexes of Extremity, and nearby, the mouth of Knight Palmino was barely free as he spoke out with a raspy voice.
"Knight...Commander Akalusia...is of important heritage.
If...kill, there will be war!"
He barely got the last words out as he was freezing with his whole existence.
Akalusia was relatively more free, but she didn't say a thing as she only grit her teeth and glared towards Noah!
At the words of Knight Palmino, Noah smiled as dazzling lights of Causality began to shine above all Teleios Stage Entities here.
His intent was a terrifying one as it rang out.
|Didn't you know?|
WAA!
|A war is already starting across the Omniverse.
A shame that none of you will be there to witness it, but your illusory weavings will bear witness.|

chapters.title: Chapter 3061 Entropic Fervor! IV
paragraphs: Knight Palmino tried to dissuade Noah just a little bit from what he was about to do!
He stated how Knight Akalusia stemmed from a grand heritage within the Imperium, and that killing her may just start a war.
But Palmino and the others didn't know.
Noah had already seen the weavings of war as they related directly to him, along with the decision of the Imperium to proceed along this destructive path similar to what they had done before!
It was a shame that these Knight Legions didn't even get the chance to join as they would be among the first sacrificial lambs.
HUUM!
The Existential Invictus Fatality was laid down.
In the glacial prison of Psychros, fiery golden light rose as above every Teleios Stage Entity, the gorgeous visage of a Saintess bathed in golden flames manifested!

All her manifestations smiled with a devilish charm while turning the heads of those below to face them, a slender finger floating right above their mouths or upper orifices of the Omniversal Pillagers as moments later...
BRRR!
The pristine landscape of frozen blue glaciers began to melt.

The hues of blue became tainted crimson red as multiple figures enclosed in ice shone with increasingly bright crimson gold light, the bodies and all of their Existential Dominiums becoming filled with extremes of flames and heat as trillions of fireballs scorched their existence!
Some of them were instantly vaporized while others exploded into balls of flames, the remnants of their Existence all being pulled towards Noah.
A moment before it reached him, Noah's hand moved again as space distorted, the visage of Little CaCuLaTan appearing as it looked surprised.
|Oh! Big Boss! Is this another shell...?|

Its eyes seemed to be shining as this Omniversal Parasite bounced around like a white and black furball, the streaks of gold in its body being prominent as Noah released his palm- Little CaCuLaTan's eyes turning into a smile as it dove directly in!

A unique symbiosis was then formed as Noah's palm opened to show a mouth that sucked in all the weavings of existence being destroyed- with their weavings being amplified by Little CaCuLaTan and then Noah as a feast of Teleios Stage Entities was undertaken.
At the same time, the Codexes of Extremity that Noah was surrounded by began to disappear one after another- sent to another location entirely for a glorious purpose!
Within the vast stretches of the Omniverse.
Within the Source Of the Imperium.
A middle aged man with a bald head adorned in the Existential Robes of a Martial Emperor was staring at a golden crystal in a room that had a dozen Teracosm Stage Entities lined up behind him.
The tone was a somber one as if they expected a very negative result at any moment, and their fears were realized to be true moments later when...
CRACK!
The Dominium Crystal shattered.
And the Martial Emperor standing at the forefront arose, holding the dredges of the Dominium Crystal as from it...he wasn't even able to get any weavings.
|After hearing of the deaths of Martial King Reperiel and Archon Basileus Alderon, we expected the worst.|
His voice was filled with utmost coldness as the Teracosm Stage Entities behind him bent down with respect- as if ready to be commanded!
The entity with his bald head looked at the residues of the Dominium Crystal as he continued.

|My granddaughter lies dead. Her death...by the hands of the ones they were pursuing. Noah Osmont. A Sanctus Princess and their Dragon Knights. Blood must be paid by blood. Get our Legions ready to set off...my Magnate Enclave will scour the ends of the Omniverse if need be. Until Osmont and all the dredges of the Sanctus Populi involved are scorched, we will not stop.|
The Magnate Enclave that never failed in whatever they set their eyes on!

The Teracosm Stage Martial Kings behind the Martial Emperor Magnate only bowed and agreed to the command as they didn't even bring up the fact that over 10,000 Martial Kings led by Martial Empress Yelena were already dispatched.
The anger of Martial Emperor Magnate had to be resolved!
Like this, a bundle of chaos began to unfold from multiple sources.

A fervor of chaos and entropy arose as after important personages of the Imperium called for war, heavy Legions were directed towards the eradication of a single being and those aiding him- Noah Osmont!
At the same time, the weavings of the Omniversal Destroyer began to spread- the focus of many entities coming to land on an Unknown Entity whose weavings were not entirely known!
Far from the Source of the Imperium.
Within the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed.
|During your transformation, the Analysis of Fruits of Existence and Quintessential Fruits of Existence was completed.|
|A change requiring your observance is beginning right now within your Infinite Forge.|
Noah's Dominium Origin was seated on the massive multicolored throne that was connected to all the weavings of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed while these prompts flashed over his eyes!

They came while he pushed multiple Codexes of Extremity towards the Manifestation of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed that was surrounded by heavy tendrils of Existential Extremity Authorities.
Manadynamics was not the only one as threads of Existential Entropy, Gravitation, Polarity, and many other past Laws seethed with potent might!
Out of all of them, Entropy seemed to be burning with unfathomable brightness- as if it were immeasurably intertwined with the weavings of the Omniverse.
As if the endlessly flowing chaos and nature of disorder of the Omniverse only caused it to become that much greater with its authority!

At such a moment in time when the completed analysis of the Fruits of Existence called for Noah to observe something, and an unknown change beginning with Entropy...Noah also spoke towards the Manifestation of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed.
|Let us begin the design of a Quintessential Codex of Extremity...burn all others down for its brilliance.|
It was the start of the design of a Quintessential Codex of Extremity amidst a fervor of chaos and entropy, a war staring at the faces of all forces currently moving within the Omniverse!

chapters.title: Chapter 3062 Entropic Fervor! V
paragraphs: Within the Source of Dignity.

Brilliant verdant and golden lights fluctuated like seas all around as the figure of Sanctus Princess Emilliana could be seen standing straight amongst other Sanctus Princesses, with the figures of Elder Queens standing ahead of them as all of them...gazed up front.
On a throne of pure Existential Extremity Authority that was also surrounded by Tendrils of the weavings of Omniversal Authorities.
The figure of an utterly gorgeous entity sat with calmness and serenity as she was the Elder Queen Mother!
The one who currently controlled the Source of Dignity!
Her expression was currently stern as surrounded by verdant and gold lights, her voice rang out.

|Destruction and genocide is coming as the Imperium wishes to enact yet another campaign similar to eons past that eradicated countless Lifeforms. This time, the Sanctus Populi will not sit idly by and defend until our forces are overrun. We will bring the war towards their own homes!|
They fought for the good of the people.
But they were not weak.
They would not be etched in the eons of history as another force that the Imperium had erased or enslaved!
They could not.
|Prepare your Dragon Knights and set off as soon as possible to your set coordinates...Salus populi suprema lex esto!|
WAA!
Her words ended with a saying.
A saying that caused the Elder Queens and Sanctus Princesses to shine with power as they returned it in kind!
In bellowing tones that seemed like drums of war.
|Salus populi suprema lex esto!|
|Salus populi suprema lex esto!|
The good of the people reigned supreme!
The good of the people was the supreme law.
With their hearts burning with purpose, they began to set off one after another.
Before all of them could disappear, a weaving from the Elder Queen Mother flowed out towards one of the Sanctus Princesses.
|Emilliana, any word on your sister?|
With her verdant gold locks of hair shining brightly, Emilliana was called upon as she bowed down while shaking her head.
|No, Queen Mother. None of us have been able to grasp their weavings.|
Sanctus Princess Sona and the Prince she had set off with.
Their weavings couldn't be ascertained by any of those within the Source of Dignity as who knew where they would be at a time when chaos was running rampant!
Emilliana bowed even deeper as her intent weaved out.
|I will continue sending my weavings towards her and await a reply. Knowing her, she likely has a plan or may be far away from any of the weavings of this war.|
The Elder Queen Mother nodded at such words as she permitted Sanctus Princess Emilliana to take her leave.

At the same time, she herself arose with a glimmer of thunderous brilliance, multicolored light coiling around her as the heavy influence of a Greater Omniversal Authority could be seen dangling above her!

The moment she did make a move, multiple Dragon Knights glistening with multicolored splendor of the weavings of the stage above Teracosm appeared behind her, their expressions full of majestic glory as the Elder Queen Mother disappeared with a flicker of brilliance along with them.
The weavings of chaos increased across all directions.
A sense of fervor for entropy seemed to only be increasing and couldn't be avoided!
In another stretch of existence within the Omniverse.
A massive Omniversal Pillager occupied a space filled with chaotic weavings of Omniversal Authorities and remnants of Unstable Anomalous Existential Domains.

Its full figure could not be discerned amidst the tenebrous darkness as its massive crimson eyes were the only things that could be clearly seen- with these eyes currently holding a sense of obsession and fervor as the intent of this entity slowly leaked out.
|Omniversal Destroyer...Oh, Omniversal Destroyer!|
It seemed excited.
As if it was heavily expectant on what was to come and how it would benefit!
Amidst such a fervor...
HUUM!
The influence of a crimson Greater Omniversal Authority descended onto this being as from this Omniversal Authority...there actually emanated a commanding voice.
|Set off to pillage and conquer. No reservations or restraints from here on out.|

The voice carried a commanding tone that the massive Omniversal Pillager radiating a dim multicolored light could not ignore, countless tentacles beginning to rise at this moment as this entity began to move.
Across the Omniverse, many wondered about the mystery of Omniversal Pillagers.
Whether they moved only to pillage and destroy, and why there would be times of silence and inaction, and times of chaos.
They wondered whether there was a structure of power amongst the Omniversal Pillagers- whether they were being led by or listening to the order of any Entity!
Nothing could be affirmed for sure by others.

But at this moment, a Will reached out through the influence of Omniversal Authorities- coursing its own extremes amidst millions of complex weavings of Extremes to deliver its Intent simultaneously across the Omniverse not just to a single Omniversal Pillager...but all of them.
Every. Single. One!
At such a time of erupting and increasing entropy, it was hard to say after the passage of years or even an eon...which entity would come out on top amidst all this chaos?
Armies set off.
As such weavings began, minutes turned into hours.
And the passage of hours...came with a great deal of changes.
Near the Source of the Imperium.

Clusters of Existential Domains under the banner of the Imperium were located inside and outside of the Source of the Imperium, with many Imperium Royals residing within such domains similar to Cappadocia.
There were thousands of such Domains, each one having a Martial King overseeing its workings as they were either part of a Legacy or Enclave.
Within one such domain.

News had begun to spread among some Imperium Royals of unique new products within the Existential Imperium Exchange- Automatons that could manage their Domains and do exploration tasks with shocking efficiency!
This caused many of them to be purchased across different Existential Domains, especially so when the news of the tides of war came.
With war came opportunities.
With war came many costs as countless products would exchange hands within the Existential Imperium Exchange as everyone sought to anneal and strengthen their own Dominiums!
So weavings of the Infernal Enclave spread along with the Automaton Workers they sold.
Inside a Domain where Automaton Workers were lined up and ready to be deployed.
Their blue gold radiance and dull eyes instantly came to life without being activated by those who purchased them, with the space in front of them distorting and forming a rift in space.
From this rift, the figure of a handsome young man stepped out as he was followed by the visage of an Emperor Penguin, a man with a glistening tenebrous Katana, and multiple others that stepped out!
It was the arrival of the Quintessential Commander Henry among many others within the Domains of the Imperium as a war truly began!

chapters.title: Chapter 3063 Entropic Fervor! VI
paragraphs: The moment Little Henry and a few others arrived in the Existential Domain that had a few dozen Existential Automatons bought and stationed before they were deployed, Little Henry raised his hand to release a glistening singularity.
A Seed.
One that radiated a devouring light of power and brilliance as the moment it was released, the surrounding weavings of the Existential Domain began to be sucked into it.
|Our job is a simple one.|
WAA!
Henry's voice rang out amidst other renowned figures of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed, all of them spreading out and circling around the Seed devouring everything.
|We defend until everything is devoured!|
RAA!
Fearsome cries echoed out in response to Henry's words as Quintessential Soldiers who had the Variables of their Existence altered were sent to the forefront of the war.
Into the homes of the Imperium where currently, their Martial Kings and Teleios Stage Knights were greatly reduced in number!
In another Existential Domain.

A group of Sequor and Neonate Stage Young Masters were leading a group of Automaton Workers into a golden floating ship- one that was setting off towards a region filled with Anomalous Existential Domains under the control of the Imperium!
Yet in the next moment...
WAP!
Space twisted above the Automaton Workers as the figures of multiple entities with unique auras appeared.
At the forefront was a woman filled with devilish charm and adorned with a crimson dress, the horns of a demoness present on her head as it was none other than the Daughter of Hatred, Lilith!

Beside her, the fiery gold figure of Ayame could be seen shining with a light of Infinity as alongside them, the figure of a tanned muscular man with shorts and an unbuttoned white shirt could be seen holding slippers in his hands- this Entity being none other than Erikson!
Their bodies emanated a unique glow and power of Existential Dominium as the Imperium Royals stared at them in a stupor, and before anybody could fully react...
|Its a good day to distort some probabilities...|

A powerful light shone from him- far exceeding even Lilith and Ayame as he was one of the few who greatly benefitted from the elevation of Noah's Existential Omniversal Emperor Lineage with its capabilities of distorting reality- along with what the Invictus Dominium Stage promised!

As someone who had long since played with Probabilities before, the glow of the Existential Extremity Authority of Probability linked to the Weaver of Extremity buzzed around Erikson with a royal purple light as he spoke out.
|There's a high probability of an ass-whooping coming up for you all.|
WAA!
Along with his words, his right hand holding a slipper swung down- a massive illusory slipper appearing above as it came down akin to swatting flies!
Only now did the Sequor and Neonate Stage Young Masters react as by this time, a devilish light had already unfolded from Lilith while Ayame carefully released a devouring Seed behind them.
In another Imperium Existential Domain on the periphery of the Source of the Imperium.

But the moment they did so...
|Fuck me.|
The Cimmerian Architect cursed as they found themselves on the back of assembled Legions.

Ahead of them, with a dozen Teleios Stage Imperium Knights in the lead, the eyes and wills of such beings and 9 Legions made up of hundreds of Sequor and Neonate Stage Imperium Royals that were about to set off landed on them.
The two sides gazed at each other in a stupor briefly as the Imperium Legions within this Domain reacted quickly, many tendrils of weavings erupting out!
|Not to worry.|
In such a situation where they came across overwhelmingly powerful Legions...
|Little Fish wouldn't send you all to your deaths...|

The voice of Barbatos rang out as she stepped out of the rift with the figures of terrifying Existential Omniversal Undead in tow, her devilishly small visage stroking the skull of a dragon as she sat on the head of an Existential Omniversal Lich King burning with deathly black flames!
As a member of the Harem, the Extremity Authority of Harems granted a terrific amount of power to Barbatos.
And she wasn't alone.
Alongside her, Adelaide, Athena, Katelyn, and multiple others flooded out while burning with tremendous power- meeting the 9 Legions of the Imperium within this Existential Domain head on!
Within one Existential Domain.
And another Existential Domain.
And another!
The forces of the Weaver of Existence began to make their way even before the main armies of the Omniverse clashed.
These Vassals were not run of the mill Dragon Knights or Imperium Knights.
They held an entirely different Realm Progression...and altered existences with their Efficiency increased, along with the benefits of the Existential Omniversal Emperor flowing through their blood!
The moment all of them began their battles, shockingly...the Imperium Knights and Royals they faced found out a shocking fact.
|YAA!|
In the Existential Domain where Barbatos and others were.
The Teleios Stage Imperium Knights opened their eyes wide as they observed a dark distortion of space- an influence of a Lesser Omniversal Authority!
But it didn't just occur around Barbatos.
It also occurred around Athena.
Around the Cimmerian Architect.
Around the Primogenitor of Steel!
HUUM!
A glow of influence that mainly Knight Commanders held as they utilized the Codexes of Extremity to gain the influence of Omniversal Authorities.
At this moment it radiated from every single one of Noah's Vassals as he unleashed a terrifying army!
And even this was a single Army.
He still had an invisible army of Illusory Weavings that had its own glorious purpose to achieve- and they patiently lay waiting!
As for Noah himself...
WU! WU!
A storm of Existential Extremity Authorities blazed near a multicolored throne at the center of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed- at the center of it all...being a colorless crystalline book.
A Codex of Extremity!

chapters.title: Chapter 3064 The Codex! I
paragraphs: 3064 The Codex! I
Colorless.
Transparent.
It seemed like an extremely delicate piece of work, but also something too exquisite to even be touched by ordinary hands!
The Manifestation of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed was standing in front of this delicate book as her intent weaved out.

|A tool not just to act as a guide to Extremity, but as something that will take extremes to an unfathomable level. To allow one to tap into and gain access not to just a few Existential Extremity Authorities, but millions.|
The purpose of the Codex of Extremity was to give one access to Existential Extremes that they would normally not have access to!
An Entity was limited.
Their Dominiums were limited.
But a tool could expand this as from the designs and hard work of the Imperium, Noah and the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed constructed their own tool- their own Codex of Extremity!
|Constructed from the purest essence of hundreds of thousands of broken down Quintessential Fruits of Existence, Quintessence itself, Infinity, Manadynamics...|
The ingredients of the Quintessential Codex of Extremity were listed one after another as wondrously, it was born from the back of Fruits of Existence!
The only question was how did Noah attain such large numbers of Fruits of Existence?
First was through the Infinite Existential Omniversal itself, and then...there was the fact that he had finished analyzing the Quintessential Fruits of Existence and the normal Fruits of Existence!
A prompt told him he had to observe something within his Forge.
This observation continued to be astounding even now.
Within his Dominium.
Surrounded by weavings of Loot, Causality, Destin, Fortune, Probability, and many others, there was the Infinite Forge.
It was Existential.
It was Omniversal.
And it was unfathomably Quintessential!
When Noah's will stepped inside of it at this moment, what he observed was an array of golden mountainous Passages that floated all around this Forge filled with seas of Loot light.

And from the tips of these mountainous Passages of golden majesty, there was a constant eruption of multicolored light that weaved together to form dozens of Quintessential Fruits of Existence with every passing second!
Dozens of Fruits of Existence every second.
From each golden mountain.
And there were...
Noah couldn't help but smile with contentment at the scene of dozens of golden mountains across his Infinite Forge!
And as his Existential Dominium was elevated, more mountains were being created as this was only the beginning.
And whenever he so chose...
|Existential Causality...|
He called out to his vibrant Omniversal Organ as a purple gold light of brilliance flashed.
Noah pulled for Causality to be twisted and distorted- for the eventuality of him producing as many Fruits of Existence to be possible in the next day!
And...
|The Existential Extremity Authority of Luck was triggered towards the ongoing and future Existential Causality.|
|The Existential Extremity Authority of Manipulation was triggered towards the ongoing and future Existential Causality.|
|The most optimum and profound end result has been set forth from all the possible paths of this Existential Causality.|
|The Existential Extremity Authority of Luck...|
|Weavings of Fortune and Destiny overlap and amplify, Probability being distorted in a Quintessential fashion as the Efficiency of this altered Existential Causality has been increased by 1.2%.|
HUUM!
A shocking amount of brilliance erupted.
And the many mountains within Noah's Infinite Forge tensed and contracted, seeming like sonic volcanic mountains that had been waiting for eruption this whole time!
Within moments...
BOOM!
Erupt they did as hundreds of thousands of Quintessential Fruits of Existence made their appearance.
Hundreds of thousands very quickly formed into a few million as at the center of it all, Ruination floated with interminable splendor.
And at the same time, Noah felt nearly a quarter of the Authority of the Invictus Dominium Wings erased as for this, he had many means to regenerate it!
Some distance away from the Nest of Turbidity.

Sanctus Princess Sona was tying her hair back while an icy authority formed a garment around her astonishing figure, her body dripping with deeply golden hues of light that solidified her power at the Teracosm Stage as if she had been in such a stage for over an eon and consumed millions of Fruits of Existence!

At such a moment, she felt the fluctuations of Causality behind her as the immeasurably bright wings behind the back and feet of a certain being lost some of their Luster, and Sona rolled her eyes as her intent weaved out right after.

|How many more times will you play with Causality and say we need to do it again to get you back to full power? The 112th time really was the last...we have to get a move on right now. The most optimum time to come across the twins of the Imperium is coming up, and they'll still be needed...|
Her eyes seemed to be filled with staunch determination to stick to her current position, even though her will nearly betrayed her!

Noah smiled as an Emperor's Robe of golden Existential Extremity Authority wrapped around him, his figure coming beside Sona who playfully put up her fists as if she would throw hands right away if he tried anything.
|You've made me realize my willpower needs to be much more powerful, I'll fix it along the way. Let's deal with that little starfish and...hmm?|
Her brows quickly rose as she felt something.
She wasn't the only one as moments later, Noah's figure disappeared amidst their concealed weavings to appear in front of Asterias Virgo!

The Omniversal Pillager who stated there was something utterly crucial that even those above the Teracosm Stage would fight for- something that would disappear within its Dominium if ever it perished!

It had been waiting patiently as its weavings told it death was very likely were it to leave in the last few hours, but Noah could see its body currently shaking and convulsing as if there were something it was revisiting heavily.

His eyes pulsed with tendrils of purple blue light as the Greater Omniversal Authority of Aitia bloomed right away, his vision seeing thick tendrils of authority in the form of a command coming down and wrapping around Asterias Virgo- commands that it was resisting right now!
|Ho?|
Sona soon appeared beside him to observe this scene herself as Noah gazed at the many possibilities, and moments later...
his shining eyes reached out to a newly forged Codex quite a distance away from here!

chapters.title: Chapter 3065 The Codex! II
paragraphs: 3065 The Codex! II
He knew his power had greatly surged upwards once more since he finished the assimilation of the Teracosm Stage Entities.
The boons of Dual Cultivation were terrifying, especially when both sides were immensely powerful as the feedback only became that much greater!
Of great consequence was the weaving of a prompt that came both to him and Sona.
|The resonance of your Existential Omniversal Organs has been deemed capable of forming an Accessory Omniversal Organ that has the possibility of becoming a genuine Omniversal Organ.|
|The more times the resonance of your Omniversal Organs is experienced, the more accumulation and change of an Accessory Omniversal Organ forming.|

The formation of an Accessory Omniversal Organ. Chances of forming it increased every time they performed Dual Cultivation as during the many dozen tries prior, such an Organ didn't arise for either of them!
But their Dominiums still experienced a great upscale of means.
Both he and Sona's power had been elevated greatly from this as there were a few possible ways they could handle the scene in front of them.
The Omniversal Pillager seemed to be resisting an inviolable call that commanded it to do something, and this call was now twisted within an Omniversal Authority that was deeply tenebrous in color.
Among the many methods that he or Sona could utilize, he reached out across the weavings of spacetime to pull out the newly made Quintessential Codex of Extremity.
He wanted to have its usage verified as it would deal with one of the greatest components it made possible!
WAP!
A clear and transparent colorless Codex appeared within Noah's right hand in the next moment as Sona only raised her brows towards this.
He had already exposed something as terrifying as being the proposed Omniversal Destroyer as showing something like this right now was far too minimal!
Noah grasped the Quintessential Codex of Extremity in his hands as more of its details rose before him.

|Quintessential Codex of Extremity|:: An Existential Omniversal Construct of complex making and design. Born from the backbone of the very Fruits of Existence and mixed in with complex weavings of authorities, it is capable of allowing one to call upon the influence of up to ten Lesser Omniversal Authorities and up to a single Greater Omniversal Authority without the need for recognition. But its usages don't just stop here. As a tool to utilize and bring everything to its utmost extreme, this Codex is capable of analyzing, recording, and breaking down all Authorities it comes across. All Omniversal Authorities it comes across will be analyzed and recorded. All the thousands or millions of Existential Extremity Authorities within an Omniversal Authority will be analyzed and recorded. Within the Records of the Quintessential Codex of Extremity, many weavings and possibilities become possible for anyone with a strong enough existence to utilize it to its full potential...
An utterly unique construct.
Grasping it, Noah's Existential Dominium whose authority had rarely been used as he replied mainly on his Invictus Dominium Wings to distort Causality...began to be utilized now!
And the Colorless Quintessential Codex of Extremity shone and illuminated the reality ahead as its pages began to flutter, words rapidly being written within it as they also rang out in Noah's mind.
|A New Greater Omniversal Authority has begun to be analyzed.|
|The Greater Omniversal Authority of Deorcnysse has been recorded in the Quintessential Codex of Extremity.|
|Approximately 3,333,333 Existential Extremity Authorities flow with complex weavings to make up the Greater Omniversal Authority of Deorcnysse.|
HUUM!
Noah felt his Dominium buzz akin to an engine.

More and more Existential Extremity Authority was required to continue doing what the Codex of Extremity sought to do, and Noah injected more of his will on exactly what he wanted to do at this moment!

|The Complex Weavings and computations of the few million Existential Authorities within the Greater Omniversal Authority of Deorcnysse are being studied for gaps to disentangle and disrupt its immovable weaving.|

|A complementary and opposing Omniversal Authority is capable of disrupting the Weavings of the Greater Omniversal Authority of Deorcnysse with much greater efficiency than any other random Omniversal Authority.|
|The Greater Omniversal Authority of Lux has been recognized.|
|The Greater Omniversal Authority of Lux has been recorded in the Quintessential Codex of Extremity.|
|Approximately 3,000,000 Existential Extremity Authorities flow with complex weavings to make up the Greater Omniversal Authority of Lux.|
|The Greater Omniversal Authority of Lux is capable of being called upon with a sufficient enough cost.|
A great deal of weavings unfolded before Noah's eyes as amidst the tendrils of darkness wrapping around the Asterias Virgo, Noah called out lightly.
|O Lux!|
The Colorless Quintessential Codex of Extremity shone with a bright white gold color.

Above Noah, swirling white gold feathers swirled down with immense fervor as they were directed by the Codex of Extremity that had taken on the same shade, about a tenth of Noah's Existential Extremity Authority being eaten up at this moment!
But the result was feathery white gold light raining down like an endless river that crashed into the Asterias Virgo, immense sparks of authorities exploding out in the next moment!
BOOM!
Heavy weavings of Greater Omniversal Authorities were disrupted.
|Hoo...Hoo!|
The rough breaths of the Asterias Virgo could be heard as it gazed towards Noah and Sona, bowing its head slightly as its voice echoed out.
|Erasing the influence and command of the Eonic Uterra is not a feat I can yet achieve...so I thank you.|
Terrifying words echoed out of the Omniversal Pillager as Sona's eyes turned sharp, her intent leaking out.
|Eonic Uterra?|
The words alone seemed to have power.
The moment they were uttered by her and Asterias Virgo, the surrounding reality buzzed as tendrils of tenebrous light burned with intensity!
The starfish shaped Omniversal Pillager gazed around with a sense of unveiled awe and respect and she spoke out with a sense of reverence.
|Yes. The one who commands the Omniversal Pillagers...The Eonic Uterra!|
WAA!
Many asked whether there was a unified voice behind the Omniversal Pillagers and what it could be.
At this moment, the distinction of Eonic Uterra was heard by the weavings of two unique beings!

But its usages don't just stop here.
As a tool to utilize and bring everything to its utmost extreme, this Codex is capable of analyzing, recording, and breaking down all Authorities it comes across.
All Omniversal Authorities it comes across will be analyzed and recorded.
All the thousands or millions of Existential Extremity Authorities within an Omniversal Authority will be analyzed and recorded.
Within the Records of the Quintessential Codex of Extremity, many weavings and possibilities become possible for anyone with a strong enough existence to utilize it to its full potential...
An utterly unique construct.
Grasping it, Noah's Existential Dominium whose authority had rarely been used as he replied mainly on his Invictus Dominium Wings to distort Causality...began to be utilized now!
And the Colorless Quintessential Codex of Extremity shone and illuminated the reality ahead as its pages began to flutter, words rapidly being written within it as they also rang out in Noah's mind.
|A New Greater Omniversal Authority has begun to be analyzed.|
|The Greater Omniversal Authority of Deorcnysse has been recorded in the Quintessential Codex of Extremity.|
|Approximately 3,333,333 Existential Extremity Authorities flow with complex weavings to make up the Greater Omniversal Authority of Deorcnysse.|
HUUM!
Noah felt his Dominium buzz akin to an engine.

More and more Existential Extremity Authority was required to continue doing what the Codex of Extremity sought to do, and Noah injected more of his will on exactly what he wanted to do at this moment!

|The Complex Weavings and computations of the few million Existential Authorities within the Greater Omniversal Authority of Deorcnysse are being studied for gaps to disentangle and disrupt its immovable weaving.|

|A complementary and opposing Omniversal Authority is capable of disrupting the Weavings of the Greater Omniversal Authority of Deorcnysse with much greater efficiency than any other random Omniversal Authority.|
|The Greater Omniversal Authority of Lux has been recognized.|
|The Greater Omniversal Authority of Lux has been recorded in the Quintessential Codex of Extremity.|
|Approximately 3,000,000 Existential Extremity Authorities flow with complex weavings to make up the Greater Omniversal Authority of Lux.|
|The Greater Omniversal Authority of Lux is capable of being called upon with a sufficient enough cost.|
A great deal of weavings unfolded before Noah's eyes as amidst the tendrils of darkness wrapping around the Asterias Virgo, Noah called out lightly.
|O Lux!|
The Colorless Quintessential Codex of Extremity shone with a bright white gold color.

Above Noah, swirling white gold feathers swirled down with immense fervor as they were directed by the Codex of Extremity that had taken on the same shade, about a tenth of Noah's Existential Extremity Authority being eaten up at this moment!
But the result was feathery white gold light raining down like an endless river that crashed into the Asterias Virgo, immense sparks of authorities exploding out in the next moment!
BOOM!
Heavy weavings of Greater Omniversal Authorities were disrupted.
|Hoo...Hoo!|
The rough breaths of the Asterias Virgo could be heard as it gazed towards Noah and Sona, bowing its head slightly as its voice echoed out.
|Erasing the influence and command of the Eonic Uterra is not a feat I can yet achieve...so I thank you.|
Terrifying words echoed out of the Omniversal Pillager as Sona's eyes turned sharp, her intent leaking out.
|Eonic Uterra?|
The words alone seemed to have power.
The moment they were uttered by her and Asterias Virgo, the surrounding reality buzzed as tendrils of tenebrous light burned with intensity!
The starfish shaped Omniversal Pillager gazed around with a sense of unveiled awe and respect and she spoke out with a sense of reverence.
|Yes.
The one who commands the Omniversal Pillagers...The Eonic Uterra!|
WAA!
Many asked whether there was a unified voice behind the Omniversal Pillagers and what it could be.
At this moment, the distinction of Eonic Uterra was heard by the weavings of two unique beings!

chapters.title: Chapter 3066 The Codex! III
paragraphs: An entity behind the terrifying movements of the Omniversal Pillagers.
Sona's face soured at hearing such a thing as Noah gazed at the dispersing Greater Omniversal Authority of Deorcnysse and the Authority of Lux he had utilized to disperse it.
This was all due to the terrifying tool in his hands.
The Codex of Extremity!
This was only the first constructed one as what would happen if he equipped his Quintessential Commanders with a tool like this?
If every one of his people held a Codex capable of allowing them to influence Greater Omniversal Authorities?
A flourishing of extremes is what Noah saw.
To the extent that even the terrifying weavings of Entities like the Eonic Uterra did not seem so unfathomable and fearful!

Noah hadn't even noticed the weavings of its command when it related to Little CaCuLaTan who was fused with his Dominium Body- the influence of a Greater Omniversal Authority hanging above him dispersing the weavings of a command that was sent down to all Omniversal Pillagers.
But all of this aside...Noah looked at the visage of the Asterias Virgo as a glimmer of the brilliance of his Lineage erupted out.
|For you to see the paths of death and even resist the influence of this Eonic Uterra...it is best for you to come under my Banner. Kneel.|
HUUM!
A sentence followed by a single command.
One that the massive starfish-shaped Omniversal Pillager and the splendid humanoid face at its center blinked at before in the next moment...
RIP!

Its skin began to tear as the humanoid face became pushed out and miniaturized, its starfish body becoming infolded and bent as it pointed down while a humanoid upper body with a blessed chest rose to support the rising head!
Reality twisted and distorted as within a moment, the miniaturized visage of an Entity with a humanoid upper body and the lower body of a starfish appeared.

The ends of the starfish of its lowe body pointed down and acted like limbs as this entity came before Noah and Sona to kneel, it'd appearance causing a sense of horror as it contrasted the beautiful upper half of a human with a gorgeous face and a head full dark hair, and a monstrous lower half that pulsed with terrors of old!
|Asterias Virgo pledges her allegiance.|
WU!

The golden light of her Dominium already opened wide as from Noah's figure, tendrils of royal purple tyranny erupted and flowed into her, the glimmer of purple and blue also coming in as he used the backing of the Greater Omniversal Authority of Aitia to bind the Dominium of this Teracosm Stage Omniversal Pillager.
After this was done...
|Alright, what is this thing that even those above the Teracosm Stage would want?|

His intent flowed out powerfully white the eyes of Asterias Virgo were buzzing at feeling the new Existential Extremity Authorities flowing into her- along with the boons that came with being a vassal of the Weaver of Existence!
She nearly stumbled on her answer as she straightened herself before replying.

|Rhynchactis, Cephalopoda Prima, and I discovered a point of Omniversal Singularity that initially seemed like a normal Unstable Anomalous Existential Domain. But it was too big, and the pressure it released was suffocating even for us. When we delved past the instability, we saw the weavings of over nine million different Existential Extremity Authorities moving together and coming apart as towards the depths of this singularity, there was actually a Seed of a Greater Omniversal Authority budding. One so powerful that even we couldn't get too close.|
A Seed of a Greater Omniversal Authority!

One that held an approximate weaving of nine million Existential Authorities as just the Greater Omniversal Authority of Lux held there million, and the Greater Omniversal Authority of Deorcnysse held a little bit more!
Even Sona's pupils dilated at these weavings as her expression turned thoughtful.

|A Seed of a Greater Omniversal Authority...if we can obtain it before the Omniversal Authority fully forms, we gain more than just recognition. We gain a level of control over an Omniversal Authority that can greatly affect the Omniverse, especially if its weavings are this complex.|
Asterias Virgo nodded at Sona's words and continued.

|The Eonic Uterra showed interest in it and sent those familiar with Greater Omniversal Authorities there, with I, Rhynchactis, and Cephalopoda Prima not being capable of delving closer or any deeper into the depths of this area as we were stationed within the Nest of Turbidity. Information about it was masked under the influence of Greater Omniversal Authorities as nothing about its weavings would be left behind even if we were to fall to enemies.|
Sona looked towards Noah with a difficult gaze as she debated on this opportunity and continuing their path of obtaining more members of the Initiative.
Their Enemy was still just an Unknown Source right now, but they at least had a target as she still believed it could be overcome with the weavings of terrifying anomalies!
Before the choice could be made though, Noah asked, Noah asked Asterias Virgo.
|What are the coordinates of this unique anomaly?|

Towards Noah's question, Asterias Virgo looked around as if she expected thunderous lightning of the Greater Omniversal Authority of Deorcnysse to descend, but it seemed to be held at bay as she waved her hands to release a cluster of dark light that Noah absorbed and broke down!
He then turned towards the figure of Sona beside him as he asked her.
|And what are the coordinates of your Imperium twins?|
His face showed a bright devilish smile.
And as if she could understand its meaning, Sona's pupils dilated.
{The Extremity of Plot laughs with wonder as it spreads its weavings into Causality, Luck, Possibility, Manipulation, and Probability!}
Noah's extremes buzzed.
Sona shared weavings of what she had uncovered and seen since a while ago as she muttered out with shining eyes.
|The Twins should be following Legions of the Imperium spreading out towards nests of Omniversal Pillagers. If somehow...|
If things really flowed in the direction that this man before her intended, then just...
Damn.
This was the only word she could say as she saw the weavings of Causality begin to be distorted around them!

chapters.title: Chapter 3067 The Codex! IV
paragraphs: Causality.
Cause and effect.
Probabilities of what could happen or may not happen depending on the actions one took!
More often than not, those who could manipulate Causality were masterminds behind the countless weavings occurring across the eons.
At this moment in time.
Somewhere within the Omniverse.
Standing in front of entire Imperium Legions, a man shrouded in multicolored light holding a crimson spear looked straight ahead with interminable splendor.
Behind him, 100 Legions led by Teracosm Stage Entities and filled with Teleios Stage Entities floated with immeasurable splendor, with every single one simply waiting for his word to move!
Around them, Tendrils of calm weavings of the Omniverse floated as in a few moments...
SHAA!
A figure blazing with pronounced golden splendor of Teracosm appeared beside the man holding the crimson spear as he spoke with great respect.

|Martial Emperor Xi, out of the weavings of three possible Nests, we have latched onto the feedback of a massive nest- one that may be hiding a great deal of Omniversal Pillagers. I just don't know whether we should proceed or wait for Martial Emperor Vadais and his Legions...|
Weavings calmly flowed.
Tendrils of a Greater Omniversal Authority were behind it, but they were so subtle as if this was the proper flow of events!
Martial Emperor Xi gazed at the report of the Martial King before him as he waved his hand while his authority began to blaze.
|Nothing is too big unless we deem it so. Let's go.|
WAA!
A glimmer of brilliance.
And one Legion after another began to disappear as they followed the instructions of the weavings of Martial Emperor Xi!
Among these Legions, there was one that had in the lead two entities with eerie similarities.
A male and a female with nearly the same mannerisms and looks.
Each with their own grace and beauty, it was a pair of twins that also calmly followed the weavings laid out moments later!
All of these weavings were seeking to flow toward a place filled with heavy swirls of darkness.
In such a place, multiple crimson eyes opened at the same time and gazed at each other.
Each one was filled with heavy intensity as intents flowed amongst each other.
|Vile intents come our way.|
|We are not ready, we have just made headway into the center...|
|They cannot come close. Nobody can interfere!|
HUUM!
Tenebrous authorities mixed in and exploded as...
|Alert the others.|
|The Eonic Uterra instructed complete and utmost success, we cannot fail!|
Coilings of Lesser and Greater Omniversal Authorities erupted.
Along with it, millions of Existential Extremity Authorities erupted out with fervor and complexity!
At the same time.
Far away from here.
Near the Nest of Turbidity.
Noah opened his eyes as waves of prompts cascaded down.
{The Weavings of Plot cheer with immeasurable clarity.}
Plot.
With a little push from Causality, Noah made it so that...
|It looks like both this opportunity and the next members of the Initiative are going to be at the same place.|
His Invictus Dominium Wings pulsed with slightly dim radiance as they already began to recover.
Beside him, Sona nodded her head while preparing as she didn't give this man beside her too many praises, or his head might get even bigger than it already was!
After all, too many praises had been given for his techniques these past hours.
As she thought of this, Sona felt a sense of rising anger at herself for being lost in it. Who was she? She couldn't allow him to take such free control next time!
With these emotions in mind, her fist clenched and constructed a massive white rift of frost in front of their eyes.
|Let's go.|
WAA!
Her words were simple as behind Noah and her figure, Asterias Virgo gathered along with the Illusory Weavings of multiple Teracosm Stage and Teleios Stage Entities!
And moments after, the figure of Little CaCuLaTan was returned in front of Noah's Dominion Soul by his Dominium Body, all parties being present here as in the next moment...
WAP!
Their figures disappeared into the rift of frost.
All around them, it seemed as if they were traversing across a reality of frost as the figure of Little CaCuLaTan bounced around like a furball as it excitedly asked.
|Big Sis, Big Boss, where are we going now? I heard a voice almost reach me to go somewhere. It seemed a little mean...|

Sona raised her brows at Little CaCuLaTan's intent as she replied while taking steps forward- with all of them actually utilizing her Source of Psychros to traverse across the Omniverse towards their location.
|We are gonna kidnap two little twins and convert them to the right cause, at the same time, there is a Seed of a Greater Omniversal Authority to grasp.|
The words only caused Little CaCuLaTan to bounce even more, as if excited and wondering exactly how a Seed of an Omniversal Authority tasted!
At the same time, Noah with his transparent Quintessential Codex of Extremity in hand looked like a missionary that was ready to convert all entities into his cause!
Their weavings pulsed and attained their optimum states as their bodies traversed across the Omniverse.
And after minutes passed...
WAP!
Reality twisted and distorted one final time as they stepped out of the path of glacial frost and appeared on the fringes of dark space.
On the fringes.
It had to be the fringe as when they gazed toward the very center, a wondrous scene could be observed.
For vast stretches of reality, everything seemed torn and unveiled as storms of multicolored Existential Extremity Authorities by the millions could be seen chaotically moving around.
In front of them, there were innumerable and massive figures of Omniversal Pillagers with ecstatic power!
And standing opposite to them, Legions of the Imperium pulsing with heavy waves of regal authority.
It was their arrival before one of the first battlefields of a war in its beginning stages.
And looking at it all before him...
Noah couldn't help but lick his lips!

chapters.title: Chapter 3068 The Codex! V
paragraphs: Martial Emperor Xi gazed at the scene ahead of him as around him, multiple Martial Kings blazing with golden brilliance were letting their intent be known with shining eyes.

|We have actually come across a finding of the Omniversal Pillagers that they haven't been able to extricate yet. Gazing at the chaotic weavings of those millions of Existential Extremity Authorities they protect behind them...we have likely come across a budding Seed!|
WAA!
The words caused a sense of wonder and glory to rise as Martial Emperor Xi nodded, his spear beginning to vibrate as his commands came out- a chilling smile creeping on his lips!

|Other Legions are on their way...meanwhile, we shall see if we can pierce through their defenses and enter this Anomalous Space ourselves to take a look at this budding Seed. As of this moment, our task is not the eradication of these Omniversal Pillagers- but the securing and ownership of this Seed of a Greater Omniversal Authority ahead of us!|
|HO!|
Shouts of affirmation bellowed out as the Legions of entities behind him let out a resonant bellow of power!

The Exclusive Existential Extremity Authority of the Imperium burned with golden radiance all around them as it only illuminated everything ahead of them, showing the Titanic figures of Omniversal Pillagers in rows and rows stretching out all around.
|Encircle.|
HUUM!
The command of Martial Emperor Xi boomed out as the Legions behind him parted and spread out like a golden tide.
Their Existential Armaments glinted in the dark space as the Martial Kings leading them began to glow with the wondrous light of none other than the influence of Omniversal Authorities!
Some Greater.
A few Lesser.
But their power was air tight as they moved with terrifying precision.

Against them, monstrosities were lined up as everything about them seemed haphazard, and yet five rainbow colored titans shrouded in tenebrous darkness seemed immovable at this moment as at the forefront, there was an Entity with a massive humanoid visage- its limbs being massive squid like tentacles while a crimson eye burned brightly on its chest.
|O Great Oneiros.|
HUUM!
His voice was deep and booming.
The Legions of the Imperium that were basked in golden light and spreading out felt a heavy sense of suffocation thereafter as in the next moment...
WU! WU! WU!

A violet beam of a Greater Omniversal Authority so immeasurably massive cascaded down, the humanoid Omniversal Pillager spread its tentacles out wide as its eye received the massive beam of light and basked in it.

The weavings of millions upon millions of Existential Extremity Authorities seethed with this Greater Omniversal Authority of Oneiros as it held far more than many other Greater Omniversal Authorities!
And the person calling upon it...was utterly dreadful as the massive eye of the Omniversal Pillagers began to bleed while its intent rang out.
|O Great Oneiros...turn everything into an endless apocalyptic dream.|
WAA!
A single intent.
And in the next moment, clouds of pulsing violet brilliance bloomed with it at the center and only spread outwards from there.
Towards everything.
Covering everything!

The Imperium Legions were alarmed as the figure of Martial Emperor Xi moved right away, an untold golden brilliance erupting out in opposition while this endless blanket of violet apocalyptic clouds bathed everything!
Far away from this unfolding reality.
HUUM!

Violet clouds filled with millions of interweaving Existential Extremity Authorities as if they were spitting on the face of the Dynamis of Extremity that entities could entangle with very few numbers spread out even towards this direction.

Noah's visage could be seen shrouded with Sona, Asterias Virgo, Little CaCuLaTan, and the many Illusory Weavings in this space as the blanketing of an apocalyptic dream arrived even here unfathomably quickly.

|All those under the expanse of the Illusory Sleeping Omniverse of Oneiros will constantly have the debuff effect of Omniversal Slumbering applied to them and their Existential Extremity Authorities- their very records and existence being pushed towards an endless slumber, with this effect only being more pronounced the closer one is to the source of Oneiros.|

chapters.title: Chapter 3069 Pompeii! I
paragraphs: Close to 10 Million Existential Extremity Authorities contained within it.

It was one of the grandest Greater Omniversal Authorities Noah had come across yet as wondrously, the Codex of Extremity captured its weavings the same as the Greater Omniversal Authorities of Deorcnysse and Lux!
But the cost for it was the highest yet as Noah's Dominium Soul squeezed out its Authority.

|The Complex Weavings and computations of the 9,999,999 Existential Authorities within the Greater Omniversal Authority of Oneiros are being studied for gaps to disentangle and disrupt its immovable weaving.|
|The sheer glory of the Greater Omniversal Authority of Oneiros is unfathomably high!|
Glory!
It was something distinguished constructs emanated as even Noah himself emanated waves of profound glory!
Something that would make it hard for others with lesser presence and glory to even gaze up at him.

Yet now, the Greater Omniversal Authority of Oneiros held such a high level of Glory that Noah felt the Quintessential Codex of Extremity in his hands buzzing while it drew more and more of his reserves of power.
|Your authority is capable of withstanding the cost.|
|The Quintessential Codex of Extremity is capable of accepting the responsibility and carrying out its established uses.|
|A complementary and opposing Omniversal Authority capable of disrupting the Weavings of the Greater Omniversal Authority of Oneiros is being sought after.|
|The Quintessential Codex of Extremity is capable of accepting the responsibility and carrying out its established uses.|
|A complementary and opposing Omniversal Authority capable of disrupting the Weavings of the Greater Omniversal Authority of Oneiros is being sought after.|
|The Greater Omniversal Authority of Realis has been recognized.|
|The Greater Omniversal Authority of Realis has been recorded in the Quintessential Codex of Extremity!|
Realis!
The moment the Codex of Extremity found an opposing Omniversal Authority and began to call out to it, its colorless light faded and was instead replaced by terrifying multicolored brightness!
The opposite of dreams.
The opposite of Oneiros!
The Greater Omniversal Authority of Realis appeared as akin to a beam of blazing multicolored right came down and burned the violet brilliance of Oneiros in the surroundings above Noah and others.
|Approximately 11,111,111 Existential Extremity Authorities flow with complex weavings to make up the Greater Omniversal Authority of Realis.|
|The Greater Omniversal Authority of Realis has a tremendously high cost of influencing through the Quintessential Codex of Extremity, but it remains possible.|

The multicolored light thundered down until it reached Noah, Sona, and the others- the influence of Oneiros and the debuffs that were beginning to wrap around them like endless tendrils of slumbering dreams rebounding at this moment!
And as Noah's existence felt the flow of millions of Existential Extremity Authorities coursing through him and the Quintessential Codex of Extremity as in the next moment...
|An Astounding Achievement!|
The surroundings vibrated.

|It is unknown how many Entities have managed to gain the influence of the Greater Omniversal Authority of Realis, but the number is low enough to the extent that depending on the next course of actions, recognition of this Omniversal Authority towards you may become possible!|
|Ah...| A possibility of wonder arose before Noah.
One of the terrifying uses of the Quintessential Codex of Extremity showed itself.
Through it, one could gain the recognition of Omniversal Authorities if they met certain conditions!
How hard was it to gain recognition of an Omniversal Authority?
One of the more accessible and yet terrifying one was an advanced Omniversal Organ generating this possibility.
But with this Codex of Extremity in Noah's hands...
|Ho!|

His terrifying thoughts were disrupted as the multicolored light of The Greater Omniversal Authority of Realis wrapped around him and all those around him, Sona's body buzzing as the icy blue light of an Omniversal Authority was finally able to course over her tightly, the glow of Realis also wrapping around it as wondrously, she began to control the flow of one to move the other and penetrate deeper into the violet clouds that had descended around them.

Such a concept meant that Tendrils of icy multicolored glacial lights began to form multiple paths into the violet clouds ahead, with Sona's voice echoing out as if she could see which pathway may be best.
|I'll illuminate the way!|
Noah controlled the flow of Realis through the Codex of Extremity as all the negative effects of the violet weavings of Oneiros were disrupted.
At the same time, Sona's visage pointed forward and caused an icy path of multicolored frost form- their figures coursing through it at this moment as they delved towards the chaotic battlefield!
Everything around them seemed to be covered by waves of endless apocalyptic dreams.
And the closer they went...
ROAAR!
The violet light of Oneiros seemed to get ever so concentrated as even more of Noah's Dominium had to be drawn out to keep the bright brilliance of Realis protecting them.
And as they delved deeper, part of Noah's will was looking at the Records of both the Greater Omniversal Authority of Realis and of Oneiros that were being analyzed and recorded in real time.
His gains from knowing the records and identities of millions of Existential Extremity Authorities...was going to be insurmountable!
BZZT!
At this moment.
The reality around them seemed to change as the clashing and weaving of multiple extremes arched around like serpents.
And the Quintessential Codex of Extremity buzzed as if it had encountered something grand!
|You have stepped into the domain of something filled with interminable Glory.|
|Weavings of the periphery of this Domain are being discerned.|
HUUM!
The seemingly simple book in Noah's hands pulsed.
His Dominium and even Invictus Dominium Wings buzzed as they were pulled in with a semblance of their authority!
And his eyes became immeasurably bright as if he could finally see.
|You have stepped into the Greater Omniversal Domain of Pompeii.|
|In the Greater Omniversal Domain of Pompeii, unknown weavings and possibilities lie within!|
Such wondrous prompts arose as in the next moment...
|KAA!|
The flowing path of ice they followed crashed and illuminated a massive figure of an Omniversal Pillager.

Its limbs were shaped like massive crimson axes as its Ox like body burned with a bright golden authority, and it was clashing against two Legions of the Imperium that all simultaneously turned to lock onto their newly arriving figures- these Legions looking a little bloodied as the Exclusive Existential Extremity Authority of the Imperium tried to fight off the heavy influence of Oneiros!

chapters.title: Chapter 3070 Pompeii! II
paragraphs: Within the bounds of the Greater Omniversal Domain of Pompeii.
First, one had to have a semblance of understanding regarding an Omniversal Domain to truly understand where the Legions of the Imperium and Omniversal Pillagers were currently in.
A Greater Omniversal Domain.
Its root cause or source was the Greater Omniversal Domain of Pompeii- which meant that this was the authority of the Seed of the Omniversal Authority that was currently budding within this space!
Its complex weavings were many.

Millions of Existential Extremity Authorities flowed as Pompeii...seemed to either be at the same level if not more majestic that the Greater Omniversal Authorities of Oneiros and Realis that Noah had just come across.

And all of them were being analyzed by the terrifying Quintessential Codex of Extremity in his hands while within his Dominium, Manadynamics seethed with cerulean splendor to freely give out the resources required to allow him to influence the Greater Omniversal Authority of Realis to protect them.
Yes.
Mana was still his forte.
He still had an infinite amount of it!
And as he acclimated to the new realm of Existential Dominium, this truth was becoming re-established more and more as the tools that got him here gained free reign.
None more so than Entropy and Manadynamics.
None more so than Infinity.

Since even before the construct of the Codex of Extremity, the fervor of the Existential Extremity Authority of Entropy was only rising within the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed as it seemed to resonate with the larger Omniverse itself.
And it still wasn't done.

But along with his endless Mana that could power up his Dominium, his Omniversal Organ that could distort Causality, Quintessential Codex of Extremity, and the Innate Existential Causality Defense wrapped around him...Noah moved with confidence.
When they came across the massive visage of an Ox like Omniversal Pillager and a battered Legion of the Imperium, Noah's body continued to freely move forward!

The Omniversal Pillager was the most dangerous as it could deal 1,000% more damage to others under the Illusory Sleeping Omniverse of Oneiros, but Noah didn't stop his momentum and came directly in front of it while holding the bow multicolored Codex of Extremity in his hands.
ROAAR!
A bellow was heard as at this stage, moves occurred within the span of an instant.
A massive limb formed like a crimson axe was before Noah's small figure right away, and yet he looked immensely calm and did not retaliate in any way.
BZZT!
Inches away from smashing into him, auroras of Tendrils of light buzzed as his Innate Existential Causality Defense flourished with brilliance!
Causality was passively twisted and distorted.
Noah didn't face the debuffs of the Greater Omniversal Domain of Oneiros as the weavings of Realis surrounded him, so this Teracosm Stage Entity was only that to him!

Seeing the baffling situation where its massive limbs were supposed to smash onto this being and yet they didn't go any further, the Omniversal Pillager was about to make another move while the Imperium Legions opposite it got a chance to breathe.
Yet in the next moment...
|There is a high probability of your death...|
The intent of Noah weaved out as on the oxen head of the Omniversal Pillager, its pupils vibrated.
Noah wanted to see how powerful he had gotten without utilizing the complete Causality effect of the Invictus Dominium Wings.
So weavings of his Extremes moved alone as the Extremity of Probability shone with a deep purple hue!
|And since nothing on you is Quintessential...how can your authorities even operate?|
A simple question.
Yet the body of the massive Omniversal Pillager further trembled as a Colorless light of Quintessence came to surround it!
Alongside it, the weavings of the Greater Omniversal Authority of Realis surged around it and dismembered the buffs of Onerios this being received- the full effects of Noah's extremes landing on it.
Its circulation of extremes began to waver and slow.
The defenses of its Dominium slowly came to a halt in a shocking show of power, its crimson eyes buzzing as it stared at the small being before it!
Shrouded in a multicolored Emperor's Robe with multicolored rivers of light swirling around him.
A pair of purple gold wings on his back and feet.
And at the end, the Oxen Omniversal Pillagers looked at this being's eyes.
His eyes...were innumerably bright.
They were currently shining with an endless blue hue of wonder.
|You dare to stare straight into the eyes of Infinity.|
HUUM!
An eruption of cerulean light bloomed.
How powerful was Noah now?
After devouring multiple Teracosm Stage Entities and even the dual cultivation with someone as unique as Sona...
His Existential Extremity Authorities alone held a tremendous amount of power.
Especially after he tapped into one of the Four Components of the Greater Omniversal Authority of Aitia and increased the efficiency of these concepts!
Infinity was one of the concepts whose extremes were now heading towards a place even he didn't know fully well.
|A target has stared into the endless sea of Infinity.|
|Unable to comprehend it and filled with an endless flow of weavings, its existence becomes increasingly overwhelmed until everything about its Existential Dominium breaks down.|
|From the weavings of Infinity, the Existential Omniversal Pupils of Infinity have been born and activated for the first time.|

|So long as any Entity designated as a target stares into your eyes, they will be blinded by the glimpse of Infinity as depending on their level of power, everything about their existence may be overwhelmed entirely as they cease to operate, or they could combat the endless weavings of Infinity until they ultimately fall.|
A shocking blue hue shone within Noah's eyes as it seemed to expand towards the horizon.
And when this light faded, the massive body of the Oxen Omniversal had frozen as its crimson eyes...were now bathed with an endless blue.
Yet it was not moving.
Its Dominium was no longer circulating!
The golden glow of Teracosm had entirely stopped moving around it as it seemed to have stalled and solidified!
And against such a being, Noah waved his hands as its massive body twisted and came towards him, disappearing into nothingness as within the next moment, it appeared within his Infinite Forge.
It was a shocking scene as from behind, Sona whistled while surrounded by icy brilliance.
After his recent upgrades...Noah's power was ascertained!
