A pair of purple gold wings on his back and feet.
And at the end, the Oxen Omniversal Pillagers looked at this being's eyes.
His eyes...were innumerably bright.
They were currently shining with an endless blue hue of wonder.
|You dare to stare straight into the eyes of Infinity.|
HUUM!
An eruption of cerulean light bloomed.
How powerful was Noah now?
After devouring multiple Teracosm Stage Entities and even the dual cultivation with someone as unique as Sona...
His Existential Extremity Authorities alone held a tremendous amount of power.
Especially after he tapped into one of the Four Components of the Greater Omniversal Authority of Aitia and increased the efficiency of these concepts!
Infinity was one of the concepts whose extremes were now heading towards a place even he didn't know fully well.
|A target has stared into the endless sea of Infinity.|
|Unable to comprehend it and filled with an endless flow of weavings, its existence becomes increasingly overwhelmed until everything about its Existential Dominium breaks down.|
|From the weavings of Infinity, the Existential Omniversal Pupils of Infinity have been born and activated for the first time.|

|So long as any Entity designated as a target stares into your eyes, they will be blinded by the glimpse of Infinity as depending on their level of power, everything about their existence may be overwhelmed entirely as they cease to operate, or they could combat the endless weavings of Infinity until they ultimately fall.|
A shocking blue hue shone within Noah's eyes as it seemed to expand towards the horizon.
And when this light faded, the massive body of the Oxen Omniversal had frozen as its crimson eyes...were now bathed with an endless blue.
Yet it was not moving.
Its Dominium was no longer circulating!
The golden glow of Teracosm had entirely stopped moving around it as it seemed to have stalled and solidified!
And against such a being, Noah waved his hands as its massive body twisted and came towards him, disappearing into nothingness as within the next moment, it appeared within his Infinite Forge.
It was a shocking scene as from behind, Sona whistled while surrounded by icy brilliance.
After his recent upgrades...Noah's power was ascertained!

chapters.title: Chapter 3071 Pompeii! III
paragraphs: Noah's visage then came to the focus of the injured Imperium Legion as at its lead, there was a Teracosm Stage Martial King followed by a few hundred Teleios Stage Entities.
Their bodies still pulsed with power and care as the Martial King's visage carefully spoke out.
|What might the intentions of young friend be?|
They were not fools.

They had lived for too long to be fools as they couldn't see the glow of the Imperium on these beings, and there were even two Omniversal Pillagers behind the cold beauty behind this man who had killed an Omniversal Pillager that was wiping the floor with them!
At their words, Noah turned and smiled devilishly at the first targets that had appeared before him.
|My intentions...are destructive ones, old friend.|
WU!
The gazes of the Imperium Knights shifted as golden brilliance erupted from them an instant later.

The Martial King who was acting as a commander held a Existential Armament in the form of a golden sword, swinging it towards Noah's visage as the weavings of an Omniversal Authority sought to gather!
But how could it freely gather under the influence of the Sleeping Omniverse of Oneiros?

And opposite it, an endlessly blue light emerged with just as much intensity as the Existential Omniversal Emperor appeared within the tug of war at the fringes of the Greater Omniversal Domain of Pompeii with a bang.
His gaze was far reaching as within the span of an instant, the Teleios Stage Entities within the Legions became frozen with their authorities no longer moving.
Blue brilliance shone in their eyes as if they were mesmerized, their Existential Dominiums no longer moving as the Martial King ahead of them bellowed out!
|Do not stare at his visage!|
His eyes were pointed down as he evaded the brilliant blue pupils, giving a command to his Legion that really wouldn't help them at this point in time!
He was going to-
WAP!
The figure of Noah teleported across the space filled with violet clouds and appeared right in front of the Martial King.

His hand forcefully reached out and broke past the Exclusive Existential Extremity Authority around this man as he grasped his head, raising this head forcefully while ignoring the golden blade that the was swinging towards him.
|Ah....| The voice of the Martial King leaked out as his eyes now reflected seas of blue light.
He trembled as he felt his own Dominium no longer listen to him, everything slowing down and disappearing as they only saw an expanse of blue.
An expanse of Infinity!
And moments later, his pupils became glazed with a sparkling blue light as all movements ceased.
It was never this easy to bring down a Teracosm Stage Entity- especially any of their powerful Martial Kings!
But Noah's power was great.
And the effects of the Greater Omniversal Authority of Oneiros were even greater!
Noah looked at the frozen figure of the Martial King that was no longer moving, waving his hand as this frozen Teracosm Martial King disappeared into his Infinite Forge soon after.
He then gazed towards the rolling violet clouds all around as Sona appeared beside him along with Asterias Virgo and Little CaCuLaTan.
|The twins we need to convert are deeper in, but the focus seems like it has to be shifted, this Greater Omniversal Domain of Pompeii seems to be bigger than initially thought.|
Her eyes were piercing and gazing at the path ahead as from behind, Asterias Virgo's starfish tentacles wiggled for her lower body while she interjected.

|I was going to say that the Pillagers sent here are all like me or greater. The one who released this apocalyptic Domain of Oneiros is known as a Greater Omniversal Pillager. Their authority is boundlessly vast as they can easily control the influence of multiple powerful Omniversal Authorities. And they weren't the only ones from the Little I got a chance to observe.|
WAA!
Enemies all around in a terrible Domain.
Enemies ahead and even more Legions of the Imperium had to be coming from behind.
And the Greater Omniversal Domain of Pompeii itself seemed to hold big secrets!
All of it just made Noah smile with a light of interest in what it could be as he made his choice.
|Let's delve into the depths of Pompeii and see what the fuss is, the twins can come after.|
Sona nodded at his words as she brought her palms together and performed quick hand motion, the frozen path they were walking on twisting and beginning to change its weavings as it pointed elsewhere!
|The most optimum path into the depths of the Greater Omniversal Domain of Pompeii, with the least amount of distractions.|
The glow of a Greater Omniversal Authority burned in her eyes as with Noah in the lead, they continued.
As if Noah didn't just pause briefly and decimate a few hundred Teleios Stage Entities and two Teracosm Stage Entities!
SHAA!

They crossed deeper into the chaotic weavings of thousands of Existential Extremity Authorities all around them, and tens of thousands more the deeper they went as they didn't come across any Imperium Legions or Omniversal Pillager.
And after a few minutes...
BOOM!

Noah who was at the forefront smashed into and pierced some sort of a veil, the chaotic weavings of Existential Extremity Authorities instantly ceasing in this region as they became more complex and stable.

Space seemed to be a hue of silver gray stellar light mixed in with the violet taint of Oneiros, with fantastical tout Pillars of silver brilliance spinning ahead of them in all directions as it seemed like a gauntlet!

Mangled bodies of Teleios and Teracosm Stage Omniversal Pillagers could be seen in the region outside and inside these countless spinning silver Pillars of light, some of them seeming drenched in blood.
Uniquely, the bodies of all mangled Omniversal Pillagers had taken on a hue of ash silver as they seemed to almost be similar to stone- as if they were eventually petrified!

Noah and Sona appeared in such a space as the Quintessential Codex of Extremity gathered the weavings of the details in the surroundings which along with Noah's own distinction as the Weaver...allowed for unique prompts to rise before his eyes.
|You have left the Outer Domain of Pompeii and entered the Inner Domain of Pompeii.|
|With every passing nanosecond, the Omniversal Weavings of an unknown influence will force any form of existence to undergo Existential Petrification.|

chapters.title: Chapter 3072 Pompeii! IV
paragraphs: As Noah made his entry into the depths of a unique domain filled with dangers, weavings somewhat relating to him continued to unfold elsewhere.
In another region of the Omniverse.
Within the bounds of Cappadocia that used to belong to Martial King Reperiel.
Auroras of blue and gold flowed as at this moment, the weavings of the Imperium had to continue.
Even a pristine Existential Domain like this could not remain without a leader as with war breaking out, most of the renowned Martial Kings were delegated to join it one after another.
Those who could be spared....were not the strongest nor highest quality of Martial Kings.
At this moment in time, deep within Cappadocia.
Within the Mines of Cappadocia, the figures of a dozen Entities were roaming around while gazing at the stellar Progress of mining all around them.

At the forefront was a chubby man who looked at the stellar rising crimson and blue mountains holding dense resources, a weak golden light of Teracosm shining around his body as he looked at the countless workers still mining all across these mountains.
A smile covered his lips as he spoke.
|They continue to mine as if this was the purpose of their whole life...not even knowing of another war that has just started.|

The chubby Martial King spoke as the golden robes around him fluttered, the Teleios Stage Knights of Cappadocia who were showing him the land he temporarily ruled over only gazing at each other with wry smiles as they waited to continue!
But at this time...
|Oh?|
The brows of the newly selected Martial King of Cappadocia rose as in the distance, he saw a cluster of prisoners sitting at the base of a blue mountain doing nothing.
Even more so, they seemed to be lounging around while staring around freely, one of them even gazing up at them with wild disrespect!
Such a scene caused the chubby Martial King to squint his eyes as he began to float down towards this mountain.
|Where is the warden for this region? Why are prisoners lounging around freely as if they own the palace?|
The words deserved an answer as the Teleios Stage Knights of Cappadocia gazed at the unique scene with slight confusion as one replied.
|Some Wardens had to be recalled and moved out to the War, Martial King Adonis, but there should still be...|
There should still be Wardens covering the vast mines of Cappadocia.
This was what the Knight of Cappadocia wanted to say.
But when his will gazed around, he came to a stark realization that he actually couldn't see any of the Wardens of the Mines of Cappadocia!
What was this?

Amidst the confusion, their figures arrived at the bottom of the mountain shining with cerulean light, crystalline materials strewn out all around them as Martial King Adonis held his nose in contempt while speaking out towards the ragtag group of prisoners just lounging around.
|You utter wastes of Existence think it's okay to just lounge around? Do you truly think you can keep your status as Prisoners unless you do work?|
His words were sharp as they were directed to all prisoners here- but especially so towards an old looking man who was sitting down at the very center of this group!
His dark hair was sprawled out behind his back messily as his dark eyes seemed disoriented, Martial King Adonis gazing at him with distaste as this was a captured Dragon Knight of the Sanctum Populi.
He was a really high tier one at that as if his Dominium wasn't sealed, one would be able to see a powerful glow of gold to signify Teracosm, and yet here he was.
Simply as a prisoner to mine within Cappadocia.
The figure of this old man seemed tired and defeated as Adonis came towards him while his intent echoed out.

|A new ruler has now descended in Cappadocia after your people ambushed the great Martial King Reperiel. Things will no longer remain the same here...the output of these mines will be increased as you all...|
His will gazed around all the prisoners here with distaste as he was speaking when...
|Oh?|
He blinked as his gaze became locked onto the figure of a silver-white haired woman with shocking grace and beauty amongst all the prisoners here.
She looked tired.
She looked apathetic.
But her beauty...
|Haha, why the hell were you put in the mines? Hey, bring this one to my chambers. With a face like that and a sealed Dominium, I can use her for many nights before she is broken.|
He spoke while pointing to the visage of none other than the jailed Basileus Anaine.
As she was stripped of her position as a Basileus by Martial King Reperiel, she was currently just Anaine!
She gazed up at the eyes filled with a light of lust that had locked onto her as she shook her head as if she were looking at a bug.
And Martial King Adonis saw this as...
|You-|
He began walking towards her with a sense of cruelty in his eyes, but all of a sudden, something unbelievable occurred.
SQUELCH!
From his back, a hand pierced through and came out of his chest.

Confusion was the first emotion that came as he and the Teleios Stage Entities following him came across this reality, their wills acclimating to see the figure of the old Dragon Knight having somehow risen and used his hand to pierce the chest of Martial King Adonis!
The weakness from this Entity had long since faded as he looked straight into the eyes of the turning Adonis who now became incredulous.
|Your...sealed...Dominium...|
They should have no power.
Their Dominiums should be sealed.
So what...
|Ah, there are always exceptions, my dirty friend. Thanks for coming down though, it is about time for me to leave and begin expanding out there.|
WAA!
The voice coming out of the old man was a unique one.

It felt young as at this moment, tendrils of blue light burned brightly in the eyes of the old Dragon Knight, the will of the Great Usurper, Noah Eckert, burning brightly as tendrils of his weavings went towards the replacement ruler of the vast Existential Domain of Cappadocia!

chapters.title: Chapter 3073 Pompeii! V
paragraphs: |Hmm...freedom!|
Outside of the Existential Mines of Cappadocia.

Martial King Adonis held eyes radiating blue tendrils of light as he looked out at the expanse of Planes of Existence and countless domains around him, the Will and controller of his Dominium currently being someone else entirely as all of his Records, Extremes, and Existence were under someone else's control!
All were under the control of the Great Usurper.

With his eyes acclimating to his new vision, Noah Eckert gazed behind him to see the tattered visage of the old Dragon Knight he had taken over with much difficulty, but it catapulted him where he was right now as everything was worth it!
His gaze eventually came to land on the visage of Basileus Anaine as he smiled.
|Used and discarded by my old friend, do you still share hatred, Little Anaine?|
Eckert asked calmly even though he knew the answer.
He didn't leave behind any loopholes as even Anaine...held traces of his oppressive will inside of her!
And within her, he felt the weavings of and controlled Vitalis.
From the old Dragon Knight, he felt the weavings of and controlled Dignity, Knighthood, Valor, and more Existential Extremity Authorities!

From Martial King Adonis, he could feel the weavings of the Exclusive Existential Extremity Authority of the Imperium along with multiple other Existential Extremes, his eyes already looking far ahead to a glorious future.
Other beings were limited in how many Existential Extremes they held in their Dominium as this number was never too high.

But if he could continue Dominating the souls of his Enemies and expand his will into the Dominiums of hundreds, thousands, or even millions of Entities of the Existential Dominium Realm...would he not grasp the weavings of and control hundreds of thousands or even millions of Existential Extremity Authorities?
Would he not be able to put together the complex weavings of an Omniversal Authority all by himself?

While others were looking to gain the influence of an Omniversal Authority, he could bring together all those he dominated and gully unleash not a mere influence- but the true power of an Omniversal Authority!
|Mmm...| He went towards the center of Cappadocia where a few Legions of the Imperium still remained as he was expectant of the future.
After all, what better time could there be to grow in power if not in times of war?
And most of all, what about a certain someone?
The weavings of a certain entity circled within his mind as he gazed back briefly past the boundaries of Cappadocia towards the Unknown.
He wondered.
'How far ahead are you, Osmont?'
A competitive spirit still welled up inside of him.
There were many things to be done if he wanted to stand a chance!
|First of all, Little Sister, Europa...it is time for you all to make your return.|
WAA!
From the depths of his Existential System.
Those he cared deeply for were waiting to come out this whole time!
Entry into the Inner Domain of Pompeii!
This restricted space showed a great deal of events occurring as the Omniversal Pillagers who had been seeking entry deeper in had a great deal of casualties here.
The spilling Pillars of ash silver light rotated like stanchions of celestial light, covering everything from top to bottom and stretching out on all sides without end.

One had to cross these dangerous spinning Pillars of light if they wanted to make any headway, and the Omniversal Pillagers showed that they were relentless in this pursuit as even after all this time, dozens of Omniversal Pillagers could be seen right outside the region of this dangerous place as a few moved forward and entered the gauntlet every now and then!

Beside him, Sona clicked her lips as they all gazed at this while feeling the oppressive Authority in the surroundings that if one didn't spend a great deal of resources, their existence may just begin to petrify.
|The deeper one goes in, the more concentrated the wonders of the Seed of a Greater Omniversal Authority are. But I didn't expect it to be such a bloodbath...|
Her words echoed out as Noah agreed with them, gazing ahead as he sent his own weavings out!
|Pompeii...|
This was the name of this Domain.
It was also the distinction of the Seed of the Omniversal Authority that was budding here.
He wanted to know.
Why were the Omniversal Pillagers doing everything in their power trying to get behind these dangerous spinning stanchions of light?
Just what lay behind all this danger that even those above Teracosm would wished to get their hands on it?!
|Show me.|
He spoke out with a booming voice as Causality began to twist and distort.
There were possibilities of realities where he would make it past these spinning stanchions of light.
What would he find once he did so?
HUUM!
His Invictus Dominium Wings buzzed as in front of him, a singular massive illusory screen of light arose.
It pulled the gazes of everyone here as on this screen, the endless spinning stanchions of light were shown...and then bypassed!
Through trenches of danger and wonder.
And what was shown to lie behind the stanchions of light...
|Past the Judgment Pillars of Pompei, the Sacred Natal Omniversal Sea formed naturally by the Omniverse during the birth of an Omniversal Authority can be accessed.|
|Within the Sacred Natal Omniversal Sea, profound effects can be experienced by those who would normally not have access to it.|
|Some of these effects have been deduced on the weavings of the Greater Omniversal Authority of Aitia.|
WU!
A glow of purple and blue shone with Noah at the center as the illusory screen began to show a tantalizing silver sea!

|A base effect while within the Sacred Natal Omniversal Sea is the passive devouring of its waters that allow the advanced growth of Existential Dominiums, Omniversal Constructs, Omniversal Organs, Existential Extremes, and the base Existential Omniversal Glory of an Entity that allows one to be recognized by Omniversal Authorities if they have a high enough value.|
Little nuggets of what lay behind the stanchions of silver light showed themselves.
And they were enough to make Noah understand he absolutely had to step deeper into this Domain!

sentences.text: |Hmm...freedom!|
Outside of the Existential Mines of Cappadocia.

Martial King Adonis held eyes radiating blue tendrils of light as he looked out at the expanse of Planes of Existence and countless domains around him, the Will and controller of his Dominium currently being someone else entirely as all of his Records, Extremes, and Existence were under someone else's control!
All were under the control of the Great Usurper.

With his eyes acclimating to his new vision, Noah Eckert gazed behind him to see the tattered visage of the old Dragon Knight he had taken over with much difficulty, but it catapulted him where he was right now as everything was worth it!
His gaze eventually came to land on the visage of Basileus Anaine as he smiled.
|Used and discarded by my old friend, do you still share hatred, Little Anaine?|
Eckert asked calmly even though he knew the answer.
He didn't leave behind any loopholes as even Anaine...held traces of his oppressive will inside of her!
And within her, he felt the weavings of and controlled Vitalis.
From the old Dragon Knight, he felt the weavings of and controlled Dignity, Knighthood, Valor, and more Existential Extremity Authorities!

From Martial King Adonis, he could feel the weavings of the Exclusive Existential Extremity Authority of the Imperium along with multiple other Existential Extremes, his eyes already looking far ahead to a glorious future.
Other beings were limited in how many Existential Extremes they held in their Dominium as this number was never too high.

But if he could continue Dominating the souls of his Enemies and expand his will into the Dominiums of hundreds, thousands, or even millions of Entities of the Existential Dominium Realm...would he not grasp the weavings of and control hundreds of thousands or even millions of Existential Extremity Authorities?
Would he not be able to put together the complex weavings of an Omniversal Authority all by himself?

While others were looking to gain the influence of an Omniversal Authority, he could bring together all those he dominated and gully unleash not a mere influence- but the true power of an Omniversal Authority!
|Mmm...| He went towards the center of Cappadocia where a few Legions of the Imperium still remained as he was expectant of the future.
After all, what better time could there be to grow in power if not in times of war?
And most of all, what about a certain someone?
The weavings of a certain entity circled within his mind as he gazed back briefly past the boundaries of Cappadocia towards the Unknown.
He wondered.
'How far ahead are you, Osmont?'
A competitive spirit still welled up inside of him.
There were many things to be done if he wanted to stand a chance!
|First of all, Little Sister, Europa...it is time for you all to make your return.|
WAA!
From the depths of his Existential System.
Those he cared deeply for were waiting to come out this whole time!
Entry into the Inner Domain of Pompeii!
This restricted space showed a great deal of events occurring as the Omniversal Pillagers who had been seeking entry deeper in had a great deal of casualties here.
The spilling Pillars of ash silver light rotated like stanchions of celestial light, covering everything from top to bottom and stretching out on all sides without end.

One had to cross these dangerous spinning Pillars of light if they wanted to make any headway, and the Omniversal Pillagers showed that they were relentless in this pursuit as even after all this time, dozens of Omniversal Pillagers could be seen right outside the region of this dangerous place as a few moved forward and entered the gauntlet every now and then!

Beside him, Sona clicked her lips as they all gazed at this while feeling the oppressive Authority in the surroundings that if one didn't spend a great deal of resources, their existence may just begin to petrify.
|The deeper one goes in, the more concentrated the wonders of the Seed of a Greater Omniversal Authority are.
But I didn't expect it to be such a bloodbath...|
Her words echoed out as Noah agreed with them, gazing ahead as he sent his own weavings out!
|Pompeii...|
This was the name of this Domain.
It was also the distinction of the Seed of the Omniversal Authority that was budding here.
He wanted to know.
Why were the Omniversal Pillagers doing everything in their power trying to get behind these dangerous spinning stanchions of light?
Just what lay behind all this danger that even those above Teracosm would wished to get their hands on it?!
|Show me.|
He spoke out with a booming voice as Causality began to twist and distort.
There were possibilities of realities where he would make it past these spinning stanchions of light.
What would he find once he did so?
HUUM!
His Invictus Dominium Wings buzzed as in front of him, a singular massive illusory screen of light arose.
It pulled the gazes of everyone here as on this screen, the endless spinning stanchions of light were shown...and then bypassed!
Through trenches of danger and wonder.
And what was shown to lie behind the stanchions of light...
|Past the Judgment Pillars of Pompei, the Sacred Natal Omniversal Sea formed naturally by the Omniverse during the birth of an Omniversal Authority can be accessed.|
|Within the Sacred Natal Omniversal Sea, profound effects can be experienced by those who would normally not have access to it.|
|Some of these effects have been deduced on the weavings of the Greater Omniversal Authority of Aitia.|
WU!
A glow of purple and blue shone with Noah at the center as the illusory screen began to show a tantalizing silver sea!

|A base effect while within the Sacred Natal Omniversal Sea is the passive devouring of its waters that allow the advanced growth of Existential Dominiums, Omniversal Constructs, Omniversal Organs, Existential Extremes, and the base Existential Omniversal Glory of an Entity that allows one to be recognized by Omniversal Authorities if they have a high enough value.|
Little nuggets of what lay behind the stanchions of silver light showed themselves.
And they were enough to make Noah understand he absolutely had to step deeper into this Domain!

chapters.title: Chapter 3074 Pompeii! VI
paragraphs: |Let's go.|
Noah's gaze was firm as he turned into a streak of light towards the spinning stanchions of light.

Sona and the others followed as their figures and powerful auras were quickly captured by the Omniversal Pillagers clustered in the distance, but even these entities turned around and delved towards the silver stanchions of light as if what was behind it...was much greater than even enemies coming over!
At the same time that Noah and his party arrived at the Judgment Pillars of Pompeii, behind them from another region of the Outer Domain of Pompeii...
RIIP!
A huge tear could be heard as in the next moment, brilliant golden light supported by the glow of the influence of multiple Greater Omniversal Authorities bloomed.

Along with it, the terrifying auras of thousands began to blaze as in the lead, the glorious visage of Martial Emperor Xi could be seen- his flaming golden Armament burning the blood of who knew how many Omniversal Pillagers before he arrived as this Entity exceeding the Teracosm Stage was filled with endless power!
His will instantly passed through and observed the figures of Noah and others, along with the groups of Omniversal Pillagers surging into the Judgment Pillars of Pompeii to try and get past it.
And with a thundering command...
|Proceed!|
He and his Legions continued to move forward, even more Imperium Knights flowing out from the rift!

At this time, Noah and his party already arrived before the spinning stanchions of silver light that could destroy any level of Dominium, with Noah delving into it right away as his extremes began to vibrate.
And above him, the glow of Causality intensified as Aitia flowed serenely around his existence.
|The Existential Extremity Authority of Probability burns to make it so that no Pillar of Pompeii has a high enough probability to hit you.|
|The Existential Extremity Authority of Possibility...|.
|The Existential Extremity Authority of Manipulation ...|
One Extreme after another flowed around him.
And this made way for a fantastical scene.
As if he had trillions of eyes all around.
SHIING!
He passed through the field of spinning stanchions at the moment he did so, he was closed and drawn in as his visage seemed to move like water!
The moment a stanchion spun from any direction and swung where he was...
SAA!
His body moved sideways, turned, bent, or a variety of motions as he began crossing through the Judgment Pillars of Pompeii with ease.

Behind him, Sona simply walked in as terrifying frost and Dignity wrapped around her, her reality distorting as the stanchions slowed down the closer they neared her, allowing her figure to change directions while evading the massive swinging Pillars of brilliance!
Little CaCuLaTan bounced around as if he was entering somewhere unique, the moment his furball figure stepped in making a stanchion smash into it as...
PING!

He was pushed sideways like a bouncy object that instantly smashed into another stanchion, his figure being smashed and bounced again as his bright eyes and smile were apparent on his face whenever he was getting zapped around, his black and white fur filled with traces of gold now only looking like a small ball that was constantly being bounced across different stanchions.
Asterias Virgo stayed behind and swallowed her reservations before sighing and stepping in right away, Legions of the Imperium barreling in not far behind them!
Like water.
This was Noah's figure as the swinging stanchions filled with an ash silver authority that could petrify someone only ever breezed beside his body.
|The flow of your Extremes has reached an unprecedented level.|

|Exceeding the effects that a simple Dynamis of Extremity could have provided, weavings of Causality, Probability, Possibility, Weavings, Manipulation, Infinity...and more mix and meld together to usher forth an existential effect unmatched in brilliance.|
His body felt like an engine with countless streams coursing through him, each one working together to make countless possible futures disappear as only a single one remained.
A single future.
A few minutes passed.

There was silence all around Noah as he opened his eyes, seeing no stanchions around him anymore as when he came to from the euphoria of Authorities, he realized he had arrived with his body half submerged in a dazzling silver sea.
Behind him, the Judgment Pillars of Pompeii spun heavily and with a profound power as the silver sea dipped into an endless waterfall right before it!
Opposite the Judgment Pillars of Pompeii, the Sacred Natal Omniversal Sea of Pompeii stretched out into the distance as not too far from where Noah was...
HUUM!
The sea swirled around the massive figure of an Omniversal Pillager as they radiated waves of terrific Authority.

A distance further, another titanic Omniversal Pillager could be seen, the silver waters swirling like the body of a galaxy with it at the very center as its body absorbed everything and only seemed to become terrifyingly stronger!

Multiple terrifying figures of powerful Omniversal Pillagers that had crossed the Judgment Pillars of Pompeii enjoyed the enrichment of these wondrous waters, with Noah's own domain not being capable of taking another step before...
BZZT!
His Invictus Dominium Wings and his Dominium buzzed, his body turning into a hungry black hole as he began to devour everything around him.
Even before the unique Natal Omniversal Source of Authority flowed into him, his Extremes already cheered.
His Existence was already buzzing!
And when it arrived, it was akin to a drug as one of the most phenomenal things this Sacred Natal Omniversal Sea of Pompeii granted...was the expansion of one's Existential Omniversal Glory.
Noah already had a high level of such a value when comparing him even to Teracosm Stage Entities.
And now that he stepped into such a place?
BOOM!
Utmost brilliance and majesty unfolded!
Far, far away from the Source of the Imperium or any of the Sources belonging to the Sanctus Popul.
Far from any Sources belonging to the Omniversal Pillagers.
In a region filled with immense and endless darkness.

Weavings of the Greater Omniversal Authority of Deorcnysse swirled heavily, its millions of Existential Extremity Authorities twisting in complex ways that formed into a unique Greater Omniversal Domain of Deorcnysse.
In such a place, a unique existence woke up at this moment and raised its body.
Worm like in nature.
Extremely small.
Tenebrous in color as truly, it seemed like a small black worm.

The moment it awoke, it let out a miserable wail as if its very existence was a painful thing, this wail being so uniquely heavy and piercing that a nearby tendril of the Greater Omniversal Authority of Deorcnysse shot out to smash into this small worm as if telling it to shut up!
But...
BZZT!
From the small tendril of Deorcnysse that contained a few thousand weavings Existential Extremity Authorities...
A light even darker than Deorcnysse itself flashed as this tendril disappeared the moment it came in contact with the small worm!
WUU!
And the small black worm raised its head as if it were hurt, its wail becoming angry and more pronounced as its small body glowed.
The blazing weavings of the Existential Extremity Authorities contained in a tendril right before this briefly shone within its body.
And then a moment later...
WAP!
As if it cloned itself, another similarly sized black worm appeared.
And another.
And another!
They propagated rapidly until 27 small black worms appeared.
They held no aura or sense of power, looking at each other with curiosity before a moment later, they all turned towards the distance where countless tendrils of Deorcnysse were swirling.
WUU!

And their wail was heard as these small black worms flashed at a shocking speed, instantly appearing in front of these complex weavings of millions of Existential Extremity Authorities as shockingly...
POOF!
The weavings were disrupted before disappearing, seemingly devoured by the small black worms!
Thereafter, chaotic weavings began to unfold as a silent roar of Deorcnysse was heard, but it didn't seem to matter to the small black worms.
As if...this Greater Omniversal Authority meant nothing to them whatsoever!

chapters.title: Chapter 3075 Pompeii! VII
paragraphs: Little tiny black worms.
Unknown in origin and nature, with a single one seemingly appearing not that long ago.

And yet the terrifying weavings of a Greater Omniversal Authority seemed nothing to it, with any tendrils of authority sent its way being ineffective as they were simply sucked into the bodies of the small black worms as if they were nothing.
And within moments, from the 27 small black worms, 81 appeared.
WUU!

Their wailing cries became ever louder and more pronounced as their speed became ridiculously fast, all of them now seeming filled with an intent against the Greater Omniversal Authority of Deorcnysse as they delved deeper and deeper into its Domain- more and more of the millions of Existential Extremity Authorities that made it up disappearing one after another as a horrific scene unveiled itself!
Noah was in the middle of absorbing a pure Source of Omniversal Authority based on Pompeii itself.
His existence felt like it was becoming ever so massive, with a value he had yet to fully define slowly increasing as he became ever so aware of it.
Existential Omniversal Glory.
A high amount of it, and one could gain the Recognition of Omniversal Authorities!

And Noah knew that its accumulation depended on one's Omniversal Organ. It was his Invictus Dominium Wings that allowed him to attain the Recognition of the Greater Omniversal Authority of Aitia, and all the subsequent boons that followed.
The more his Invictus Dominium Wings advanced, the more he played with Causality, the more he would peer into the weavings of Aitia and understand its remaining three components.
If he had the recognition and full understanding of the Omniversal Authority along with everything it contained...what would happen?
If-
|Hmm?|
His thoughts were stopped.
The clear Quintessential Codex of Extremity in his hands buzzed.

Its pages fluttered as it flipped open to the records of the Greater Omniversal Authority of Deorcnysse, and the millions of Existential Extremity Authorities recorded as parts of its weavings...they shockingly began to dim as if they never existed to begin with.
And a moment later, Noah felt his weavings begin to vibrate with interminable fervor, his Lineage and all parts of his existence rolling alongside it!
He felt the countless paths he could take dim at an unfathomable rate, whereupon the trillions and trillions of possibilities out there, it felt like half were erased in the span of a second!
These were probabilities of the future!
Of his future!
Their weavings were instantly erased as if they never existed, and even more weavings were closed off as...
|An Unknown Influence is negating many possible weavings of the future!|
Who?
What else was there apart from the Unknown Source that was trying to steer him to take on the path of an Omniversal Destroyer?!
What-
|AHH!|

A piercing scream echoed out as behind him, tight after the spinning Judgment Pillars of Pompeii, the figure of Sonahasd just crossed through as she clasped her head while a fierce bellow erupted from her, her face twisted in pain as her eyes were glazed with an icy gold light!
Noah's visage instantly appeared beside her even while seas of silver splendor surged inside of both of them, his hand grasping hers as her voice echoed out in pained and exasperated tones.
|All possible weavings are disappearing!|
WAA!
|Weaving of Damnation, weavings of greatness, weavings of pain...every one of them!|
Her voice was pained as if she didn't understand.
She had seen the weavings of Damnation as with Noah, more possibilities opened as she even discovered the workings of what was to come.
They had a clear enemy.

An Unknown Source that may not even be capable of moving by itself. Something that even steered Noah as the perpetrator of Damnation, and as long as they controlled this while collecting more anomalies for the Initiative, they would be able to overcome it as more possible weavings were flourishing!
So why...
|Why?!|
Even though Noah held her right hand, she clutched her chest with her left as the area where her heart should be ached.
She held no heart, and yet it ached so much!
She felt like she was coming so close to overcoming something that she had been shouldering all these years, only for something even more obscene to show itself.
She didn't understand why.
She-
|It's okay.|
HUUM!
The voice of Noah echoed out serenely as it stabilized the weavings that Sona was seeing.
|Whatever it is, we will overcome it.|
Noah said such words while he turned Sona's gorgeous face towards his.
Golden blue light surrounded her.
Hues of green bathed her.
Her eyes twinkled with gold and blue icy light as her pupils focused, a firm light rising within them as she spoke while gazing deeply at Noah.
|Do you know...all other paths have turned dark as somehow, a singular path is all that remains.|
|That path...has you at its lead. The only thing not consumed and negated completely in all paths. Why is that?|
She seemed to genuinely be asking him a question.
But he...didn't have an answer for her.
He couldn't tell her that even for him, more than half of the possible paths of weavings of the future were already erased as others were slowly following!
Something immensely destructive and unfathomable had occurred as it made things very, very serious.
But he didn't know what.
At least, not yet!
But he wasn't alone.

In the distance, figures of the all Omniversal Pillagers that were devouring the Source of the Sacred Natal Omniversal Sea of Pompeii all trembled while shocked looks spread in their eyes, some of them even letting out bellows that could be heard in the distance.
|WHAT!|
|IMPOSSIBLE!|
They weren't the only ones.

Behind, Legions of the Imperium that had begun to enter the Judgment Pillars of Pompeii clutched their heads in shock as they received new weavings of their future paths, this moment coming at a very inopportune time as for some of them, shining stanchions of light smashed into them soon after!
Far from the Greater Omniversal Domain of Pompeii.
From the Source of the Imperium.
To the Sources of Dignity, Valor, Freedom, and many others of the Sanctus Populi.
Weavings descended as they were all enough to turn things upside down!

She felt like she was coming so close to overcoming something that she had been shouldering all these years, only for something even more obscene to show itself.
She didn't understand why.
She-
|It's okay.|
HUUM!
The voice of Noah echoed out serenely as it stabilized the weavings that Sona was seeing.
|Whatever it is, we will overcome it.|
Noah said such words while he turned Sona's gorgeous face towards his.
Golden blue light surrounded her.
Hues of green bathed her.
Her eyes twinkled with gold and blue icy light as her pupils focused, a firm light rising within them as she spoke while gazing deeply at Noah.
|Do you know...all other paths have turned dark as somehow, a singular path is all that remains.|
|That path...has you at its lead.
The only thing not consumed and negated completely in all paths.
Why is that?|
She seemed to genuinely be asking him a question.
But he...didn't have an answer for her.
He couldn't tell her that even for him, more than half of the possible paths of weavings of the future were already erased as others were slowly following!
Something immensely destructive and unfathomable had occurred as it made things very, very serious.
But he didn't know what.
At least, not yet!
But he wasn't alone.

In the distance, figures of the all Omniversal Pillagers that were devouring the Source of the Sacred Natal Omniversal Sea of Pompeii all trembled while shocked looks spread in their eyes, some of them even letting out bellows that could be heard in the distance.
|WHAT!|
|IMPOSSIBLE!|
They weren't the only ones.

Behind, Legions of the Imperium that had begun to enter the Judgment Pillars of Pompeii clutched their heads in shock as they received new weavings of their future paths, this moment coming at a very inopportune time as for some of them, shining stanchions of light smashed into them soon after!
Far from the Greater Omniversal Domain of Pompeii.
From the Source of the Imperium.
To the Sources of Dignity, Valor, Freedom, and many others of the Sanctus Populi.
Weavings descended as they were all enough to turn things upside down!

chapters.title: Chapter 3076 On the brink of fear! I
paragraphs: Within the vast stretches of the Omniverse, the figure of Martial Empress Yelena was leading one of the most powerful forces of the Imperium yet, with 10,000 Martial Kings following her lead.
Their pathway seemed to be leading directly towards the Source of Dignity!
Yet simultaneously, without needing the specific insight of certain extremes like those from the Visionary Enclave, all of them were able to grasp the weavings of their possible futures.
The fact that suddenly, all possible paths were gone.
They couldn't see any possibilities of weavings in the future!
It was a shocking finding, but one had to also look closely at the method by which all of them realized this.
Every single Entity realized these weavings at the same time.
As if what was coming for them didn't even bother to hide it.
Finding out anything about the Omniversal Destroyer that a few select powerful beings was hard, with most others not knowing about it.
But whatever just came now...they all found out about it freely.
Did it not have any authority to mask its weavings? Could they find out more about it?

These were just some of the questions running through Empress Yelena's mind as she kept her calm and didn't panic entirely even as the Martial Kings behind her looked shocked, astonished, and in disbelief at what their own weavings told them!
None of it...seemed real!

In their shock and disbelief, they had been continuing on the same path towards the Source of Dignity as within moments, Martial Empress Yelena felt the pulsing of weavings as her figure instantly roused to attention to look ahead, seeing a Legions gloating opposite her as they seemed to be experiencing the same shock and disbelief.

In their shock and disbelief, they had been continuing on the same path towards the Source of Dignity as within moments, Martial Empress Yelena felt the pulsing of weavings as her figure instantly roused to attention to look ahead, seeing a Legions gloating opposite her as they seemed to be experiencing the same shock and disbelief.
It was...the Legions of the Sanctus Populi led by Elder Queens and the Elder Queen Mother who would not let the battle be dictated by their enemies.
Massive and magisterial Dragons floated like Omniversal vessels, their backs filled to the brim with Legions of other Dragon Knights and Sanctus Princesses.
The Legions of the Source of Dignity of Sanctus Populi.
They chose not to react defensively as they had set off, and were even close to ambushing their enemies!

At the same time that Martial Empress Yelena and her Legions noticed them, the Legions led by the Elder Queen Mother of Dignity and some of her Dragon Knights also locked onto them and came out of their own stupor.
They stared at each other as if they wanted to know if they felt the same weavings right now!

Immense silence permeated across the surroundings as tensions built up, with the eyes of Martial Empress Yelena shining moments later as she raised her hand to command her Legions to hold, her figure floating up as she stared at the most powerful Entity opposite her.
She looked at the Elder Queen Mother and spoke calmly.
|Did you see it?|
WAA!
She didn't say what exactly.
She had to be sure that it wasn't just related to the Imperium.
And as if the Elder Queen was also thinking the same lines...
|Did you see it?|
She got back the same question.
And the rising silence and tension only became that much deeper as both sides buzzed with Authority!

Martial Empress Yelena half expected some of the more battle-hardened Martial Kings behind her to even ignore orders and radiate their righteous judgment of the Imperium as this would spur on a full battle, but nobody moved.
When she looked back, she saw that their eyes were still filled with the same blackness and disbelief as it didn't seem like any of them were up for a battle.
After all, their own weavings told them that all their possible futures were just erased!

Across the eons, those in the Existential Dominium Realm always felt threads of the possibilities of their weavings and future. Combinations of thousands or millions of possible paths as the most probable ones would unfold.
There were always possibilities.
There were always paths...until at this moment, they couldn't see any.

That even with all of their power, annealing of their Existential Dominiums with countless resources, and the many years perfecting their extremes and techniques...none of it mattered as they held no future.
Such a realization was extremely shocking as who would have thoughts of battle after that?!
What were they even fighting for?!
Martial Empress Yelena felt these despotic and shocked weavings within her own forces as she came to a decision right after, her voice echoing out amidst the heavy silence.
|Set up camp!|
WAA!
Even though the Elder Queen Mother ahead of her didn't answer, Empress Yelena could see her eyes and the eyes of her forces.
Their weavings carried the same resonance as those of her and her people!

So she released the command that was followed by her Legions in a dazed fashion, a golden bastion of light erupting underneath them as the hazy golden light of the Exclusive Existential Extremity Authority of the Imperium began to blaze around this region.

Ahead of her, the Elder Queen Mother seemed to have spoken similar words as the many Dragons retreated into a calm and coiling formation, with her figure actually floating forward while surrounded by two Dragon Knights!
Martial Empress Yelena did the same as two Martial Kings covered her left and right, and she moved forward to meet the Elder Queen Mother of one of the Domains of the Sanctus Populi.
They should have been battling by now with both sides suffering major losses, but their priorities were just greatly changed.
The Leaders of the two Legions appeared at the center point between their forces as Martial Empress Yelena gazed at the Elder Queen Mother of Dignity and her Dragon Knight, her intent echoing out.
|I stand here by my own Authority, with my actions not being a reflection of any stance the Great Imperium is making.|
She began succinctly as towards her words, the Elder Queen Mother waved her hands dismissively as she replied.
|Are all possible paths closed for you all as well? Everything?|
She spoke to gain affirmation as towards such a question, Empress Yelena nodded without hesitation!
It was an affirmation that only caused the eyes of the Elder Queen to turn somber, with the Legions of both sides on standby as the gazes they shared were one and the same.
There was too much confusion.
The unfolding of the current reality didn't make much sense!
So Martial Empress Yelena came to a decision as she spoke calmly to the Elder Queen Mother.
|I will send word to the Imperium Exarchs for Dialogue to be opened between our sides to try and understand, respond, and resolve the absence of future possibilities we are all experiencing.|

chapters.title: Chapter 3077 On the brink of fear! II
paragraphs: She spoke such drastic words as she could see it.
She didn't even turn around to look at her own forces with her eyes as her will had already noticed this same emotion in all eyes here.
On the battle-hardened Martial King and others.
She could see that after seeing the cessation of any and all possible futures, apart from their shock and disbelief, they began to teeter on the brink of fear.
Fear!
Because just what could cause the cessation of all their possible futures for every single one of them without fail?!
Martial Empress Yelena could see the rising fear as she had to control this, and fighting a war at this moment was far from being advisable as she instead sought dialogue.

The Elder Queen Mother of Dignity gazed at her coldly as dialogue was never something the Sanctus Populi would have with a group of beings that had enslaved an entire Existential Lineage to be Seeds for the production of Fruits of Existence.
They were not good people.
They were entirely against the will of the people!
But in this moment of utterly profound unknowns of the future, where the fate of all people lay in peril...the guidelines of the Sanctus Populi showed what had to be done.
So the Elder Queen Mother of Dignity nodded while gazing behind her.
|Confirm the extent of the cessation of future weavings. I will check on my side and let the Sanctus Populi know of this expanded dialogue.|
Yes.
They had to confirm the extent of this terror. Was it widespread for all beings, or were there some who didn't face it?
More information had to be obtained as at this moment, a point of communication was made between the Imperium and the Sanctus Populi!
Around this same time.
Within the farthest reaches of the omniverse, absent of light and any brilliance, a low howl could be heard amidst a powerful wail that seemed like a cacophony of sounds at this moment.

The dazzling weavings of the Greater Omniversal Authority of Deorcnysse made up of millions of Existential Extremity Authorities...had dwindled to absolutely nothing as at this moment, a massive tenebrous worm sucked in the last weavings that made up this complex Authority.
Around it, tens of thousands of wriggling black worms could be seen, such a reality expressing a sickening feeling as each one seemed to be emitting wails once more.

The biggest worm that had just finished devouring the last shreds of Deorcnysse looked around with more cognizance- all the other worms having split from it as at this moment, even it let out a wail as it felt a sensation flooding back into it.
It didn't like this sensation.
The others didn't like this sensation.
So they wailed.
But when they were eating up tendrils of that authority...tendrils of Existential Extremity Authorities- they didn't feel that horrid sensation.
They had to look for more Authorities like that.
They had to, otherwise this vile sensation within them would only grow stronger!
WUU!
The wails became louder and louder as on the body of the largest tenebrous Worm, segments of it wriggled before soon enough, they turned towards a certain direction.
It couldn't see anything.
It couldn't sense anything.
The only thing it had was the vile feeling within it as it turned towards what it believed would have the cure- a direction where more of those Authorities would be.
And then...
BOOM!
It shot out at speeds that cracked the surrounding Omniverse as behind it, throngs of wriggling worms also turned towards its direction and followed!
In the Sacred Natal Omniversal Sea of Pompeii.
Noah supported the figure of Sona that was still looking at him with complex emotions as his gaze was drawn towards nothing else but the Quintessential Codex of Extremity.
Because on its pages.
Where the Records of the Greater Omniversal Authority of Deorcnysse used to lie.
The millions of Existential Extremity Authorities that made it...were all grayed out.
Not a single one was missed.
Not a single one remained!
All of them were dim as if they never existed, and the big distinction of Deorcnysse was also gray with weavings of the end!

Noah stared at this scene with stern eyes as of course, he connected the disappearance of an entire Greater Omniversal Authority to the same thing that was causing the cessation of possible futures for Sona and all others.
There was something out there devouring Greater Omniversal Authorities as this same thing was the cause of the end of weavings for many entities.
What was it? It's power?
Was it exceeding the Teracosm Stage? Or even beyond that?
Was-
HUUM!

He was taken out of his thoughts as he came to observe the Quintessential Codex of Extremity buzzing, transparent tendrils of light wrapping around it- specifically on the pages holding the records of the devoured and deleted Greater Omniversal Authority of Deorcnysse!
Along with these transparent tendrils of light, intents flowed toward Noah in a shocking fashion as they formed into prompts.
|You hold the last remnants and records of the weavings of the Greater Omniversal Authority of Deorcnysse.|
|The balanced weavings of the Omniverse are disrupted by the cessation of Deorcnysse as they seek to go towards equilibrium.|

|Holding the last remaining records of the Greater Omniversal Authority of Deorcnysse, you have gained the Authority to spark the Greater Omniversal Singularity Seed of Deorcnysse under the right conditions.|
|The conditions for the spark of the Greater Omniversal Singularity Seed of Deorcnysse are unknown.|
|It is recommended to move rapidly before the composition and records of the Greater Omniversal Authority of Deorcnysse entirely enter oblivion.|
A shocking finding fell onto his lap.
An obscene opportunity because of nothing else other than...the Quintessential Codex of Extremity!

His entire existence began to think and try to grasp the weavings of this phenomenon rapidly why he urged Sona behind him, the figures of Little CaCuLaTan and Asterias Virgo appearing from the Judgment Pillars of Pompeii at this moment and also stepping into the Sacred Natal Omniversal Sea of Pompeii as truly, they had to hurry.
Too many things were rapidly changing as at this moment, Noah felt like he was on the clock while something utterly disastrous loomed in the distance!

chapters.title: Chapter 3078 Chaos Theory I
paragraphs: Time.
It was something that others had a great deal of, and also the thing that determined much about the power of an Entity.
Those who had more time in existence generally had more power.
Noah had not gone through a great deal of time, and yet he found himself always embroiled in the midst of things that occurred just as he was moving.
|The Existential Extremity Authority of the Protagonist ponders on why wars and apocalypses break out the moment of your arrival into a new Dominium.|

Eons passed and went, and millions of years came as of course, there were Wars prior against the Imperium, Sanctus Populi, Omniversal Pillagers, and other defeated forces, but it seemed that the moment Noah arrived on the stage of the Omniverse, many more things were suddenly spurred on as he wasn't given time!

Time to simply and in a laid back manner explore, get stronger, farm Fruits of Existence, develop and understand millions of Existential Extremity Authorities, and observe the continued growth of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed.

If he was given a month or even a year with no conflict, given the rate of the production of Fruits of Existence by him and the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed, he may just have grown strong enough to topple the strongest Entities here!
But no.

Wars and apocalypses bloomed left and right as soon as he arrived, and in this manner, the progress of months or years could be obtained in a short period of time by burning and devouring the hard work of the enemies that threw themselves at him.
|The Existential Extremity Authority of the Protagonist affirms that this reality only further proves its distinction.|
|Plot ponders on whether it has been directly influencing things without its knowledge.|
|The Weavings of the Existential Extremity Authority of Entropy make themselves prevalent.|
HUUM!
All of a sudden, Noah's visage began to leak out murky purple radiance that visibly stretched out around him.
|Entropy states that everywhere you go, chaos follows.|

|Any sense of equilibrium is destroyed as events follow the most uncertain and chaotic outcomes. Countless lives are lost, whether through your hands or others. You are not a blessing to the order of any system, but a disruptor and instigator that always leads everything towards destruction.|
Noah's figure came to a stop.
The brightness in his eyes pulsed as they stared at the prompts that had just risen before him as if he were frozen.

Around him, streams of the Source of the Sacred Natal Omniversal Sea of Pompeii continued to flow into him while the chaotic weavings of the purple murky black light of Entropy formed into a swirling storm around him that only grew stronger.
|You've destroyed Worlds, Realms, Galaxies, Universes, Cosmos, entire Realities and Dimensions, Planes of Existence, and Existential Domains.|
|You are a thorough bringer of chaos even if you are not conscious of it, with rivers of blood lying behind your throne too vast to grasp.|
HUUM!
The weavings were hard to read.
But they held truth within them that was irrefutable, with many scenes crossing Noah's mind as the memories of countless Entities he had devoured rose to the surface of his mind!
|Noah?|

Beside him, the visage of Sona was pushed away as she called out with worry, seeing a shocking annealing of the chaotic purple black brilliance of Entropy around him only get more intense as the silver waters around them seemed to be getting rapidly devoured by it, the Existential light around it only becoming more intense.
|The Weavings of Chaos have attained Existential Extremity Authority.|
|The Weavings of Destruction have attained Existential Extremity Authority.|
|The Weavings of the Villain have attained Existential Extremity Authority.|
|The Weavings of Apocalypse have attained Existential Extremity Authority.|

Concepts rose and swirled around Noah with such shocking intensity as he remained frozen and gazing forward, reflecting on all the things he had done so far as the weavings of Entropy only became stronger!
|You are a chaos attractor that subtly conducts actions that lead to even greater unfolding chaos, plunging entire systems into wars for your benefit.|
|The weavings of Entropy applaud your grand calculations.|

|From the moment of the destruction of the Vitalis and Vacuous Existential Domains, you've continued conducting a series of chaotic events that ultimately led one of the major forces of the Omniverse to seek you out, and on the guise of defense, you unleashed enough chaos to kill the Martial Kings that acted as the spark to a war.|

|You purposefully released false weavings of an Omniversal Destroyer to the countless masses seeking you, further pulling on them to come seek you where thereafter, they would become more fuel to the endless bloody river of your Ascension.|

|Entropy applauds you with the highest honors and lets you know that you have unveiled weavings of profound chaos across the Omniverse, spreading across it in such a potent fashion that now, it is capable of collecting the product of your achievements!|
Noah was silent.
His figure sat down on the submerged silver waters that were getting devoured by him endlessly as he looked ahead.
He...who was he?
Someone who simply moved to destroy and plunder?
Just to elevate himself up, he destroyed everything else? He-
|Entropy is gathering the products of your chaotic and disordered achievements and begins enacting a Seed of an Omniversal Authority over it.|
The dark purple light of chaos became a shockingly deep hue it began to form into the shape of a pillar of light that shot upwards.
Up past the Inner Domain of Pompeii.
Into the vast Omniverse.

|Your widespread chaos has affected enough of the weavings of the Omniverse to allow for enough Natal Omniversal Source to be gathered and utilized for the formation of an Omniversal Singularity Seed.|
Above him.
The pillar of murky dark purple light only became more and more brilliant as the heads of many entities rose and came to gaze in this direction.

Sona's eyes were cloudy as she was bathed in a brilliant icy light while trying to reach Noah to no avail, his figure currently seeming filled with countless thoughts and weavings as he looked up- unfathomable weavings of chaos exploding outwards as it seemed they were only just getting started!

sentences.text: Time.
It was something that others had a great deal of, and also the thing that determined much about the power of an Entity.
Those who had more time in existence generally had more power.
Noah had not gone through a great deal of time, and yet he found himself always embroiled in the midst of things that occurred just as he was moving.
|The Existential Extremity Authority of the Protagonist ponders on why wars and apocalypses break out the moment of your arrival into a new Dominium.|

Eons passed and went, and millions of years came as of course, there were Wars prior against the Imperium, Sanctus Populi, Omniversal Pillagers, and other defeated forces, but it seemed that the moment Noah arrived on the stage of the Omniverse, many more things were suddenly spurred on as he wasn't given time!

Time to simply and in a laid back manner explore, get stronger, farm Fruits of Existence, develop and understand millions of Existential Extremity Authorities, and observe the continued growth of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed.

If he was given a month or even a year with no conflict, given the rate of the production of Fruits of Existence by him and the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed, he may just have grown strong enough to topple the strongest Entities here!
But no.

Wars and apocalypses bloomed left and right as soon as he arrived, and in this manner, the progress of months or years could be obtained in a short period of time by burning and devouring the hard work of the enemies that threw themselves at him.
|The Existential Extremity Authority of the Protagonist affirms that this reality only further proves its distinction.|
|Plot ponders on whether it has been directly influencing things without its knowledge.|
|The Weavings of the Existential Extremity Authority of Entropy make themselves prevalent.|
HUUM!
All of a sudden, Noah's visage began to leak out murky purple radiance that visibly stretched out around him.
|Entropy states that everywhere you go, chaos follows.|
|Any sense of equilibrium is destroyed as events follow the most uncertain and chaotic outcomes.
Countless lives are lost, whether through your hands or others.
You are not a blessing to the order of any system, but a disruptor and instigator that always leads everything towards destruction.|
Noah's figure came to a stop.
The brightness in his eyes pulsed as they stared at the prompts that had just risen before him as if he were frozen.

Around him, streams of the Source of the Sacred Natal Omniversal Sea of Pompeii continued to flow into him while the chaotic weavings of the purple murky black light of Entropy formed into a swirling storm around him that only grew stronger.
|You've destroyed Worlds, Realms, Galaxies, Universes, Cosmos, entire Realities and Dimensions, Planes of Existence, and Existential Domains.|
|You are a thorough bringer of chaos even if you are not conscious of it, with rivers of blood lying behind your throne too vast to grasp.|
HUUM!
The weavings were hard to read.
But they held truth within them that was irrefutable, with many scenes crossing Noah's mind as the memories of countless Entities he had devoured rose to the surface of his mind!
|Noah?|

Beside him, the visage of Sona was pushed away as she called out with worry, seeing a shocking annealing of the chaotic purple black brilliance of Entropy around him only get more intense as the silver waters around them seemed to be getting rapidly devoured by it, the Existential light around it only becoming more intense.
|The Weavings of Chaos have attained Existential Extremity Authority.|
|The Weavings of Destruction have attained Existential Extremity Authority.|
|The Weavings of the Villain have attained Existential Extremity Authority.|
|The Weavings of Apocalypse have attained Existential Extremity Authority.|

Concepts rose and swirled around Noah with such shocking intensity as he remained frozen and gazing forward, reflecting on all the things he had done so far as the weavings of Entropy only became stronger!
|You are a chaos attractor that subtly conducts actions that lead to even greater unfolding chaos, plunging entire systems into wars for your benefit.|
|The weavings of Entropy applaud your grand calculations.|

|From the moment of the destruction of the Vitalis and Vacuous Existential Domains, you've continued conducting a series of chaotic events that ultimately led one of the major forces of the Omniverse to seek you out, and on the guise of defense, you unleashed enough chaos to kill the Martial Kings that acted as the spark to a war.|

|You purposefully released false weavings of an Omniversal Destroyer to the countless masses seeking you, further pulling on them to come seek you where thereafter, they would become more fuel to the endless bloody river of your Ascension.|

Someone who simply moved to destroy and plunder?
Just to elevate himself up, he destroyed everything else?
He-

chapters.title: Chapter 3079 Chaos Theory II
paragraphs: He looked up.
He was looking up, and yet it seemed as if he couldn't see the endless skies!
All he could see were the dark pulsing waves of Entropy that crashed down all around him.
When did he begin to think the way he currently thought?

When did his reality distort in such a way that he could kill millions of Entities, shatter entire Worlds, Realms, Universes, Cosmos, and entire Realities and Planes of Existence as if it were nothing?
When did life hold such little value to him that he considered life forms mere particles of Loot to be on his chopping board- as mere fuel for his progression?
HUUM!
The chaos around him only became more intense as above, a dazzling point of singularity began to form.
Alongside it, the prompts of the Weavings of Entropy that seemed to have been building up Authority ever since it became Existential continued.
|With a Construct that requires the devouring of all things as fuel for its own growth, Entropy applauds you for the chaos it causes.|

|Devouring and plundering every aspect of existence it appears in, your construct contains boundless hunger and greed for life that will never be satiated, its apathy undoubtedly greater than even yours with how voracious its hunger is.|
|Your actions appear random or simply following the progression of events with you reacting to external stimuli.|
|An Entity attacks you, and you defend yourself and kill them. But the methodology you took to get to that point is surrounded by weavings of chaos that you construct.|

|Within the apparent randomness and disorder of the Realities, Planes of Existence, and Omniverse you are currently in, there seem to be many fractals and interconnectedness of weavings that all lead to your cataclysmic benefits.|

|Small and insignificant actions you take initially seem to cause a butterfly effect that propagates to create numerous diverging outcomes and possibilities, causing an unfolding of deterministic chaos everywhere you go.|
|You express annoyance in any new domain you go to if ever the unfolding weavings lead to a sort of cataclysmic apocalypses, all without taking hold of weaving that is partly true and partly false.|

|A weaving you know of deep within you, past any Unknown Sources or anything else that may try to influence you. The reality that for your own benefit and power, you subtly conduct chaos and lead every domain of Reality you enter toward an Apocalypse.|
Noah's will silently buzzed.
He looked at the weavings of Entropy as he had no reply.
BOOM!

Above him, the blooming singularity began to pull in weavings of multiple Existential Extremity Authorities, Noah feeling Entropy take centerpoint as Chaos, Villain, Destruction, and many others began to follow.
As this occurred, the weavings of chaos seemed to resonate within his mind over and over again. He looked back over the path he had taken.
He knew he was a selfish man and accepted this long ago.
But for him to bring death and misery wherever he went?
For him to be the bringer of Apocalypse in every Domain he went to?
This was...
This was...
It was not something Noah could deny.
Any Domain he and the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed entered...did he not devour everything about it until what it used to be was entirely erased?
The Blue Planet.
The Nine Dimensions.
The Desolate Mausoleum.
Vacuous and Vitalis.
He came.
He conquered.
He devoured.
And he left.
This was who he was!
HUUM!
The Entropy in his surroundings picked up and became even more intense.
|Noah!|
In the distant surroundings, the voice of Sona could be heard as surrounded by freezing icy brilliance, she tried to reach out towards him to no avail.
He.
Someone who only produced immeasurable weavings of chaos and induced Apocalypses in every land he went to.
He killed those he designated and gave the label of enemies to, and those labeled as friendly...were utilized, discarded and forgotten as soon as they arrived.
He even went as far as labeling himself the Protagonist while he gave the label of Extras to all others!
He had even distinguished the women he considered closest to him and even his own son as Chosen Extras.
His own son...he called an Extra.
His own son!
HUUM!
His Invictus Dominium Wings- his Omniversal Organ and even his very heart pulsed as he felt a sense of shame and pain at even treating his own blood this way!
Even the figure of Sona that was trying to reach out to him in the distance.
Did he actually have any genuine feelings of attachment towards her?
Or was he simply utilizing her for power and as a tool for Dual Cultivation?

From her side, she looked towards him for answers and for hope, where not too long ago, she had even asked him why every single path of hers was now shattered and destroyed as the only possible path that showed life and possibility stemmed from following him.
As someone she could rely on after so many years of a heavy burden, some genuine feelings for him may have truly formed in her heart.
But what about him?
He didn't have an answer.
He looked down at his hands that had taken countless actions, and felt the beat of his heart, and he then felt his weavings that had made countless choices.
They all...felt so immensely heavy at this moment!
But his mind remained resilient.
He accepted it.
He accepted the definition of Entropy when it related to him as truly, he could not deny it.
He did devour and kill.
Every land he had entered so far had fallen and been devoured by him.
His Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed was voracious and unending in its hunger.
Yes.
He was all of these things.
But that wasn't it.
This wasn't all that he was!
|Manadynamics rises in contention.|
|Genesis rises in contention!|
|The Weavings of the Hero rise in contention.|
|The Weavings of the Protagonist rise in contention.|
|The Weavings of Extremity stand firm with belief.|
|The Weavings of Infinity and Quintessence assert their own weavings.|
|Amidst all the chaos, you are the one to save countless more lives and rebuild and restructure what would have been lost.|
|Were you to not exist, the system of existence would lose a tremendous overall benefit!|
